raw.title: Staff Backend Engineer - Grafana Second Horizon | Spain | Remote
raw.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
raw.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany.

The Opportunity:

At Grafana Labs, we build observability tools that help users understand, respond to, and improve their systems – regardless of scale, complexity, or tech stack. We recently started a skunkworks initiative with a mission to bring observability to the rest of the business. Our goal is to make Grafana the single best place where humans and AI agents understand and act on real-time data from across the enterprise. As part of this initiative, we are building an AI-native data intelligence system that gives agents reliable, governed access to enterprise context. This system helps agents retrieve the right data, metadata, definitions, lineage, quality signals, and institutional knowledge without every agent builder having to maintain their own brittle context files. The principle is simple: the context system retrieves, agents decide, and data teams maintain the intelligence.

The new team is a mix of seasoned Grafanistas and new hires. We operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, both as individuals and as a team. Engineers are empowered to make decisions, move quickly, and validate ideas early – while being supported by a deeply collaborative culture that values curiosity, feedback, and cross-functional partnership.

We’re looking for a Staff-level Backend Engineer to help build the first production services for this context layer management system. You will design and ship the core backend architecture that powers ingestion, context storage, retrieval APIs, and agent-facing integrations. This is an early-stage role on a high-autonomy team, so you should be comfortable working through ambiguity, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and building systems that can evolve from internal dogfooding to production-grade SaaS. As the team matures, there’s a broad opportunity to expand or redefine this role based on impact and initiative.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Build the core backend services: Design, implement, test, and operate the first services for context ingestion, context indexing, retrieval orchestration, API access, source configuration, and system administration.
  • Create a scalable SaaS foundation: Help define and build the architecture for a multi-tenant service, including tenant isolation, usage tracking, quotas, audit logs, background jobs, and reliable service boundaries.
  • Power agent-facing retrieval workflows: Build APIs and service interfaces that allow AI agents, MCP tools, CLIs, and internal applications to retrieve relevant context, provenance, confidence signals, and warnings.
  • Work across product and infrastructure: Partner with the team to make practical tradeoffs between fast experimentation and long-term reliability, especially as the project moves from prototype to production.
  • Operate what you build: Instrument services with metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and dashboards. Use observability tools to understand system behavior and improve reliability.
  • Contribute to technical direction: Help shape the architecture, service boundaries, storage choices, API contracts, deployment patterns, and engineering practices for a new product area.
  • Effective communication: You’ll be working in a highly dynamic and collaborative environment, so we need someone who can communicate effectively and contribute across teams.
  • Ownership and impact: Take full ownership of the AI solutions you develop, ensuring they are not only innovative but also scalable, maintainable, and aligned with real user workflows.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Strong engineering skills: Solid experience building production-grade, user-facing software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems and making UI design decisions with minimal supervision.
  • AI experience with a practical mindset: You’re familiar with AI technologies and frameworks, and you focus on delivering high-quality solutions that work in the real world, not just in theory.
  • Quick iteration and experimentation: You’re comfortable releasing prototypes, collecting feedback, and iterating with a pragmatic mindset.
  • Proven initiative: You take ownership and drive projects forward, pushing boundaries to find the most impactful solutions. You can deal with ambiguity and are able to define scope where things are loosely defined.
  • Collaborative attitude: You communicate effectively with your peers. You’re open to feedback, and you bring a solutions-oriented mindset to the table.
  • Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and building applications powered by GenAI.
  • Proven track record of delivering software that made it into production and is actively used by users.
  • Exposure to working in cloud-native environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Experience using observability tools to understand and troubleshoot system behavior.

Bonus Points for:

  • Experience building or working with agent frameworks or multi‑agent workflows.
  • Experience as a data analyst or work with data platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, Snowflake, DataBricks)
  • Experience building tools for data engineering.

How we work:

We are a remote-first team that meets regularly over video and does most of our work asynchronously, in writing. We value creativity, diverse perspectives, and clear communication. Tempo is relied upon by prominent global organizations to monitor critical applications and infrastructure, and we expect everyone on the team, including our Staff engineers, to contribute ideas that make it a more reliable, more useful, and more loved product.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Spain, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR 94,025 - EUR 112,830. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

raw.title: Customer Service Rep 1
raw.excerpt: Position Summary:The FEMA Call Center Customer Service Representative (CSR) serves as a direct telephone point of contact for individuals registering for federal disaster assistance, callers seeking information about a prior registration, and individuals seeking referrals to disaster relief programs and other assistance providers.
raw.description:
Position Summary:

The FEMA Call Center Customer Service Representative (CSR) serves as a direct telephone point of contact for individuals registering for federal disaster assistance, callers seeking information about a prior registration, and individuals seeking referrals to disaster relief programs and other assistance providers. The CSR conducts customer interactions with patience, tact, courtesy, and professionalism; determines the caller's needs; provides approved instructions and referrals; and accurately enters information into FEMA-approved computer systems while following a scripted interview process.

The CSR performs work in direct support of FEMA's Individual Assistance mission during periods of disaster activity. Depending on the applicable Call Order, assigned duties may include Registration Intake (RI), Basic Helpline (HL), Transitional Sheltering Assistance (TSA), outbound calling, document review or validation, case-related support, and referrals to other disaster assistance providers.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a direct point of contact for disaster survivors and other callers seeking federal assistance, registration services, status information, or referrals.
  • Conduct every call with patience, tact, courtesy, empathy, and professionalism.
  • Listen actively and determine the caller's needs using approved procedures and scripts.
  • Provide accurate instructions, information, telephone numbers, and referrals based on current FEMA-approved guidance.
  • Conduct scripted interviews and collect required information from callers.
  • Accurately enter caller-provided information into FEMA's Windows-compatible database or other FEMA-approved systems.
  • Complete required data entry and other call-agent work while the caller is on the telephone, except for limited after-call work permitted by the contract.
  • Perform Registration Intake (RI) duties when assigned.
  • Perform Basic Helpline (HL) duties when assigned, including assisting callers with questions concerning prior registrations.
  • Perform Transitional Sheltering Assistance (TSA) or other specialized lines of business when authorized and trained.
  • Conduct outbound calls when assigned.
  • Perform document review, document validation, or other specialized processing functions when assigned and trained.
  • Provide referrals to appropriate secondary support organizations and other disaster assistance providers.
  • Attend required pre-shift meetings and briefings and remain current on event-specific information, priorities, procedures, and policy changes.
  • Follow FEMA-approved scripts, job aids, Standard Operating Procedures, work instructions, and supervisor direction.
  • Maintain required availability and readiness to receive calls during assigned production periods.
  • Meet applicable customer service, quality, productivity, attendance, schedule-adherence, and call-handling standards.
  • Participate in quality monitoring, coaching, calibration, remedial training, and performance-improvement activities.
  • Immediately report system, security, privacy, technical, or operational issues through established CRI procedures.
  • Perform other related duties assigned in response to FEMA's level of support and the requirements of the applicable Call Order.

Security, Privacy, & Protection of Information:

  • Protect FEMA Personally Identifiable Information (PII), Sensitive but Unclassified (SBU) information, and other protected information always.
  • Access FEMA information only when authorized and when access is necessary to perform assigned duties.
  • Do not retain PII or other information from calls outside authorized FEMA systems and procedures.
  • Do not create or retain handwritten or electronic notes containing caller PII unless expressly authorized by the contract and applicable procedures.
  • Immediately destroy any permitted temporary notes in accordance with FEMA requirements.
  • Do not discuss or expose FEMA caller information to unauthorized persons.
  • Perform all work in an approved environment that satisfies FEMA/HSPD-12 security requirements.
  • Never handle FEMA calls from a public environment or another location where unauthorized persons may hear or access protected information.
  • Comply with all DHS, FEMA, CRI, HSPD-12, cybersecurity, privacy, and information-security requirements.
  • Immediately report suspected security incidents, unauthorized disclosure, lost equipment, improper access, or other security concerns.

Mandatory Eligibility & Security Requirements:

  • Must be a United States Citizen.
  • Lawful permanent resident are not eligible for this FEMA assignment.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Must successfully complete the FEMA-required background investigation and receive the required favorable adjudication before receiving access to protected FEMA information or systems.
    • Not in default on federal student loans.
    • Demonstrated financial responsibility.
    • No felony convictions within the past 7 years.
    • Misdemeanor convictions within the past 7 years may impact eligibility.
    • No non-medical collections totaling $7,500 or more.
  • Must satisfy applicable HSPD-12 and FEMA access requirements.
  • Must complete required DHS IT Security and Privacy Training.
  • Must complete all FEMA-required training applicable to the assigned line of business before performing production duties.
  • Must maintain required credentials and system access throughout the assignment.
  • Must comply with any additional security, suitability, background-investigation, or access requirements established by a specific FEMA Call Order.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • United States Citizenship.
  • At least 18 years of age.
  • Ability to read, write and speak English fluently.
  • Ability to communicate professionally and effectively with individuals by telephone.
  • Basic computer proficiency and demonstrated ability to work in a Microsoft Windows based environment.
  • Ability to accurately enter information while simultaneously communicating with a caller.
  • Ability to follow detailed scripts, instructions, policies and procedures.
  • Ability to learn and retain program-specific information and apply it accurately.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and safeguard sensitive information.
  • Ability to work effectively in a high-volume contact center environment.
  • Ability to remain calm, patient, tactful, and professional when assisting individuals who may be experiencing stressful circumstances.
  • Ability to successfully complete required background investigation, security, privacy, and FEMA training requirements.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous call center or contact center experience.
  • Previous customer service experience involving high-volume telephone contacts.
  • Experience with data entry or case-management systems.
  • Experience working with government programs, public benefits, emergency management, disaster assistance, or related services.
  • Experience following scripted interviews or structured data-collection processes.
  • Prior FEMA Registration Intake or Helpline experience.
  • Prior experience working in a secure environment involving PII or other sensitive information.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Excellent telephone communication and customer-service skills.Strong active listening and information-gathering skills.
  • Patience, tact, courtesy, empathy, and professionalism.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to navigate multiple computer applications while maintaining a customer conversation.
  • Ability to accurately interpret and apply written procedures.
  • Ability to learn and apply complex program requirements.
  • Ability to protect confidential and sensitive information.
  • Ability to accept coaching and apply quality-assurance feedback.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing disaster-event priorities, procedures, and workloads.

Performance Expectations:

  • Customer Service: Provide courteous, professional, empathetic, and accurate assistance.
  • Quality: Follow scripts and procedures and maintain required accuracy in customer interactions and data entry.
  • Productivity: Meet applicable production-hour, availability, call-handling, and productivity expectations.Schedule
  • Adherence: Report as scheduled and remain available and ready to accept assigned contacts.
  • Security: Maintain strict compliance with FEMA, DHS, HSPD-12, and CRI security and privacy requirements.
  • Training: Successfully complete all required training and demonstrate competency before performing assigned production duties.
  • Professional Conduct: Maintain professional conduct with callers, supervisors, coworkers, FEMA personnel, and other stakeholders.
  • Responsiveness: Promptly communicate operational, technical, security, or customer-service issues to CRI leadership.
  • Continuous Improvement: Participate constructively in quality reviews, coaching, calibration, and remedial training.

Work Environment and Remote Work Requirements:

  • Work may be performed at a CRI facility or from an authorized remote location when permitted by the applicable FEMA Call Order.
  • Remote employees must work from an approved location that satisfies FEMA security and privacy requirements.
  • Remote work requires a private work environment where unauthorized individuals cannot hear calls or view FEMA information.
  • Remote personnel must use CRI-approved equipment, systems, connectivity, and security controls.
  • Employees must not conduct FEMA calls from public locations, vehicles, restaurants, classrooms, malls, or other unauthorized environments.
  • The position requires prolonged periods of sitting, computer use, telephone communication, and headset use.
  • The operation may require shifts during evenings, weekends, holidays, and other extended operating periods based on FEMA demand and Call Order requirements.

The Public Affairs & Patient Advocacy Vaccines Lead supports the development and execution of Public Affairs & Patient Advocacy strategies, engages key stakeholders, and contributes to initiatives that improve awareness, access, and health outcomes. We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system — and innovative pipeline — enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.

Strategy Execution & Program Support

  • Track, analyze, and report Progress against defined objectives and KPIs, surfacing insights that inform strategy refinement

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build and maintain productive relationships with patient advocacy groups, medical societies, and public health organizations within an assigned portfolio

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Share stakeholder perspectives and emerging trends to enrich cross-functional planning

  • Support coordination of integrated stakeholder engagement efforts, ensuring activities are sequenced and connected across functions

Operational Excellence & Compliance

  • Ensure all activities adhere to corporate, legal, and regulatory standards with a high degree of accuracy and accountability

  • Apply strong project management skills to manage deliverables, timelines, and stakeholder communications

  • Identify and propose process improvements that increase efficiency and program quality

About You

Basic Qualifications

  • BA/BS in public health, scientific, policy, or related field; advanced degree preferred

  • 5–7 years of experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical, or public health sectors, of which 2+ years should be in Public Affairs, Patient Advocacy, or related roles

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting stakeholder engagement initiatives in a healthcare or public health context

  • Exposure to digital health tools or digital engagement strategies

  • Experience working in cross-functional, matrixed environments

  • Vaccines or public health experience preferred

Professional Skills

  • Strong collaboration and partnership skills

  • Foundational strategic thinking and learning agility

  • Execution excellence and attention to detail

  • Effective written and verbal communication

  • Curiosity, adaptability, and innovation mindset

Why Choose Us

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.

  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.

  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.

raw.description:
Real people. Real service.

At SupplyHouse.com, we value every individual team member and cultivate a community where people come first. Led by our core values of Generosity, Respect, Innovation, Teamwork, and GRIT, we’re dedicated to maintaining a supportive work environment that celebrates diversity and empowers everyone to reach their full potential. As an industry-leading e-commerce company specializing in HVAC, plumbing, heating, and electrical supplies since 2004, we strive to foster growth while providing the best possible experience for our customers.

Through an Employer of Record (EOR), we are looking for a new, remote QA Engineer in India to join our growing IT Team. This individual will report into our QA Team Lead and work closely with cross-functional partners to ensure our software adheres to established quality standards through web and mobile automated testing using Cypress and Appium.If you’re passionate about making a meaningful impact through software excellence and implementing innovative solutions, we’d love to hear from you!

Role Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote from India

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 4:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time / 12:00 p.m. – 9:00 p.m. Indian Standard Time to ensure effective collaboration

Base Salary: The expected starting salary for the position is $18,482 to $23,103USD within a full position range of $18,482 to $27,723 USD annually. This range reflects the long-term earning potential for the role. Our starting pay practice is the minimum to middle portion of the range, depending on experience, qualifications, and internal equity, consistent with applicable law and it is rare for a new hire to start above the midpoint.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, verify, and validate system test cases for web-based and mobile applications
  • Create and execute test plans, set up test environments, and understand + execute test scripts for database execution
  • Validate end-to-end functionality and enhancement requests
  • Resolve technical and business issues using strong analytical, troubleshooting, and debugging skills
  • Collaborate with leadership to implement effective testing solutions
  • Build cross-functional partnerships and collaborate with Developers, Project Managers, and UX Designers to solve complex challenges to maximize the customer experience

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field with 3+ years of QA engineering experience or no degree with 6+ years of equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of programming experience in Java, JavaScript, and SQL
  • 2+ years of web automation experience utilizing page object modeling (POM) including proficiency with Cypress
  • Experience in API testing, both automated and manual, for web, backend, and mobile applications using REST/RestAssured and Micro services
  • Familiarity with test automation tools such as MySQL, Postman, and Eclipse IDE
  • High-level proficiency of written and verbal communication in English

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in an e-commerce environment
  • 2+ years of mobile automation experience using Appium
    • Additional experience using WebDriver IO + Mocha + Chai is a plus
  • Web automation experience with Selenium and Cucumber
  • Experience using AI platforms to increase productivity (ex: Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, etc.)

Why work with us:

  • We have awesome benefits – We offer a wide variety of benefits to help support you and your loved ones. These include:
    • Comprehensive and affordable medical, dental, vision, and life insurance options
    • Competitive Provident Fund contributions
    • Paid casual and sick leave, plus country-specific holidays
    • Mental health support and wellbeing program
    • Company-provided equipment and one-time $250 USD work from home stipend
    • $750 USD annual professional development budget
    • Company rewards and recognition program
    • And more!
  • We empower ownership – We all contribute to our success and we all share in it. Our Ownership for All program ensures each SupplyHouse team member will benefit financially from the company’s growth and accomplishments.
  • We promote work-life balance – We value your time and encourage a healthy separation between your professional and personal life to feel refreshed and recharged. Look out for our 100% remote schedule and wellness initiatives!
  • We support growth – We strive to innovate every day. In an exciting and evolving industry, we provide potential for career growth through our hands-on training, access to the latest technologies and tools, diversity and inclusion initiatives, opportunities for internal mobility, and professional development budget.
  • We give back – We live and breathe our core value, Generosity, by giving back to the trades and organizations around the world. We make a difference through donation drives, employee-nominated contributions, support for DE&I organizations, and more.
  • We listen – We value hearing from our employees. Everyone has a voice, and we encourage you to use it! We actively elicit feedback through our monthly town halls, regular 1:1 check-ins, and company-wide ideas form to incorporate suggestions and ensure our team enjoys coming to work every day.

Check us out and learn more at !

Additional Details:

  • Remote employees are expected to work in a distraction-free environment. Personal devices, background noise, and other distractions should be kept to a minimum to avoid disrupting virtual meetings or business operations.
  • SupplyHouse.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer, strongly values inclusion, and encourages individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position.
  • To ensure fairness and trust in our hiring process, we ask that all application materials, assessments, and interview responses reflect your own thinking and perspective. You may use AI tools to assist in preparing your responses, as long as this use is clearly disclosed and you can speak authentically to your ideas and work. Our focus is on honesty, judgment, and how you approach problem-solving. We appreciate your transparency and look forward to learning more about your skills.
  • We are committed to providing a safe and secure work environment and conduct thorough background checks on all potential employees in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
  • All emails from the SupplyHouse team will only be sent from an @supplyhouse.com email address. Please exercise caution if you receive an email from an alternate domain.

What is an Employer of Record (EOR)?

Through our partnership with Remote.com, a global Employer of Record (EOR), you can join SupplyHouse from home, while knowing your employment is handled compliantly and securely. Remote takes care of the behind-the-scenes details – like payroll, benefits, taxes, and local compliance – so you can focus on your work and career growth. Even though Remote manages these administrative functions, you’ll be a part of the SupplyHouse team: connected to our culture, collaborating with colleagues, and contributing to our shared success. This partnership allows us to welcome talented team members worldwide while ensuring you receive a best-in-class employee experience.

raw.title: ICT/Telecom
raw.excerpt: TEECOM hires by discipline, not by open requisition.
raw.description:
TEECOM hires by discipline, not by open requisition. We are growing — multiple teams across the US, UK, and India are actively hiring to grow their teams.

When you apply here, you are applying to TEECOM for a role in ICT/Telecom. Rather than interviewing for a single posted role, you will go through a structured Discipline Assessment that establishes your level and demonstrated capability. Once your level is determined, TEECOM's recruiting and leadership teams match your profile to the best available opening on a team that fits your skills, experience, and goals.

Roles span Designer II through Principal, Senior Consultant. Your level — and your title — are determined by your assessment, not by the role you apply to.

If you have meaningful experience in more than one discipline, apply to your primary discipline and tell your recruiter about your secondary discipline(s) during your Introduction Call. You may be scheduled for a separate Discipline Assessment for each one.

ICT/Telecom at TEECOM

    TEECOM's ICT/Telecom practice designs and documents the telecommunications and structured cabling infrastructure that connects buildings, campuses, and organizations. Our clients span a wide and growing range of industries and facility types across the US, UK, and India.

    Work spans structured cabling systems (copper and fiber), outside plant infrastructure, distributed antenna systems (DAS), public safety radio coverage, passive optical networks, and other low-voltage communications infrastructure. ICT/Telecom designers at TEECOM work across the full project lifecycle — from concept design and basis of design through construction documents, specifications, and construction administration. You will collaborate with architects, MEP engineers, IT teams, and construction managers to deliver coordinated, buildable technology infrastructure drawings.

    At more senior levels, you will lead design decisions, mentor junior staff, manage client relationships, and help grow TEECOM's ICT/Telecom practice.

What We're Looking For

    We hire at all levels — the strongest ICT/Telecom candidates are proactive, curious about how infrastructure actually gets built, and take ownership of producing documents that contractors can follow without guessing.

    If you don’t have everything on this list yet, that’s expected — TEECOM develops people through structured documentation, mentorship, and real project work.

    • Experience designing structured cabling systems (copper and fiber) across a range of facility types and industries
    • Familiarity with BICSI standards, TIA/EIA cabling standards, and applicable low-voltage code requirements (NFPA 70, local codes)
    • Ability to read and produce construction documents — floor plans, riser diagrams, details, and specification sections
    • Experience with Revit and/or AutoCAD for technology systems documentation
    • Understanding of outside plant infrastructure, including conduit routing, manholes, and fiber optic systems — preferred
    • Experience with DAS design or public safety radio systems (NFPA 72, IFC) — preferred
    • BICSI RCDD (Registered Communications Distribution Designer) certification — preferred
    • PE license (electrical preferred) — preferred
    • Ability to manage your own work independently across multiple concurrent projects

      • *TEECOM covers exam fees and study materials for certifications relevant to your discipline, pays a one-time bonus when you pass, and funds all continuing education — including conference attendance.

TEECOM is a fully remote consulting firm. We hire across all US states, the UK, and India. Our projects span the globe — some roles involve international travel, so share your comfort level with your recruiter.

If you're ready to be assessed on your own merits and matched to the right team, apply here. If you have questions about the process, contact recruiting directly.

raw.excerpt: Are you ready to be a technology leader in the SaaS space?
raw.description:
Are you ready to be a technology leader in the SaaS space? Join epilot!

We are looking for product minded engineers not only coders. We're seeking builders who bridge technical expertise with product strategy. If you're passionate about impactful software, apply now! (Learn more about our understanding of being a product engineer here)

epilot is building a SaaS product to sell complex products online, focusing on solving ecommerce in the rapidly transforming energy market. Our mission: Make selling complex energy products as easy as selling a pair of shoes online.

As Software Engineer at epilot you will be a driving force in shaping this mission. What makes working as a Software Engineer at epilot so special? Our unique engineering culture is defined by a few core engineering principles.

We "epilots" are a team of experts from the fields of software development, energy management, product management and sales. In order to bring our solution even faster to the top in the energy world, we are looking for you as a Senior Product Engineer (Full Stack).

Requirements

What awaits you

As a Product Engineer at epilot, you’ll go beyond just coding. You’ll play an integral role in building our cutting-edge platform using technologies like TypeScript, React, Svelte, and serverless AWS microservices. Here’s what you’ll do:

  • Immerse yourself in our tech stack: Microfrontends, serverless AWS, and best-in-class developer tooling and automation. Learn more here:

  • Be part of a cross-functional dream team: Collaborate with full-stack, backend, and frontend developers, designers, and product managers to deliver impactful features.

  • Work end-to-end: From ideation to delivery, you’ll team up with product management and design to bring features to life and make product decisions.

  • Take ownership: Got an idea? Draft an RFC (Request for Comment), drive the initiative, and own it from start to finish.

  • Foster growth: Mentor colleagues, share knowledge, and continuously learn new technologies.

  • Innovate with agility: Participate in diverse, exciting development projects, leveraging pair programming and agile methodologies.

What you bring

We’re looking for a Product-Minded Engineer who resonates with our values and has the following skills and mindset:

  • Product Thinking: You care about delivering value to customers and users, not just writing code.

  • Technical Expertise:

    • Hands-on experience with React or other JavaScript frameworks.

    • Knowledge of RESTful APIs or GraphQL.

    • Familiarity with microservices architecture and public/private cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).

    • Basic understanding of application and cloud security principles, and how to build secure, reliable software.

  • Ownership Mentality: You take initiative, drive features to completion, and thrive on responsibility.

  • Entrepreneurial Spirit: You think like a business owner, understanding how your work impacts our goals.

  • Problem-Solver: You see challenges as opportunities for growth.

  • Collaborative Mindset: You’re a true team player who motivates and inspires those around you.

  • Agile Know-How: You’re familiar with methodologies like Scrum, Kanban, or XP and understand how to apply them effectively.

What we offer you

At epilot, we believe in rewarding performance, fostering growth, and creating an environment where you’ll thrive:

  • Impactful Work: Be part of a product-driven company that’s reshaping the energy sector.

  • Startup Mentality: Enjoy a dynamic atmosphere with flat hierarchies and open communication.

  • Flexibility: Work remotely or from our centrally located office in Cologne, with flexible working hours.

  • Growth Opportunities: Your career will grow as fast as we do. Learn, experiment, and embrace a “Fail Fast and Often” mentality.

  • Competitive Compensation: We take your desired salary seriously and value performance.

  • Team Spirit: Join us for regular events like summer parties, company breakfasts, and our epic annual epilot summit, where you’ll connect with co-epilots worldwide.

  • Transparency and Openness: Everything is open for discussion in our inclusive and supportive culture.

What to/we expect in your first 180days

-read full version: here-

By Week 1 you will:

  • Pair with a colleague and ship something. Small is fine, working is the point

  • Start learning the business: who our customers are, what we're building toward, why it matters

  • Connect with the team and empower the team

By Month 1 you will:

  • Own a topic: have your name on a topic, be the main driver of that topic from refinement to delivery. Already shipping the first iteration of it

  • Have a good understanding of the codebase and how our services connect

  • Know enough about our customers and domain to push back on bad ideas, including ours

By Month 3-6 you will:

  • Be the undisputed owner of your domain: the go-to person, the one who spots problems before they're reported and fixes them before they're assigned

  • Have shipped something that visibly moved a metric: adoption, reliability, performance, or revenue

  • Operate fully autonomously. You know when to decide and when to align

  • Raise the bar for the people around you, you push us forward, you are a multiplier. Not just through your own work, but through your reviews, your feedback, and how you onboard whoever we hire after you

We welcome applications from all backgrounds regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, disability, or sexual orientation!

Check out our promise to you: promise.epilot.cloud

P.S.: If you want to learn more about the application process, please read Eka's blog article: How to get hired at epilot

raw.title: ICT/Telecom
raw.excerpt: TEECOM hires by discipline, not by open requisition.
raw.description:
TEECOM hires by discipline, not by open requisition. We are growing — multiple teams across the US, UK, and India are actively hiring to grow their teams.

When you apply here, you are applying to TEECOM for a role in ICT/Telecom. Rather than interviewing for a single posted role, you will go through a structured Discipline Assessment that establishes your level and demonstrated capability. Once your level is determined, TEECOM's recruiting and leadership teams match your profile to the best available opening on a team that fits your skills, experience, and goals.

Roles span Designer II through Principal, Senior Consultant. Your level — and your title — are determined by your assessment, not by the role you apply to.

If you have meaningful experience in more than one discipline, apply to your primary discipline and tell your recruiter about your secondary discipline(s) during your Introduction Call. You may be scheduled for a separate Discipline Assessment for each one.

ICT/Telecom at TEECOM

    TEECOM's ICT/Telecom practice designs and documents the telecommunications and structured cabling infrastructure that connects buildings, campuses, and organizations. Our clients span a wide and growing range of industries and facility types across the US, UK, and India.

    Work spans structured cabling systems (copper and fiber), outside plant infrastructure, distributed antenna systems (DAS), public safety radio coverage, passive optical networks, and other low-voltage communications infrastructure. ICT/Telecom designers at TEECOM work across the full project lifecycle — from concept design and basis of design through construction documents, specifications, and construction administration. You will collaborate with architects, MEP engineers, IT teams, and construction managers to deliver coordinated, buildable technology infrastructure drawings.

    At more senior levels, you will lead design decisions, mentor junior staff, manage client relationships, and help grow TEECOM's ICT/Telecom practice.

What We're Looking For

    We hire at all levels — the strongest ICT/Telecom candidates are proactive, curious about how infrastructure actually gets built, and take ownership of producing documents that contractors can follow without guessing.

    If you don’t have everything on this list yet, that’s expected — TEECOM develops people through structured documentation, mentorship, and real project work.

    • Experience designing structured cabling systems (copper and fiber) across a range of facility types and industries
    • Familiarity with BICSI standards, TIA/EIA cabling standards, and applicable low-voltage code requirements (NFPA 70, local codes)
    • Ability to read and produce construction documents — floor plans, riser diagrams, details, and specification sections
    • Experience with Revit and/or AutoCAD for technology systems documentation
    • Understanding of outside plant infrastructure, including conduit routing, manholes, and fiber optic systems — preferred
    • Experience with DAS design or public safety radio systems (NFPA 72, IFC) — preferred
    • BICSI RCDD (Registered Communications Distribution Designer) certification — preferred
    • PE license (electrical preferred) — preferred
    • Ability to manage your own work independently across multiple concurrent projects

      • *TEECOM covers exam fees and study materials for certifications relevant to your discipline, pays a one-time bonus when you pass, and funds all continuing education — including conference attendance.

TEECOM is a fully remote consulting firm. We hire across all US states, the UK, and India. Our projects span the globe — some roles involve international travel, so share your comfort level with your recruiter.

If you're ready to be assessed on your own merits and matched to the right team, apply here. If you have questions about the process, contact recruiting directly.

raw.description:
Are you ready to be a technology leader in the SaaS space? Join epilot!

We are looking for product minded engineers not only coders. We're seeking builders who bridge technical expertise with product strategy. If you're passionate about impactful software, apply now! (Learn more about our understanding of being a product engineer here)

epilot is building a SaaS product to sell complex products online, focusing on solving ecommerce in the rapidly transforming energy market. Our mission: Make selling complex energy products as easy as selling a pair of shoes online.

As Software Engineer at epilot you will be a driving force in shaping this mission. What makes working as a Software Engineer at epilot so special? Our unique engineering culture is defined by a few core engineering principles.

We "epilots" are a team of experts from the fields of software development, energy management, product management and sales. In order to bring our solution even faster to the top in the energy world, we are looking for you as a Senior Product Engineer (Full Stack).

Requirements

What awaits you

As a Product Engineer at epilot, you’ll go beyond just coding. You’ll play an integral role in building our cutting-edge platform using technologies like TypeScript, React, Svelte, and serverless AWS microservices. Here’s what you’ll do:

  • Immerse yourself in our tech stack: Microfrontends, serverless AWS, and best-in-class developer tooling and automation. Learn more here:

  • Be part of a cross-functional dream team: Collaborate with full-stack, backend, and frontend developers, designers, and product managers to deliver impactful features.

  • Work end-to-end: From ideation to delivery, you’ll team up with product management and design to bring features to life and make product decisions.

  • Take ownership: Got an idea? Draft an RFC (Request for Comment), drive the initiative, and own it from start to finish.

  • Foster growth: Mentor colleagues, share knowledge, and continuously learn new technologies.

  • Innovate with agility: Participate in diverse, exciting development projects, leveraging pair programming and agile methodologies.

What you bring

We’re looking for a Product-Minded Engineer who resonates with our values and has the following skills and mindset:

  • Product Thinking: You care about delivering value to customers and users, not just writing code.

  • Technical Expertise:

    • Hands-on experience with React or other JavaScript frameworks.

    • Knowledge of RESTful APIs or GraphQL.

    • Familiarity with microservices architecture and public/private cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).

    • Basic understanding of application and cloud security principles, and how to build secure, reliable software.

  • Ownership Mentality: You take initiative, drive features to completion, and thrive on responsibility.

  • Entrepreneurial Spirit: You think like a business owner, understanding how your work impacts our goals.

  • Problem-Solver: You see challenges as opportunities for growth.

  • Collaborative Mindset: You’re a true team player who motivates and inspires those around you.

  • Agile Know-How: You’re familiar with methodologies like Scrum, Kanban, or XP and understand how to apply them effectively.

What we offer you

At epilot, we believe in rewarding performance, fostering growth, and creating an environment where you’ll thrive:

  • Impactful Work: Be part of a product-driven company that’s reshaping the energy sector.

  • Startup Mentality: Enjoy a dynamic atmosphere with flat hierarchies and open communication.

  • Flexibility: Work remotely or from our centrally located office in Cologne, with flexible working hours.

  • Growth Opportunities: Your career will grow as fast as we do. Learn, experiment, and embrace a “Fail Fast and Often” mentality.

  • Competitive Compensation: We take your desired salary seriously and value performance.

  • Team Spirit: Join us for regular events like summer parties, company breakfasts, and our epic annual epilot summit, where you’ll connect with co-epilots worldwide.

  • Transparency and Openness: Everything is open for discussion in our inclusive and supportive culture.

What to/we expect in your first 180days

-read full version: here-

By Week 1 you will:

  • Pair with a colleague and ship something. Small is fine, working is the point

  • Start learning the business: who our customers are, what we're building toward, why it matters

  • Connect with the team and empower the team

By Month 1 you will:

  • Own a topic: have your name on a topic, be the main driver of that topic from refinement to delivery. Already shipping the first iteration of it

  • Have a good understanding of the codebase and how our services connect

  • Know enough about our customers and domain to push back on bad ideas, including ours

By Month 3-6 you will:

  • Be the undisputed owner of your domain: the go-to person, the one who spots problems before they're reported and fixes them before they're assigned

  • Have shipped something that visibly moved a metric: adoption, reliability, performance, or revenue

  • Operate fully autonomously. You know when to decide and when to align

  • Raise the bar for the people around you, you push us forward, you are a multiplier. Not just through your own work, but through your reviews, your feedback, and how you onboard whoever we hire after you

We welcome applications from all backgrounds regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, disability, or sexual orientation!

Check out our promise to you: promise.epilot.cloud

P.S.: If you want to learn more about the application process, please read Eka's blog article: How to get hired at epilot

raw.description:
Department: Sales

Reporting to: UK Pod Lead

Employment type: Full-time

Salary: £40,000-£45,000; OTE up to £105,000

Location: Remote, UK-based, with monthly London meetups and regular periods working from China of up to 3 weeks at a time

Languages: Fluent Mandarin and professional-level English

About Gocertify

Gocertify is a bootstrapped UK tech start-up helping brands run smarter, more targeted reward campaigns.

We verify eligible audiences such as students, key workers and seniors, so brands can move away from broad discounting, protect brand value and offer the right rewards to the right customers.

We are trusted by 500+ brands, including Samsung, Sainsbury's and FARFETCH. We work with 2m+ shoppers a year, drive £125m+ in retail sales, and have grown profitably and bootstrapped since 2020.

We are a team of around 20 people, working remotely with monthly meetups in London.

Why this role exists

China is becoming an increasingly important market for Gocertify. We are already seeing strong opportunities with over 50 Chinese consumer brands looking to grow in the UK and other international markets, and now want someone focused on developing that market full-time.

Some of our strongest progress has come through events, introductions and face-to-face relationships in China. We now want to turn that early traction into a more consistent commercial channel.

Role and scope

This is a hands-on commercial role focused on building Gocertify's presence with Chinese brands.

You'll own the China new-business pipeline from identifying the right brands and opening conversations through to demo, negotiation and close. A big part of the role is building relationships directly with Chinese businesses, both remotely and during regular time in China.

You'll stay close to new partners through launch where your Mandarin, market knowledge or existing relationship helps, before Client Success takes over the ongoing relationship.

This isn't a mature territory with a fixed playbook. You'll build your own pipeline, win Chinese brands and help us work out the most effective way to grow Gocertify in China.

As our first full-time commercial hire focused on China, you'll also help shape how we approach the market as we learn what works.

What you will focus on

1. Build a pipeline of Chinese brands

You will work on

  • Building and prioritising a target list of Chinese consumer brands with strong UK or international growth potential
  • Creating new opportunities through outbound, WeChat, LinkedIn, email, events, introductions and relevant partner networks
  • Finding and building relationships with the right contacts
  • Using time in China to meet priority brands in person, attend relevant industry events and develop relationships that are harder to build remotely
  • Testing which brands, messages and channels generate the strongest opportunities and adjusting your approach based on what works

2. Own and close new business

You will work on

  • Owning opportunities from first conversation through discovery, demo, negotiation and close
  • Understanding how prospective brands are approaching international growth, customer acquisition and promotions
  • Demoing Gocertify in Mandarin and English and tailoring the commercial case to what the brand is trying to achieve
  • Managing multiple stakeholders and keeping opportunities moving through clear next steps and consistent follow-up
  • Negotiating commercial terms and maintaining accurate pipeline and forecast information

3. Help build a stronger China go-to-market

You will work on

  • Sharing what you are learning about Chinese brands, buying processes, objections and competitors
  • Improving how we position and sell Gocertify in the Chinese market
  • Building useful Mandarin-language sales materials, case studies and other assets where they will help opportunities progress
  • Identifying which events, networks, partners and routes into the market are producing the strongest results
  • Turning what works into a more repeatable approach as our China business grows

4. Support new partners through launch

You will work on

  • Coordinating a clear handover into Client Success once a new partnership is agreed
  • Staying involved through onboarding where your Mandarin, market knowledge or relationship with the partner helps move things forward
  • Supporting clear communication around onboarding and implementation requirements
  • Creating or adapting Mandarin-language onboarding materials where useful
  • Feeding recurring questions or onboarding friction back into the wider team so we can improve the experience for future Chinese partners

Requirements

  • Fluent Mandarin and professional-level English
  • Experience in B2B sales, business development or partnerships
  • Evidence of creating opportunities yourself through outbound, networking, introductions or account research
  • Experience progressing commercial opportunities through discovery, demo, negotiation and close
  • Confidence running product demonstrations and commercial conversations with prospective clients
  • Experience building relationships with Chinese businesses and a strong understanding of how commercial relationships are developed in China
  • Strong pipeline management, with clear follow-up, prioritisation and forecasting
  • Comfort managing your own territory or pipeline with a high level of independence
  • Experience using different routes to create opportunities, including digital outreach, networking and face-to-face relationship building

Experience in ecommerce, retail, affiliate/performance marketing, SaaS, loyalty or related technology would help you get up to speed more quickly, but we do not require it.

Who will thrive in this role

This role will suit someone who is comfortable operating between two markets and can combine strong relationship-building with commercial discipline.

  • You can bridge different ways of doing business. You'll often be the person closest to the Chinese market, so you'll need to understand what a prospect is really telling you and help the UK team understand the context behind it. Equally, you can explain Gocertify's approach in a way that makes sense to a Chinese partner, without simply translating a UK sales pitch word for word.
  • You balance adaptability with commercial discipline. You'll need to adjust how you communicate and build relationships depending on the brand and situation, while still qualifying opportunities properly, maintaining momentum and being clear about what it will take to get a deal done.
  • You're comfortable being the person closest to the market. There won't always be someone else internally who knows the answer about how a Chinese prospect, event or route to market works. You'll be expected to form a view, bring the right context back to the team and help us make sensible decisions from it.

How we work

  • Fully remote (UK-based) with monthly in-person meetings in London.
  • Core working hours: 10am-4pm UK time with flexible remote work.
    • When working from the UK, you'll work 6am-2pm up to three days a week to overlap with the Chinese working day.
  • Regular travel to China, typically in trips of up to 3 weeks and totalling around 3 months across the year.

Benefits

  • 25 days annual leave + UK bank holidays
  • Private health insurance with AVIVA, including optical and dental cashback and the option to self-fund partners/dependents
  • EMI share options
  • Work-from-home budget
  • Flexible remote work in many countries around our core hours, 10am-4pm UK
  • Unlimited access to coworking spaces in 48+ countries through Hubble
  • Access to incredible Gocertify offers

Start Date: November 2026 onward, with staggered start dates

About the Opportunity

Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of a global enterprise cybersecurity company building a new generation of products to secure AI agents, LLM-powered applications, and the data they access.

The engineering organization is scaling rapidly in India, with multiple Backend Engineer openings across several product workstreams.

Depending on your experience and interests, you may join one of the following areas:

  • Agentic Security: Real-time policy enforcement for AI agent actions, tool calls, and data access.
  • AI Security Gateway: High-performance proxy between enterprise applications and LLM providers, covering inline inspection, DLP, rate limiting, and streaming.
  • Platform: Shared multi-tenant foundations including identity/RBAC, configuration, event streaming, storage, and internal APIs.
  • Data Security Integration: Event-driven integrations between AI security products and existing data security infrastructure.
  • Cloud Discovery: Services that discover AI agents, model endpoints, and AI-enabled applications across AWS, Azure, and GCP, and map their access.
  • Agentic AI Forensics: Ingestion, indexing, and querying of agent traces and security events for investigation and analysis.
  • AI Risk Research: Tooling and testing harnesses that enable security researchers to identify and validate attacks against AI agents.

Across all workstreams, the core stack includes Go, Python, gRPC/REST, event streaming, Kubernetes, and major cloud platforms. AI-assisted development is also a core part of the engineering workflow.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and operate production Go services with high standards for performance, reliability, and multi-tenancy.
  • Design APIs and data models, owning service contracts, idempotency, retries, and back-pressure.
  • Build event-driven pipelines and integrations with cloud providers, internal systems, or AI/agent frameworks.
  • Own service reliability through testing, observability, CI/CD, and production readiness.
  • Use Python for tooling, testing, migrations, automation, or data workflows.
  • Collaborate with AI engineers, security researchers, and product teams on threat models and enforcement logic.
  • Use AI coding assistants as part of your daily development, testing, and debugging workflow.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional backend engineering experience, including 2+ years building production services in Go. Senior roles require 6+ years overall and 3+ years in Go.
  • Strong understanding of Go concurrency, networking, and performance, including goroutines, channels, context, and profiling.
  • Working knowledge of Python.
  • Experience designing gRPC and REST APIs, working with protobuf, and building asynchronous/event-driven systems such as Kafka or equivalent.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider: AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases in distributed systems.
  • Strong testing discipline and attention to data correctness.
  • Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable using modern AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or similar. This is a must-have.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership in a remote-first, distributed environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with API gateways, proxies, policy/authorization engines such as OPA or Cedar, or service meshes.
  • Deep knowledge of a major cloud provider's APIs and IAM model.
  • Experience with Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, ClickHouse, or other search/indexing and columnar data systems at scale.
  • Familiarity with LLM agent frameworks, tool-calling protocols, and AI/agent security.
  • Experience building multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
  • Background in cybersecurity, security tooling, or trust & safety.
  • Experience introducing AI-assisted or agentic development workflows across engineering teams.

AI-First Engineering

AI is a core part of how this team builds software.

During the interview process, you'll be asked about how you use AI in real-world engineering: the tools you rely on, how you validate their output, and how AI has changed your development workflow.

We're looking for engineers who use AI as a force multiplier for quality, productivity, and problem-solving, not simply as an autocomplete tool.

Why Join

  • Build a greenfield product at the intersection of cybersecurity and agentic AI.
  • Work on Go services operating at enterprise scale and protecting some of the world's largest organizations.
  • Take ownership of a product workstream and influence architecture from an early stage.
  • Work alongside a highly technical, distributed engineering team where AI is a core part of the development process.

Pragmatike is committed to a fair, transparent, and inclusive recruitment process. We do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

In accordance with GDPR, your personal data will be processed lawfully, fairly, and securely and used solely for recruitment purposes, including sharing it with our client(s) for employment consideration.

raw.description:
About You
You are a Business Architect who bridges finance and engineering, translating a complex subscription billing model into data requirements that the integration team can act on. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity across business and technical domains. You'll guide stakeholders through the transformation from a legacy accounting system to Zuora, interpreting Zuora's data model and billing logic well enough to unblock the technical team, while also maintaining stakeholder communication and technical continuity during a planned handover period. This role does not carry project management, Zuora platform administration, or change management authority, as those responsibilities remain within the team.

Note: This position is offered under a part-time contractor model.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field is desired, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Proven experience in business analysis, including requirements gathering, process mapping, and gap analysis.
  • Strong subscription and billing domain knowledge, covering recurring revenue, invoicing, and the payment lifecycle.
  • Data literacy, with the ability to read pipeline logic, validate data flows, and QA outputs.
  • Stakeholder facilitation skills, running workshops, producing decision docs, and framing trade-offs for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Prior ERP or accounting system migration or transformation experience.
  • Ability to ramp up independently, learning a new billing platform's data model and business context with minimal oversight.
  • Advanced Conversational English. Executive facing communication skills, with fluency sufficient to work directly with a US based controller and finance team.

Nice to haves:

  • Zuora platform familiarity across billing, revenue, and CPQ modules.
  • GCP ecosystem awareness, including BigQuery, Looker, and Data Studio.
  • Familiarity with change management frameworks such as ADKAR or Kotter.
  • A Zuora Certified Administrator or Revenue Analyst certification.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Translate the billing model in Zuora into data requirements the integration team can act on.
  • Lead business analysis for the portion of scope that Zuora's professional services doesn't cover, including custom billing rules, revenue recognition, and reporting.
  • Guide finance and business stakeholders through the transformation from a legacy accounting system to Zuora, providing clear transformation guidance at each step.
  • Interpret Zuora's data model and billing logic to unblock the integration team, acting as a partial platform advisor rather than a full platform administrator.
  • Facilitate decisions and trade-off conversations directly with the controller and finance stakeholders.
  • Maintain stakeholder communication and technical context continuity during a planned handover or coverage period.
  • Proven business analysis experience across finance and technical domains, including requirements gathering, process mapping, and gap analysis.
  • Strong subscription and billing domain expertise, covering recurring revenue, invoicing, and payment lifecycle.
  • Data literacy, comfortable reading pipeline logic and validating data flows and outputs.
  • Prior ERP or accounting system migration or transformation experience.
  • Advanced English fluency for direct, executive level collaboration with a US based finance team.

About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

raw.title: Mid-Level Software Engineer
raw.excerpt: At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies.
raw.description:
At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

About the role

As a Mid-level Software Engineer at Ledgy, you’ll build reliable, scalable product experiences that help companies manage their equity with confidence. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to turn complex equity workflows into clear, automated, user-friendly software.

This role is a strong fit if you’re ready to take ownership of well-scoped projects, grow your technical judgement, and contribute across the stack while learning from senior peers.

Location: We hire remotely across the UK, Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania. For candidates based in London, we use a hybrid model with 2 days in the office per week.

Teams we are hiring for:

  • Core Equity — Owns the foundational logic that powers Ledgy’s equity engine. Every equity-related event — such as issuing shares, creating new pools, or adjusting ownership — generates transactions. This team defines and maintains the transaction logic, data model, and core domain behaviour that ensure Ledgy’s platform remains accurate, scalable, and compliant. They also enable employees to sell their shares seamlessly once vested.
  • Workflows & Automation — Focuses on automating complex equity workflows and integrating with third-party services, including the trading exchange. The team builds systems that help company admins efficiently onboard and offboard employees, automate equity grants and terminations.
  • Reporting — Transforms Ledgy’s core equity data into financial, operational, and compliance reports. The team manages large, complex datasets and ensures reporting is accurate, performant, and reliable across jurisdictions and company structures. Their work powers the insights companies and auditors rely on for decision-making and transparency.
  • Tax — Ensures taxes are correctly reflected throughout equity operations, especially moments such as exercising, selling, mobility, and other taxable events. As a future team, Tax will build end-to-end product capabilities across the stack, helping customers manage complex tax and compliance requirements accurately across jurisdictions.

You will thrive in the role if you

  • You have 3+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer
  • You are comfortable building and shipping production-quality features across the stack
  • You enjoy learning complex domains and turning them into simple, maintainable product experiences
  • You care about clean, tested, readable code and thoughtful collaboration
  • You are curious about equity, financial workflows, and their real-world impact on companies and employees
  • You’re excited to grow your technical judgement through code reviews, pairing, and architecture discussions
  • You take ownership of your work while asking for input early when trade-offs are unclear

Our Tech Stack*:

We have a modern, cohesive stack that lets us move fast while maintaining quality:

  • Language: TypeScript
  • Frontend: React, Tailwind CSS, tRPC
  • Backend: tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, Temporal
  • Infrastructure: GCP, Terraform Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions

*We don’t expect proficiency in this specific stack

What Your Journey Could Look Like

First 30 days:

  • Be paired with an onboarding buddy who will introduce you to the world of equity management
  • Get to know your engineering team, product managers, and designers
  • Learn how your team’s domain connects to the broader Ledgy platform
  • Set up your development environment and start contributing small, well-scoped changes
  • Build familiarity with our codebase, product workflows, and engineering practices

First 3 months:

  • Ship product features and improvements with increasing independence
  • Work with teammates to break down problems, understand trade-offs, and deliver reliable solutions
  • Participate actively in code reviews and team discussions
  • Develop a deeper understanding of how companies manage and automate equity
  • Contribute to improving quality, maintainability, and user experience in your team’s domain

First 6–12 months:

  • Own medium-sized features from implementation through release
  • Collaborate with Product and Design to shape pragmatic, user-centric solutions
  • Contribute to technical discussions around data models, workflows, and scalability
  • Continue growing toward senior-level ownership, judgement, and impact

The interview process:

  • Getting to know you (45 min): Meet with someone from our people team to talk about your experience and to ask questions about the role
  • Live Coding (60 min): An equity domain problem to solve collaboratively using your preferred language and IDE. We want to see how you think, so this step does not allow AI. But you can freely look up syntax questions if you need to.
  • System Design (60 min): A system design session focused on practical problem-solving, clear trade-offs, and how you structure technical thinking
  • Case Study (60 min): Collaborate with a product manager and engineer to explore a problem related to Ledgy’s domain. Focus is on understanding requirements, product thinking, and implementation trade-offs.
  • Culture Interview: A chance to meet one of our founders and your hiring manager for a 30-minute chat about Ledgy’s mission and values
  • Offer 🎉

Being part of Ledgy means:

  • Recharge and re-energize with flexible working hours, 25 days of vacation, and up to 40 days of remote work from outside your home country.
  • We make space for your own professional development, with a generous yearly learning & development budget.
  • This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. All salaries are aligned with competitively benchmarked ranges based on work location and levelling.
  • For candidates based in London or Zurich we use a hybrid work model of 2 days in the office per week.

  • Business Resource Groups (BRGs) – BRGs facilitate inclusion and collaboration across our business internally and throughout the communities where we live, work and play. BRGs are open to all.

$144,900.00 - $210,075.00

Equal opportunity employer • Drug-free workplace

OCI Solutions Architect - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: OCI Solutions Architect
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Engineer to architect, deploy, and operate large-scale, secure, and resilient cloud environments on Oracle’s next-generation public cloud. In this role you will own the full OCI engineering lifecycle, from landing-zone design and infrastructure-as-code, through workload migration and ongoing operations, including cost optimization and observability. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical knowledge of OCI services with strong DevOps and automation fundamentals, and will partner with database, application, and security teams to deliver well-engineered cloud platforms that support mission-critical Oracle and non-Oracle workloads.

Key Responsibilities
  • Architect, deploy, and operate enterprise-grade OCI landing zones, compartments, and tenancy structures aligned with internal governance and compliance standards.
  • Design and implement OCI networking topologies, including VCNs, subnets, gateways, FastConnect, IPSec VPN, and DRG-based hub-and-spoke architectures.
  • Build and maintain OCI infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and OCI Resource Manager, with version control, peer review, and automated validation.
  • Implement IAM policies, federation with corporate identity providers, and strong RBAC patterns using OCI Identity Domains.
  • Design and operate OCI compute (VMs, bare-metal, OKE for Kubernetes) and storage services (Object, Block, File, Archive) optimized for workload patterns.
  • Operate OCI database services, including Autonomous Database, Exadata Cloud, MySQL HeatWave, and Base Database, in close partnership with DBA teams.
  • Build CI/CD pipelines on OCI DevOps service or external platforms (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) for both infrastructure and applications.
  • Implement observability using OCI Monitoring, Logging, APM, and integrations with third-party observability stacks.
  • Drive ongoing cost optimization through right-sizing, lifecycle management, and architectural simplification.
  • Design disaster-recovery and business-continuity solutions across OCI regions and availability domains.
  • Strengthen security posture using OCI Cloud Guard, Security Zones, Vault, and Data Safe, and lead remediation of findings.
  • Advise application development teams on OCI-native design patterns and best practices.
  • Develop automation tooling in Python, Bash, and Terraform to reduce operational toil.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to internal cloud communities of practice.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of cloud engineering experience, with strong hands-on time on OCI.
  • Production-level experience with infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
  • Solid experience with OCI compute, networking, storage, identity, and database services.
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle Container Engine for Kubernetes (OKE).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for cloud workloads.
  • Strong scripting skills in Python and Bash.
  • Deep understanding of cloud security, IAM, and compliance requirements.
  • Experience with observability tooling and incident response.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional certification.
  • Experience operating Oracle Exadata Cloud or Autonomous Database at scale.
  • Exposure to multi-cloud architectures spanning OCI and AWS/Azure/GCP.
  • Familiarity with FinOps practices on OCI.
  • Experience operating regulated workloads on OCI.
How to Apply
