raw.description:
Position Summary

The Logistics Coordinator will manage retailer purchase orders and coordinate shipment preparation, documentation, tracking, and fulfillment, with a primary focus on Walmart. The role will maintain accurate order records, support retailer compliance and claims resolution, and coordinate with production, shipping, warehouse, and operations teams. Following initial client-led training, the role will report to the Operations Manager and Director of Operations.

Job Details:

  • Work Setup: Work from home
  • Shift/Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM U.S. Central Time | 9:00 PM - 6:00 AM Manila Time
  • Holidays: Follow the client's holiday calendar, to be provided

Responsibilities:

  • Manage the retail order desk by retrieving, reviewing, and processing retailer purchase orders (POs), including Walmart POs.
  • Access retailer portals and EDI platforms, including Walmart Retail Link, to manage orders and maintain product information.
  • Enter and update PO, shipment, and delivery details in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and internal order-management records.
  • Set up shipments in Walmart's transportation system, review assigned shipment information, and create and maintain shipment tickets.
  • Prepare Bills of Lading (BOLs), retailer-compliant shipping and pallet labels, ASN labels/stickers, and other required shipping documentation.
  • Upload complete shipment documentation to Google Drive and email the production team with the files needed for printing and shipment preparation.
  • Check that products and shipments meet retailer-specific labeling, pallet, ASN, routing, and compliance requirements.
  • Coordinate retailer routing requirements and communicate appointment information to the internal team. This role does not directly schedule appointments; appointment decisions and approvals remain with the internal team.
  • Track shipment and delivery status, obtain Proofs of Delivery (PODs), and maintain accurate PO, shipment, BOL, and delivery records.
  • Monitor retailer claims and discrepancies, research supporting shipment records, and file and process claims for shipments or products reported as missing or not received.
  • Identify potential On-Time In-Full (OTIF) and retailer compliance issues and proactively communicate them to the appropriate internal teams.
  • Check retailer inventory information and store-level product stock when required.
  • Use Walmart Scintilla as the source of truth for U.S. supplier performance, including in-store sales and online pickup/delivery performance.
  • Support reporting and analysis on retailer sales, inventory, fulfillment, and compliance using retailer reporting systems and internal records.
  • Coordinate proactively with production, shipping, warehouse, and operations teams to resolve order issues and support timely fulfillment.

Responsibilities

Search Analytics & Insights → Analyze large-scale e-commerce search data to identify trends and improvement opportunities across search, ranking, recommendations, and personalization

Query & Ranking Analysis → Investigate search behavior, including zero results, query reformulation, abandonment, position bias, CTR, and relevance versus business trade-offs

KPI Measurement & Experimentation → Define and interpret search KPIs and rigorously evaluate online experiments across ranking, personalization, recommendations, and hybrid or vector search

Data & Metrics Development → Build end-to-end metrics layers using event-level data and server-side search logs, from raw tracking data to clear datasets and visualizations

Cross-Functional Analytical Leadership → Lead analytical initiatives and collaborate with Product, Data Science, MLOps, and ML/Search Engineering teams to improve product and business outcomes

Must Have

  • Strong hands-on skills in SQL and Python, particularly Pandas, supported by solid statistical knowledge and the ability to create clear data visualizations
  • Familiarity with the e-commerce search funnel and hands-on experience with query and ranking analysis, including zero results, reformulation, abandonment, position bias, CTR by position, and relevance versus business trade-offs
  • Experience defining, tracking, and interpreting metrics such as CTR, PDP view rate, add-to-cart, conversion, revenue, and zero-results rate
  • Experience designing and statistically evaluating ML/search experiments across ranking, personalization, and recommendations
  • Proficiency with event-level data and server-side search logs, including building multidimensional metrics layers and end-to-end analytical solutions at large e-commerce scale
  • Proven ability to collaborate with Product Owners, Data Scientists, MLOps, and ML/Search Engineers, lead senior-level initiatives, and deliver measurable product and business impact
  • Proactive and curious approach to complex problems, with genuine enthusiasm for search, recommendations, ranking, personalization, and AI-powered product discovery
  • Regular use of AI tools to improve productivity, automate or reduce repetitive work, support decision-making, and deliver higher-quality outcomes
  • Ability to use AI tools responsibly by structuring effective prompts, critically validating outputs, understanding limitations, and taking ownership of the final result

Nice to Have

  • Experience with GCP, distributed data systems, and analytical databases
  • Familiarity with offline relevance evaluation metrics: NDCG, Recall@K, MRR and MAP
  • Knowledge of information retrieval, recommender systems, or ranking models

As a people-first organisation, we believe diversity strengthens our teams and drives innovation. All employment decisions are based on merit, skills, and performance, without discriminating based on any personal characteristic. This reinforces our commitment to providing an inclusive and respectful workplace.

At Accesa you can

Enjoy our holistic benefits program that covers the four pillars that we believe come together to support our wellbeing, covering social, physical, emotional wellbeing, as well as work-life fusion.

  • Physical Wellbeing: Our wellbeing program includes medical benefits, gym support, and personalised fitness options for an active lifestyle, complemented by team events and the Healthy Habits Club.
  • Work-Life Fusion: In very dynamic industries such as IT, the line between our professional and personal lives can quickly become blurred. Having a one-size-fits-one approach gives us the flexibility to define the work-life dynamic that works for us.
  • Emotional Wellbeing: We believe that to maintain our overall health, we need to invest in our mental wellbeing just as much as we do in our physical health, social connections or in achieving work-life balance.
  • Social Wellbeing: As a growing community in a hybrid environment, we want to ensure we remain connected not just by the great work we do every day but through our passions and interests.

Company Description
Accesa is a leading technology company headquartered in Cluj-Napoca, with offices in Oradea and 20 years of experience in turning business challenges into opportunities and growth.

A value-driven organisation, it has established itself as a partner of choice for major brands in Retail, Manufacturing, Finance, and Banking. It covers the complete digital evolution journey of its customers, from ideation and requirements setup to software development and managed services solutions.

With more than 1,200 IT professionals, Accesa also has a fast-growing footprint, establishing itself as an employer of choice for IT professionals who are passionate about problem-solving through technology. Coming together in strong tech teams with a customer-centric approach, they enable businesses to grow, delivering value for our clients, partners, industry, and community.

Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

Motive’s Financial Products team operates a fast-growing commercial lending and spend management program (Motive Card) built on partnerships with issuing banks and card networks. The program already spans the US & Canada with further international expansion planned. We’re hiring a Lead Compliance Manager to build and own the compliance function for this business end-to-end — from policy development through hands-on execution — as it scales into new products, segments, and markets.

Reporting to the Head of Risk, Financial Products, you will be the senior-most dedicated owner of AML/BSA, sanctions, KYC/KYB, and lending-compliance programs that today are stitched together across Product, Legal, Risk Ops, and Engineering. You will manage the compliance relationship with our issuing bank and network partners across every market we operate in, translate regulatory requirements into policy and control design, and ensure those controls actually operate — not just exist on paper — across a multi-geography, multi-partner program. As Motive enters new markets, you will define what compliance needs to look like there before launch, not after.

What You'll Do:

  • Own and maintain Motive’s AML/BSA, Sanctions, and KYC/KYB policies and procedures across all markets where Motive operates — today the US & Canada, with more markets on the roadmap — keeping them current with local regulatory requirements and issuing bank/network requirements
  • Design, implement, and monitor controls for sanctions and PEP screening, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity escalation, including named Compliance Officer/Designee responsibilities where required by regulation or bank partners
  • Serve as the primary compliance point of contact and relationship owner for issuing bank and card network partners in each market, including compliance reviews, exams, audits, and remediation commitments
  • Partner with Risk, Legal, Underwriting, Product, and Engineering to embed lending-compliance requirements into new products and markets before launch
  • Lead internal and third-party compliance audits and exams, driving findings to closure and maintaining audit-ready documentation and evidence across all jurisdictions
  • Monitor regulatory developments across commercial lending, AML/sanctions, and payments in each market Motive operates or plans to enter, and translate them into actionable policy and control updates
  • Build and run the governance structure for the compliance program — reporting, escalation paths, risk committees — giving leadership clear visibility into program health, and establish the playbook for evaluating compliance requirements ahead of entry into any new market
  • Build out the compliance function as it scales, including hiring and managing future team members as scope grows

What We're Looking For:

  • 8+ years of experience in compliance, audit, or risk management within lending, payments, or financial services, including direct ownership of AML/BSA, KYC/KYB, sanctions, and PEP programs
  • Hands-on experience managing compliance relationships with issuing banks, card networks, or other regulated financial partners, including audits and remediation
  • Multi-jurisdiction compliance program experience, including Canada and UK/EU required; additional international experience (e.g., Mexico or other Latin American markets) a strong plus
  • Working knowledge of the regulatory frameworks governing commercial lending, AML/sanctions, and payments across North America and Europe (e.g., BSA, FinCEN, FINTRAC/PCMLTFA, OFAC sanctions, UK/EU AML and data protection regimes)
  • Proven ability to both write policy and operationalize it — building controls, procedures, and monitoring that hold up under audit, not just documentation
  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with Legal, Risk, Product, and Engineering to launch compliant products in new markets
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to represent Motive credibly to external regulators, auditors, and bank partners, and to advise senior leadership on compliance risk

Position Summary

Phizenix is seeking an experienced Business Development Manager – Government/SLED/Federal to develop public-sector business, build relationships with prime contractors and government stakeholders, and identify staffing and services opportunities early in the procurement lifecycle.

The role requires working knowledge of how Federal, State, and Local agencies buy — procurement regulations, budget/legislative cycles, contract vehicles, and socio-economic contracting programs — alongside strong core business development and capture skills.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Pipeline

  • Identify and develop new business across Federal, State, and Local Government (SLED) markets, positioning Phizenix as a qualified staffing/subcontracting partner to primes and agencies.

Government Policy, Regulatory & Compliance Awareness

  • Maintain working knowledge of the FAR/DFARS and relevant state/local procurement codes, and track legislative, budget, and appropriations developments that affect agency spending and procurement timing.

  • Pursue positioning on relevant contract vehicles (GSA MAS, GWACs, IDIQs, BPAs, NASPO ValuePoint) and track solicitations and sources-sought notices via SAM.gov and state SLED portals.

Capture & Proposal Support

  • Develop early-stage capture strategies and win themes, navigate RFP/RFI/RFQ processes alongside proposal/capture teams, and collaborate with recruiting/delivery on staffing solutions and pricing.

Relationship & Stakeholder Management

  • Build relationships with contracting officers, program managers, and teaming partners; represent Phizenix at industry days and procurement forums; drive new business with a hunter mentality.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of Government, Federal, SLED, or Public Sector Business Development/Sales experience with a proven track record of winning contracts.
  • Strong understanding of RFP/RFI/RFQ and government procurement processes, including the FAR and relevant state/local procurement regulations.
  • Familiarity with SAM.gov, GSA eLibrary/eBuy, GovWin IQ, or equivalent market-intelligence tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with socio-economic/set-aside certifications and their role in teaming strategy.
  • Experience responding to and helping shape RFIs and Sources Sought notices.
  • Certifications (CFCM, CPCM, Shipley, PMP) or experience with CRM/proposal tools (Salesforce, Deltek, GovWin IQ).

Phizenix is a technology solutions company delivering software, consulting, and IT staffing services to clients, including U.S. government prime contractors and public-sector organizations.

Position Summary

Phizenix is seeking an experienced Business Development Manager – Government/SLED/Federal to develop public-sector business, build relationships with prime contractors and government stakeholders, and identify staffing and services opportunities early in the procurement lifecycle.

The role requires working knowledge of how Federal, State, and Local agencies buy — procurement regulations, budget/legislative cycles, contract vehicles, and socio-economic contracting programs — alongside strong core business development and capture skills.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Pipeline

  • Identify and develop new business across Federal, State, and Local Government (SLED) markets, positioning Phizenix as a qualified staffing/subcontracting partner to primes and agencies.
  • Build relationships with prime contractors and conduct customer/partner outreach to uncover staffing and workforce needs.
  • Manage opportunities from identification through award, maintaining an accurate pipeline (CRM/GovWin IQ or equivalent) and reporting against pipeline and revenue targets.

Government Policy, Regulatory & Compliance Awareness

  • Maintain working knowledge of the FAR/DFARS and relevant state/local procurement codes, and track legislative, budget, and appropriations developments that affect agency spending and procurement timing.
  • Monitor agency policy priorities and socio-economic/set-aside programs (8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB/EDWOSB) to inform teaming and set-aside strategy.

Contract Vehicles & Procurement Channels

  • Pursue positioning on relevant contract vehicles (GSA MAS, GWACs, IDIQs, BPAs, NASPO ValuePoint) and track solicitations and sources-sought notices via SAM.gov and state SLED portals.

Capture & Proposal Support

  • Develop early-stage capture strategies and win themes, navigate RFP/RFI/RFQ processes alongside proposal/capture teams, and collaborate with recruiting/delivery on staffing solutions and pricing.

Relationship & Stakeholder Management

  • Build relationships with contracting officers, program managers, and teaming partners; represent Phizenix at industry days and procurement forums; drive new business with a hunter mentality.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of Government, Federal, SLED, or Public Sector Business Development/Sales experience with a proven track record of winning contracts.
  • Strong understanding of RFP/RFI/RFQ and government procurement processes, including the FAR and relevant state/local procurement regulations.
  • Familiarity with SAM.gov, GSA eLibrary/eBuy, GovWin IQ, or equivalent market-intelligence tools.
  • Experience building relationships with prime contractors and public-sector stakeholders; experience selling IT Staffing, Professional Services, or Consulting Services preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities before formal solicitation, with strong networking, negotiation, and communication skills.
  • Proven hunter mentality and ability to independently build and manage a government business pipeline.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Public Administration, Political Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Existing network of Federal and/or State agency contacts and prime-contractor relationships.
  • Familiarity with socio-economic/set-aside certifications and their role in teaming strategy.
  • Experience responding to and helping shape RFIs and Sources Sought notices.
  • Certifications (CFCM, CPCM, Shipley, PMP) or experience with CRM/proposal tools (Salesforce, Deltek, GovWin IQ).

raw.excerpt: About UsInStride Health’s mission is to deliver specialty anxiety and OCD care that works for every kid, teen, young adult, and family who needs it.
raw.description:
About Us

InStride Health’s mission is to deliver specialty anxiety and OCD care that works for every kid, teen, young adult, and family who needs it. Through this mission, we are expanding access to insurance-based care, increasing engagement in treatment, and improving treatment outcomes. We are doing this by combining research-backed clinical care and innovative technology to eliminate the major problems with care today: difficulty finding providers, months of waiting to be seen, arduous onboarding processes, and inconsistent use of evidence-based therapies and outcomes tracking. Our vision is to become the nation’s most trusted provider of pediatric anxiety and OCD care.

TeamInStride Health: Our Core Values

  • Give Heart: We lead with heart, treating patients and their families the way we want our loved ones to be treated.
  • Work Smart: We find smarter ways to solve hard problems and fix the broken mental health system by leveraging technology, diversity of thought, and innovation.
  • Have Humility: We leave our egos at the door, empowering our team to collaborate, celebrate diversity, and adopt a growth mindset.
  • Embrace Community: We all belong. We are in this together, and we never worry alone. We believe in each other and recognize that every voice matters.

About the Role

We are looking for a virtual Pre-Licensed Therapist to join our team to deliver family-centric and evidence-based care to Children, Adolescents, & Young Adults. This is a fully remote position.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide evidence-based individual and group clinical care to patients and families
  • Use measurement-based care to inform treatment planning
  • Lead and collaborate with other care team members (e.g., coach and psychiatrist)
  • Provide feedback on program curricula and training protocols
  • Provide feedback regarding the various applications of technology in treatment
  • Maintain awareness of risk management issues
  • Complete documentation in a timely and thorough manner
  • Participate in initial and ongoing trainings on the application of evidence-based and tech-enhanced care delivery
  • Facilitate skills or skills practice groups, as assigned. These CBT-based groups are for parents/caregivers and focus on skills development and implementation based on the InStride Health curriculum, integrating aspects of ACT and PMT.

What You Need to Succeed in the Role

  • Provisional / Associate licensure with the following designation:
    • Provisional / Associate Counseling License & Masters Degree from an accredited graduate program
  • An active license in Pennsylvania
  • Graduate-level clinical internship with therapy training required
  • Background in working with children and adolescents, with anxiety and related disorders, or preferably both
  • Experience and training in delivering evidence-based treatments (e.g., CBT, ACT, DBT) preferred
  • Basic computer skills, facility with and openness to new technologies
  • Excellent written and interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to be flexible and nimble, embrace change, and work well both independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, mission driven environment
  • Culturally responsive with regard to diversity and inclusion
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information in a manner that inspires confidence and trust
  • Commitment to Progressing Toward Independent Licensure: this is a pre-licensed role intended for clinicians who are actively working toward full independent licensure. Once you have completed the supervised clinical experience and other state requirements needed to pursue final licensure, you will be expected to promptly complete all remaining steps and obtain independent licensure within six months for master's-level clinicians (LCSW/LPC or equivalent) or nine months for doctoral-level psychologists (Ph.D/Psy.D), absent documented circumstances outside your reasonable control.

The starting annual salary for this role is $70,000. This is a pre-licensed role designed to support clinicians in progressing toward independent licensure; compensation will increase upon obtaining full independent licensure in accordance with InStride's compensation practices.

Why Join Our Team

  • Generous benefits package (401k with match, Flexible PTO, paid holidays, paid service days, 4 week paid sabbatical, 12 week paid parental leave, health benefits starting on your first day, and more)
  • Opportunity to join a mission-driven company that is changing the landscape of pediatric mental health treatment
  • Chance to make a far-reaching impact by helping children and families access desperately-needed, evidence-based care
  • Opportunity to work with talented and experienced team members who have devoted their lives to solving this problem
  • Fully virtual: work from the comfort of your home with periodic in-person retreats

Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, & Belonging (DEIB)

We want to make our clinical services available for everyone, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or how you identify. To achieve this, we recognize we must continually make progress in building a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive team. Through these efforts, we support two primary objectives at InStride Health:

  1. Providing high quality patient care to families. We are in a privileged position to support families during a vulnerable time in their lives. We approach all families and each other with compassion and are most effective as a diverse team where all individuals feel valued, respected, and accepted.
  2. Building a mission-driven business that lasts. Specifically, we believe our commitment to a supportive culture improves innovation, decision-making, and efficiency.

We invite you to share any additional information about yourself or your experiences that may not be reflected in your CV. Inclusion of this information is completely voluntary.

Beware of fake job postings and offers. All official communications from InStride Health will come from email addresses ending in @instride.health. We will never ask for personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank details during the application process. If you receive a suspicious job offer or communication, please contact our recruitment team directly () to verify its authenticity.

The AEM Technical Architect will lead the design and delivery of enterprise Adobe Experience Manager implementations. This role partners with clients and cross-functional teams to create scalable, secure solutions, provide technical direction, and drive successful project execution. The position combines solution architecture,deliveryleadership, and hands-on technicalexpertise. It is not a full-time development role, but the Architect must be able to troubleshoot complex issues, review implementation approaches, and contribute directly when needed.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end AEM solution design and provide architectural direction throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Partner with client stakeholders, business analysts, QA, lead developers, developers, DevOps teams, and third-party vendors to clarify requirements and align the implementation approach.

  • Design scalable and secure integrations between AEM and external platforms such as commerce, CRM, ERP, analytics, and marketing systems.

  • 3+ years of experience architecting enterprise-grade CMS or AEM implementations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure toAdobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign, or other Adobe Experience Cloud products.

  • Experience supporting technical discovery, solution presentations, or pre-sales activities.

What Success Looks Like

  • Delivery teams receive practical guidance that supports quality, maintainability, scalability, andtimelyexecution.

In Zusammenarbeit mit den zehn Friedensnobelpreisträgern sucht Live Peace Ehrenamtliche/r Mitarbeiter:innen Finanzen und Fundraising (m/w/d)

55 Länder befinden sich im Krieg. Jedes vierte Land. Auf allen Kontinenten. Mehr als 114 Millionen Menschen sind durch Konflikte vertrieben worden, und jeden Tag verlieren Tausende von Zivilisten und Soldaten ihr Leben oder werden verletzt.

Live Peace ist ein Ereignis, ein Werkzeug, ein Hebel, der es den Menschen ermöglicht, durch die Teilnahme an Friedenskonzerten und Live-Unterhaltung an einem Tag friedlich Frieden zu fordern. Musik und Kunst haben die außergewöhnliche Kraft, uns zu vereinen, uns zu bewegen und uns durch die kollektiven Emotionen, die sie erzeugen, zu erheben. Im Jahr 1985 verfolgten 2 Milliarden Fernsehzuschauer und 75 000 Menschen persönlich das legendäre Live-Aid-Konzert, das 69 der größten Künstler, darunter Queen, U2, Dire Straits, Elton John, Sting, Madonna und Bob Dylan, 16 Stunden lang auf zwei Bühnen in London und Philadelphia zusammenbrachte.

Live Peace soll zu einem weltweiten Ereignis werden, das jedes Jahr am 21. September, dem Internationalen Friedenstag der Vereinten Nationen, stattfindet, mit immer mehr Konzerten und Live-Auftritten, die von Städten, Restaurants, Bars und Nachtclubs organisiert werden, und mit Liedern in allen Sprachen der Welt.

raw.excerpt: About dss+At dss+, you don’t just deliver projects - you help save lives, improve performance, and build a more sustainable future.
raw.description:
About dss+

At dss+, you don’t just deliver projects - you help save lives, improve performance, and build a more sustainable future.

We are a purpose-led global consultancy partnering with organisations in high-risk and asset-intensive industries to solve complex operational challenges across safety, operational excellence, and sustainability.

With a heritage rooted in DuPont’s industrial operations, we combine deep expertise, practical problem-solving, and digital innovation to deliver measurable and lasting impact for our clients.

Why This Role

As a freelance Subject Matter Expert (SME), you will bring deep expertise in underground mine ventilation, fire prevention, and emergency response to support a major mining expansion project in Brazil.

Working alongside dss+ and client stakeholders, you will review operational procedures, identify operational and safety risks, challenge existing practices where appropriate, and provide practical recommendations aligned with industry leading practices.

Why This Industry

As underground mining operations become more complex and technically demanding, effective Ground Control is critical to protecting people, infrastructure, and operational continuity.

dss+ supports mining organizations in strengthening operational risk management by ensuring that technical requirements, Critical Controls, and engineering standards are translated into practical procedures that can be applied consistently in the field.

Your Impact at dss+

You will provide specialist expertise for the critical review, development, and improvement of operational procedures associated with underground mine ventilation, atmospheric hazards, fire prevention and response, evacuation, and emergency preparedness.

You will help ensure that ventilation requirements, operational conditions, emergency scenarios, and Critical Controls are translated into practical procedures that can be understood and consistently applied by supervisors, operators, contractors, maintenance teams, and operational leadership.

Key Accountabilities

  • Review and evaluate underground ventilation procedures, standards, and management systems.

  • Assess procedures covering primary, secondary, and auxiliary ventilation systems.

  • Review ventilation surveys, monitoring practices, and atmospheric testing requirements.

  • Evaluate post-blast ventilation and underground re-entry procedures.

  • Assess operational responses to ventilation failures, alarms, and abnormal atmospheric conditions.

  • Review underground fire prevention, detection, and emergency response procedures.

  • Evaluate smoke propagation response strategies and ventilation management during emergencies.

  • Assess emergency communications, evacuation procedures, refuge chambers, and escape route management.

  • Support the development and validation of emergency preparedness plans and response procedures.

  • Identify gaps between engineering requirements and operational execution.

  • Facilitate workshops involving engineering, operations, maintenance, emergency response, safety, and contractor teams.

  • Provide recommendations to strengthen operational and safety risk controls.

What You'll Experience at dss+

Deliver on our Purpose
Be part of a values-led organization where your expertise helps improve safety performance, strengthen risk management, and support critical operational decisions.

Apply your Trusted Expertise
Work alongside experienced technical and operational leaders, bringing your knowledge to a high-profile underground mining expansion project.

Collaborate with Industry Experts
Contribute to a multidisciplinary team of specialists supporting one of the mining industry's most important operational improvement initiatives.

Create Lasting Impact
Help develop practical procedures and controls that will influence operational performance and safety outcomes long after the project is complete.

Who You Are

You are an experienced underground mining professional with deep expertise in ventilation systems, atmospheric risk management, fire prevention, and emergency preparedness.

You are comfortable reviewing technical requirements, identifying operational risks, challenging assumptions, and translating engineering requirements into practical operational procedures that can be consistently applied in underground mining environments.

Experience

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in underground mining operations.

  • Minimum 5 years of direct involvement in underground mine ventilation.

  • Experience in the design, operation, commissioning, optimization, or management of underground ventilation systems.

  • Practical experience conducting ventilation surveys and assessing underground atmospheric conditions.

  • Experience developing, reviewing, or implementing operational and emergency response procedures.

  • Experience supporting underground emergency preparedness and emergency response programs.

  • Experience conducting technical reviews, audits, operational assessments, or risk evaluations.

  • Experience supporting mine development, operational readiness, expansion, or ramp-up projects is advantageous.

Capabilities

  • Ability to translate ventilation designs and technical calculations into practical operational procedures.

  • Define atmospheric monitoring requirements and acceptable operating limits.

  • Establish objective post-blast re-entry criteria.

  • Define effective responses to ventilation failures, alarms, and abnormal atmospheric conditions.

  • Integrate fire scenarios into ventilation management and evacuation procedures.

  • Assess escape strategies, refuge arrangements, and emergency communication systems.

  • Develop procedures that clearly define responsibilities, authorization requirements, operational controls, and stop-work criteria.

  • Plan, facilitate, and evaluate underground emergency drills and simulations.

  • Facilitate technical workshops involving engineering, operations, maintenance, emergency response, and contractor teams.

  • Strong technical writing skills with the ability to prepare clear documentation in English.

  • Strong stakeholder engagement and facilitation capabilities.

Education & Languages

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mining Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

  • Specialized training or postgraduate qualification in Mine Ventilation is highly desirable.

  • Professional registration or equivalent certification, where applicable.

  • Fluency in English required.

  • Portuguese and/or Spanish highly advantageous.

A Bit More About Us

We are implementers and change-makers. Our teams work from the boardroom to the shop floor, helping organizations build resilience, improve performance, and sustain results over time.

Our expertise spans industries including metals and mining, energy, chemicals, manufacturing, and private equity, combining deep operational knowledge with transformation and capability-building expertise.

Diversity & Inclusion

dss+ is committed to building a diverse workforce and fostering an inclusive culture where everyone is respected, valued, and able to contribute fully.

We believe diversity strengthens our organization and drives better outcomes for our people, our clients, and the communities we serve.

raw.description:
About the role:

The Associate Organizing Director is a seasoned people manager who leads a team of ~5 organizing staff across multiple career levels. While this role focuses heavily on driving team performance, setting clear metrics, coaching for growth, and holding staff accountable to shared campaign goals, the Associate Organizing Director also provides strategic oversight for state field programs, campaign execution, and cross-department initiatives.

We are looking for an experienced organizing leader who loves people management and building and leading innovative programming in a rapidly growing progressive organization. The position involves some travel up to 20% each year, with ebbs and flows depending on the work.

Indivisible offers a comprehensive employer-sponsored benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; a company-sponsored Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA); FSA with limited matching, and a 401(k) retirement plan with up to a 5% employer match. Employees are fully vested upon becoming eligible.

What you'll do:

People and Culture - 60%
  • Supervise ~5 organizing staff across multiple states and experience levels.
  • Provide regular guidance, mentorship, structure, feedback, and evaluation to support team members’ ongoing growth.
  • Use program metrics and tracking systems to manage individual staff performance, holding team members accountable to shared goals and addressing gaps early through proactive coaching.
  • Contribute to a safe, welcoming, and inspiring environment for staff to excel in, and provide ongoing opportunities for team members to lead and grow. Build a unique and positive culture for your team.
  • Uphold Indivisible's values of creating an inclusive and equitable working environment.
Program Management - 30%
  • Independently or in partnership with other organizational leadership, lead priority programs and campaigns, both within our team and across departments, to help achieve organizational goals.
  • Work with organizers across experience levels to develop strategic turf plans to hit campaign and organizational goals.
  • Actively manage your team to achieve their goals - providing constructive feedback and guidance as they work towards them, creating opportunities to learn from both successes and setbacks, and holding staff accountable when they fall short.
Team Leadership - 10%
  • Work with Organizing Leadership to continue to build and improve Indivisible's organizing model and strategy.
  • Identify best practices both within the team and in the field, and work with leadership to scale them aggressively.
  • Listen for and surface new departmental or organizational initiatives based on feedback from group leaders and/or staff.

Qualifications:

Field Expertise & Strategy
  • Strong knowledge and at least 5-7 years/cycles of demonstrated experience developing and implementing field strategies; deep understanding of grassroots and grasstops organizing.
  • Ability to develop and implement field plans, track/monitor/assess progress, troubleshoot, and adapt as needed.
  • Ability to tackle big, complex problems with actionable plans, generate smart, innovative approaches, and not afraid to think outside of the box.
Ability to Manage in Complexity
  • Relentlessly results-oriented; strong track record of meeting or exceeding goals.
  • At least 3-5 years of proven experience managing others to achieve ambitious goals.
  • Strategic and analytical thinker with the ability to pivot from big picture to detailed implementation as needed.
  • Ability to juggle multiple streams of work, prioritize, and problem-solve in complex and nuanced situations.
  • Comfort operating in complex and fluid environments, responding innovatively and rapidly to emerging opportunities or concerns.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive year-round in a fast-paced, dynamic grassroots campaign environment while managing a heavy workload.
Interpersonal Skills
  • Strong people skills; effective communicator.
  • An exceptional team player who exemplifies a work style that is flexible, respectful, collaborative, and nimble.
  • Can build trust, confidence, and followership of a diverse range of staff, volunteers, and field partners - across race, gender, and other identities.
  • Demonstrated record of mentorship, coaching, and leadership development in previous positions.
Cultural Competency
  • Understanding of race, gender, sexuality, and other aspects of identity, and their intersections, and how that plays out in the work.
  • Demonstrates self-awareness of their own multiple group identities and their attendant dynamics, and can adapt their approach as needed.
  • Ability to build strong relationships and trust across race, gender, class, and other group identities, both internally and externally.
  • Experience organizing in communities of color and/or building multiracial organizing efforts and prior training in anti-oppression, equity, and inclusion.

About Indivisible Project

We’re building something new. We’re a progressive grassroots organization that began in the aftermath of Trump’s election. We’re working to build a democracy that reflects a broad, multiracial “we the people,” one that works for all of us and is sustained by all of us. To support this movement, we’ve built an incredible team at the national level. We dream big, we support each other, and we have fun doing it. For more information about Indivisible’s vision, mission, and theory of change, click here.

We’re changing what’s politically possible. Indivisible is part of the powerful progressive movement reaction to Trump, fighting the racist, misogynistic, plutocratic, and authoritarian agenda trumpeted by Trump and the GOP congress. Don’t take our word for it; Indivisible has been featured on the Rachel Maddow Show multiple times, as well as in the New York Times and in pretty much every other major news outlet in the country.

We’re building together. We’re building a new organization every day - a rare opportunity to model what we want to see in the world. We’re deeply committed to equity and building a diverse and inclusive organization.

We’re looking for you. If you want to fight for the soul of American democracy, there’s no better place to be than Indivisible. We’re looking for more team members who are passionate about building an inclusive democracy and committed to getting results. It’s an exciting, fulfilling place if you’re someone who wants to fight fiercely for the progressive world we want to have.

Every one of us on the national team is here because we believe this movement is the best way to retake and build progressive power in this country. Does that ring true for you? If so, great - throw your hat in the ring to join our team. Let’s start #winning together. For more information about Indivisible’s organizational principles, click here.

AI Optimization Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: AI Optimization Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an AI Optimization Engineer to focus on extracting maximum throughput, minimizing latency, and reducing cost across training and inference workloads for large neural network systems. The role spans the full stack from low-level kernel optimization to distributed system tuning, requiring deep understanding of GPU architecture, model parallelism, memory management, and compiler-level optimization. The ideal candidate has demonstrated impact on production AI workloads, with strong instrumentation and measurement discipline that enables rigorous, data-driven optimization decisions. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Six or more years of experience in performance engineering, ML systems, or HPC.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and C++.
  • Hands-on experience optimizing deep learning workloads on modern GPUs.
  • Deep understanding of distributed training and inference techniques.
  • Experience with profiling tools across CPU, GPU, and distributed systems.
  • Familiarity with model compression techniques and their accuracy implications.
  • Strong grasp of memory hierarchies, communication primitives, and parallelism strategies.
  • Excellent measurement, debugging, and analytical reasoning skills.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience optimizing LLM inference at production scale.
  • Contributions to vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, DeepSpeed, or similar projects.
  • Familiarity with custom kernel authoring in Triton or CUTLASS.
  • Experience with FinOps for AI workloads.
  • Publications or talks on AI systems performance.

About us

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

About the role

As Marketing Data Analyst, you will own the analytical point of view on marketing performance across Coalition's insurance and security businesses. You will connect data from across the marketing and sales stack, explain what is driving results, and bring marketing leadership recommendations that change what we do next. This role is weighted toward insight over reporting. Dashboards matter and you will keep them healthy, but the true value you’re going to bring is analysis and the judgment behind it. You will partner closely with marketing operations, sales operations, data engineering, data science, and marketing leadership.

Responsibilities

  • Funnel & Campaign Analysis: Run end-to-end analysis across both the insurance and security businesses, from awareness and demand capture through intent, pipeline, and closed revenue. The two funnels behave differently and you will need to understand each, including the go to market motions that go into them so you can identify where the funnel is leaking, which channels are carrying weight, and what should change.
  • Insights & Recommendations: Get past simple metrics to the insight. Bring campaign managers, growth leads, and marketing leadership data-backed recommendations they can act on. That includes calls on what to repeat, what to cut, and where to move our collective marketing efforts.
  • Data Synthesis: Pull together CRM, marketing automation, ad platform, web analytics, and sales engagement data to answer questions no existing dashboard can. Often, data arrives messy, from sources that don’t join cleanly. You should be able to reach an answer on your own, and to escalate upstream data issues to Data Engineering, Data Science, or Sales Operations when the fix belongs there.
  • Measurement Framework Design: Establish how we goal, measure, and optimize areas of marketing investment that do not yet have a consistent standard. Help define the metrics, set the benchmarks, and get marketing and sales agreeing on the definitions and what matters.
  • Executive Reviews: Own the analytical narrative for the monthly CMO Data Review and the quarterly Marketing and GTM QBRs. You help decide what the story is and surface what leadership needs to see.
  • Reporting & Dashboards: Design and maintain performance dashboards for weekly, monthly, and quarterly stakeholder reporting. Keep metric definitions and tracking integrity sound so the numbers hold up under scrutiny. Build toward self-service so teams can answer routine questions without you.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the primary liaison connecting Marketing with Data Engineering, Data Science, and Sales Operations to ensure data alignment, tracking integrity, and cohesive reporting.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in B2B marketing analytics
  • BI Tools: Experience with Looker
  • Modern Tooling: Active usage and understanding of Salesforce, Marketo, Outreach, Chillipiper, Google Analytics, and Ad Platforms.
  • Funnel Mastery: Deep understanding of B2B marketing funnels, attribution concepts, and performance metrics (CAC, LTV, conversion rates, pipeline velocity).
  • Communication: Exceptional ability to verbally and visually communicate complex analytical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership.

Why Coalition?

Work at Coalition is centered on the joint mission to Protect the Unprotected. We have built a remote-first, highly inclusive culture that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Coalition’s exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion.

We’re always looking for collaborative, inquisitive individuals to join #OurCoalition.

This commitment includes, but is not limited to, ensuring equal treatment in recruitment, selection, training, promotion, transfer, compensation, and all other aspects of employment. WHY DEPT®?

We are pioneers at heart. What this means, is that we are always leaning forward, thinking of what we can create tomorrow that does not exist today. We were born digital and we are a new model of agency, with a deep skillset in tech and marketing. That’s why we hire curious, self-driven, talented people who never stop innovating.

Our culture is big enough to cope and small enough to care. Meaning, that with people across 20+ countries, we’re big enough to provide you with the best tools, global opportunities, and benefits that help you thrive. While acting small by investing in you, your growth, your team, and giving you the autonomy to solve our clients' problems, no matter where you are in the world.

About You

Our Senior Account Manager, Programmatic is responsible for overseeing the successful execution and optimization of programmatic campaigns with a high level of media-buying expertise and operational excellence within our retail vertical. In this role, you will serve as a strategic partner to clients, manage complex campaigns, and provide mentorship and day-to-day guidance to Account Managers and Coordinators to support their development and ensure strong team performance.

While DEPT® is a remote-first company, this role requires candidates to be located in either the Mountain or Pacific time zones.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner closely with client services and programmatic teams to deliver client-first recommendations and provide day-to-day programmatic expertise.
  • Develop & execute cutting-edge digital campaigns from conception to launch across platforms like Amazon (bonus if you have experience on Walmart and Target).
  • Manage and oversee executions and optimizations of your sponsored campaigns.
  • Build, strengthen, and maintain effective client relationships by communicating performance insights and strategic opportunities.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities, strategic thinking, and clear communication in all client and internal interactions.
  • Act as a proactive self-starter who can independently manage workflows while collaborating across teams.
  • Support the development and execution of programmatic strategy to drive performance and achieve client goals.
  • Provide guidance, feedback, and light mentorship to Account Managers and Coordinators to support their growth.
  • Champion our core values and contribute to a positive, collaborative team culture.
  • Bring forward innovative ideas and challenge existing processes to help elevate team performance and campaign results.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4+ years of programmatic media experience, preferably across CTV, Display, and Video, with exposure to Native, Audio, or OOH.
  • Hands-on programmatic trading experience within retail marketplaces such as Walmart, Target, & Best Buy.
  • Proficiency in multiple DSPs (Amazon, TTD & DV360 preferred), as well as familiarity with Ad Servers.
  • A minimum of 3 years’ paid marketing / ecommerce experience.
  • Familiarity with Amazon Vendor/Seller Central is required.
  • Demonstrated experience guiding or mentoring junior team members and contributing to their development.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with a strategic mindset.
  • While DEPT® is a remote-first company, this role requires candidates to be located in either the Mountain or Pacific time zones.

WHAT IMPRESSES US

  • Exceptional deck-building and storytelling abilities.
  • Advanced experience with Google Analytics, Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, or similar ad-tech platforms.
  • Skills in data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Data Studio, Tableau).
  • Experience supporting or contributing to client pitches, audits, or strategic presentations.

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a pioneering technology and marketing services company that creates integrated end-to-end digital experiences for brands such as Google, KFC, Philips, Audi, Twitch, Patagonia, eBay and more. Its team of 2,500+ digital specialists across 30+ locations on 5 continents delivers pioneering work on a global scale with a boutique culture.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our effortshere.

  • Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs to support frontend applications and enterprise integrations.

  • Experience with AWS services including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, IAM, EventBridge, SQS, SNS, and CloudWatch.

  • Strong knowledge of DynamoDB schema design, indexing strategies, and performance optimization.

  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. title: Sales Development Representative - IBERIA
description: The Sales Development Representative, IBERIA is responsible for generating qualified pipeline for Omilia's IBERIA enterprise sales team through structured outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification.

raw.title: Sales Development Representative - IBERIA
raw.excerpt: The Sales Development Representative, IBERIA is responsible for generating qualified pipeline for Omilia's IBERIA enterprise sales team through structured outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification.
raw.description:
The Sales Development Representative, IBERIA is responsible for generating qualified pipeline for Omilia's IBERIA enterprise sales team through structured outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification. The role sits at the top of the sales funnel — identifying, engaging, and qualifying senior decision-makers at target enterprise accounts across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, and converting interest into discovery meetings for Account Executives. Success is measured by qualified meetings booked, pipeline contribution, and outbound activity quality across assigned IBERIA territories.

Accountabilities

  • Own the top-of-funnel pipeline generation for assigned IBERIA territories — consistently delivering a volume of qualified meetings that meets or exceeds monthly and quarterly targets.
  • Maintain a structured, data-driven outbound prospecting motion — building and executing multi-touch, multi-channel sequences across phone, email, LinkedIn, and social that reach senior CX, IT, and operations decision-makers at target IBERIA enterprise accounts.
  • Qualify inbound leads from marketing campaigns, events, and website activity — rapidly assessing fit, intent, and timing, and advancing qualified prospects to the appropriate Account Executive.
  • Act as the first commercial representation of Omilia in IBERIA prospect interactions — communicating Omilia's value proposition clearly and compellingly across diverse European markets and cultural contexts.
  • Maintain accurate and complete records of all prospecting activity in Salesforce — ensuring that the Sales Director has full visibility of pipeline generation activity, conversion rates, and outreach performance across the IBERIA region.

Key Responsibilities

Outbound Prospecting

  • Research, identify, and build targeted prospect lists for assigned IBERIA territories — drawing on Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, and other intelligence tools to map target accounts, identify buying centres, and pinpoint senior decision-makers across CX, IT, contact centre operations, and digital transformation functions.
  • Execute structured multi-touch outbound sequences — combining personalised cold email, phone outreach, LinkedIn engagement, and social selling to engage senior prospects at target IBERIA enterprise accounts across priority verticals including financial services, insurance, telecommunications, utilities, healthcare, and public sector.
  • Craft compelling, personalised outreach in English and relevant IBERIA languages as applicable — connecting Omilia's conversational AI and contact centre capabilities to each prospect's known business challenges and demonstrating genuine understanding of each target account and market context.
  • Conduct high-quality discovery conversations with senior prospects — qualifying on budget authority, need, and timing, uncovering the prospect's contact centre environment and automation objectives, and building sufficient interest and context to secure a substantive first meeting for the Account Executive.
  • Adapt outreach approach and communication style to the distinct procurement cultures and business norms of assigned IBERIA markets — recognising that prospecting into UK and German enterprises, for example, requires meaningfully different tone, cadence, and messaging.

Inbound Lead Management

  • Respond to inbound leads from marketing campaigns, content downloads, event registrations, and website enquiries within agreed SLAs — assessing fit and intent rapidly and advancing qualified prospects through to AE handover.
  • Partner with the marketing team on IBERIA campaign follow-up — ensuring that leads generated from webinars, events, and digital campaigns are worked promptly and effectively, and providing feedback on lead quality and regional relevance to improve targeting.

Account Executive Collaboration

  • Work closely with assigned IBERIA Account Executives to align prospecting activity to territory priorities — understanding each AE's target account list, preferred verticals, and current pipeline gaps, and focusing outbound effort accordingly.
  • Prepare and deliver clear, structured meeting briefs for AEs prior to each booked discovery call — summarising the prospect's role, company context, key business challenges, and the conversation that led to the meeting.
  • Participate in joint account planning sessions with AEs — contributing outbound intelligence, contact mapping, and engagement history to inform IBERIA territory strategy.

Omilia Platform and Market Knowledge

  • Develop and maintain a working knowledge of Omilia's product portfolio — OCP, miniApps, Pathfinder, CoPilot, TalkGuard, and OptimizeIQ — sufficient to hold an intelligent first conversation with a senior prospect, articulate Omilia's key differentiators, and connect platform capabilities to common contact centre pain points across IBERIA verticals.
  • Maintain awareness of GDPR and the EU AI Act as they relate to enterprise AI and contact centre deployments — sufficient to address basic compliance questions in initial prospect conversations and position Omilia credibly in the European regulatory context.
  • Stay current with Omilia's IBERIA target verticals, competitive landscape, and key industry trends — ensuring that outreach messaging reflects current market context and positions Omilia credibly against incumbent CCaaS and IVR vendors active in European markets.

Reporting and Process

  • Maintain Salesforce as the system of record for all prospecting activity — logging calls, emails, LinkedIn touches, meetings booked, and pipeline progression accurately and consistently.
  • Track and report on personal KPIs — including outreach volume, connection rates, meeting booking rates, and pipeline contribution — and use this data to continuously refine messaging, sequencing, and targeting across IBERIA markets.
  • Participate in regular pipeline reviews and coaching sessions with the Sales Director — sharing what is working, identifying regional blockers, and incorporating feedback to improve performance.
  • Occasionally travel within IBERIA to support trade shows, industry events, and internal sales team meetings — up to 10% of the time.

Requirements

Required:

  • 1–3 years of experience in a sales development, business development, or outbound prospecting role — preferably within enterprise SaaS, CCaaS, conversational AI, or B2B technology.
  • Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding outbound prospecting and meeting-booking targets in a structured SDR or BDR environment.
  • Proficiency with outbound sales tools — including Salesforce CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and sales engagement platforms (e.g., Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, Spanish and Portuguese — able to craft personalised, compelling cold outreach and hold confident discovery conversations with senior CX, IT, and operations decision-makers across IBERIA markets.
  • Awareness of and sensitivity to the distinct business cultures, procurement norms, and communication styles across key IBERIA markets — and the ability to adapt outreach tone and approach accordingly.
  • Organised and self-directed work style — able to manage a high volume of outbound activity across multiple accounts and geographies without losing attention to quality or personalisation.
  • Genuine curiosity about enterprise technology, contact centre automation, and conversational AI — and the motivation to develop deep product and market knowledge over time.
  • Coachable and growth-oriented — open to feedback, willing to iterate on messaging and approach, and committed to continuous improvement.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Marketing, or a related discipline.

Nice to have:

  • Fluency in one or more European languages (German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch) — directly relevant for outreach into non-English-speaking IBERIA markets.
  • Prior exposure to contact centre technology, CCaaS, IVR, or conversational AI — either through sales experience or personal interest.
  • Familiarity with Omilia's platform or competing platforms (Genesys, Avaya, Nuance/Microsoft, Google CCAI, Amazon Connect).
  • Experience prospecting into large enterprise accounts across IBERIA financial services, insurance, telecommunications, or utilities verticals.

Omilia Note

  • Contribute actively and effectively as an integrated team member.
  • Act as an Omilia ambassador in all interactions.

Benefits

  • Fixed compensation;
  • Long-term employment with the working days vacation;
  • Development in professional growth (courses, training, etc);
  • Being part of successful cutting-edge technology products that are making a global impact in the service industry;
  • Proficient and fun-to-work-with colleagues;
  • Apple gear

Omilia is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that embracing diversity in all its forms enriches our workplace and drives our collective success. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels welcomed, valued, and empowered to contribute their unique perspectives without regard to factors such as race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, heredity, disability, age, or veteran status, all eligible candidates will be given consideration for employment.

raw.description:
About AJC

American Jewish Committee (AJC) is the global advocacy organization for the Jewish people. We create trusted partnerships with leaders around the world to ensure Jews and Israel are safe and thriving.

With an unparalleled reach spanning six continents, AJC engages leaders in more than 110 countries through 40 offices and dozens of partnerships with Jewish communities worldwide. Wherever the Jewish people and Israel need us, AJC is there—empowering leaders in government, education, partner communities, and the private sector to counter antisemitism and act as allies.

The challenges we face are global. AJC is leading the global response. Join us.

Your Department

AJC uses marketing, branding, communications, and social media to educate the public and shape opinion in pursuit of our mission. We leverage our vast global media presence—which includes the largest social media following of any Jewish organization—as an essential part of our advocacy arsenal.

Your Impact

This position makes an impact at AJC by planning, overseeing, and developing work with significant impact on the organization's mission and goals; manages a small team. Works with significant latitude to solve complex problems and make strategically important decisions impacting the department.

The incumbent leads the visual strategy to increase brand awareness and support the agency's mission. This position is responsible for overseeing all agency-wide design projects, overseeing the work of the Graphics Team, and ensuring AJC's visual presence is consistent and impactful across all platforms.

Your Role

  • Conceptualize and direct the visual strategy to increase AJC’s brand awareness in a crowded marketplace and build support for the agency’s mission and advocacy objectives
  • Generate and oversee all agency design projects, including promotional brochures, event collateral, direct mail fundraising packages, AJC.org website, AJC’s social media platforms, email templates, and environmental graphics
  • Lead a talented Graphics Team in creating engaging, relevant, and inspiring visual designs
  • Manage and mentor AJC’s in-house Graphics Team, overseeing an annual goal-setting process, identifying professional development opportunities for all team members, and overseeing the day-to-day operations of the team
  • Maintain and manage a roster of freelance designers, illustrators, photographers, and external print shops
  • Review, adjust, and implement best practices for AJC’s in-house Graphics Team and print shop, ensuring the use of state-of-the-art technology and techniques
  • Collaborate with key Marketing and Communications stakeholders, especially the Senior Director of Brand Marketing, to plan major marketing initiatives, like the annual end-of-year fundraising campaign
  • Play a key role in setting AJC brand guidelines and ensuring adherence across the agency for all print, digital, and environmental designs
  • Partner with the video specialist to provide creative oversight for all externally-produced video projects
  • Create and maintain a consistent brand look across AJC offices representing AJC’s global and regional prominence
  • Maintain a deep knowledge of compelling visuals relevant to AJC’s priority issue areas and audiences
  • Generate and oversee the vision for AJC Global Forum collateral and environmental graphics
  • Serve as a consultant and stakeholder to the Department’s efforts to maintain AJC’s digital asset management system, ensuring proper licenses/rights for images and easy accessibility across the agency
  • Oversee designs requested by internal clients and train all staff on how to interface with the Graphics Team
  • Seek insights from end-users to develop design and graphic request operations best practices
  • Identify, negotiate contracts for, manage, and evaluate outside design, photography, and printing vendors, ensuring contracted projects are completed on time and within budget
  • Lead all graphics, photography, fabrication, and other visual experiential initiatives, including related vendors, at major AJC events, working outside of normal business hours in the weeks up to and during such events
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of design trends in the Jewish communal organization sector, social media advocacy, and digital advocacy
  • Prepare and monitor the annual graphics budget in consultation with AJC’s accounting department and the SVP of Marketing and Communications.
  • Research and recommend efficient and justifiable purchases for the graphics team and print shop
  • Support AJC regional and overseas offices and national departments with design and branding requests
  • Present final layouts for approval, explaining the creative with clear rationale
  • Review and approve proofs of printed artwork and copy.

Supervisory Role

Medium office/team of 4-7

Education, Training, and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 8-10+ years of related work experience
  • 12+ years of graphic design experience, preferable in an agency or non-profit setting.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Passion for the mission, goals, and objectives of AJC
  • Committed to AJC’s core values: respect, accountability, integrity, innovation, and collaboration
  • Demonstrates professionalism and high standards of conduct
  • Ability to work collaboratively with individuals from diverse backgrounds
  • Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and listening)
  • Strong organization and project management skills, including the ability to set priorities and meet deadlines
  • Capacity to multitask and work in a fast-paced and changing environment
  • Willing and able to work outside of standard working hours, including early mornings, evenings, and/or weekends
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Teams, and Outlook), Google Suite applications, and Zoom
  • Proficient in Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign
  • Understanding of web production and digital design elements
  • Familiarity with video production
  • Strong managerial skills and the ability to direct, motivate, and develop individuals and/or teams
  • Experience with, and ability to oversee, the installation of all event fabrications along with oversight of photography and graphics at major events.

Physical Demands

Office employees

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often sitting or standing for prolonged periods
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers
  • Communicating with others to exchange information
  • Moving about to accomplish tasks or moving from one worksite to another

Disclaimers

raw.excerpt: We are looking for a Director - Developer Platforms, Infra, Data Engineering and Platform to lead and evolve the engineering platforms and infrastructure that power Carousell Group at scale.
raw.description:
We are looking for a Director - Developer Platforms, Infra, Data Engineering and Platform to lead and evolve the engineering platforms and infrastructure that power Carousell Group at scale.

This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who can operate across Platform Engineering, Infrastructure / SRE and Data Engineering and go deep in at least two of these areas.

You will help shape how our engineering organisation builds, operates and scales systems while driving the adoption of AI-native and agentic engineering practices across the organisation.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable operating at both strategic and technical depth. You should be able to engage with senior engineers on architecture and technical decisions while also leading managers and engineering organisations through complex, multi-year initiatives.

What You Will Do

  • Lead and evolve our platform, infrastructure and engineering capabilities to support highly scalable and reliable systems across Carousell Group.

  • Drive agentic engineering and AI adoption across engineering teams, leading from the front with hands-on experience applying AI to engineering workflows and software development.

  • Provide technical direction across Platform Engineering, Infrastructure / SRE and Data Engineering and make sound architecture decisions across these areas.

  • Lead the design and operation of highly scalable distributed systems with strong focus on reliability, performance, observability and operational excellence.

  • Partner with engineering leaders across the organisation to improve developer productivity, engineering velocity and system reliability.

  • Build and develop a strong engineering leadership layer and help principal and senior engineers grow their technical leadership.

  • Lead distributed engineering teams through managers and create an environment where senior technical talent can do their best work.

  • Drive engineering excellence across areas including service runtime, observability, scaling, service communication, data consistency, developer tooling, networking, security and infrastructure.

  • Own and influence significant infrastructure and platform investments including engineering efficiency and cloud cost optimisation.

  • Work closely with Product, Data, Engineering and executive stakeholders to shape technical strategy and influence business outcomes.

  • Operate effectively across multiple markets, teams and cultures within Carousell Group.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success will mean:

  • Our engineering teams are increasingly AI-native and effective in using agentic engineering practices.

  • Our platform and infrastructure can scale reliably with the growth of the business.

  • Engineering teams have strong internal platforms, tooling and infrastructure that allow them to move faster without compromising reliability.

  • Senior technical talent is being developed into stronger technical and organisational leaders.

  • Platform and infrastructure investments are managed with a strong balance between engineering quality, reliability, developer productivity and cost.

  • You become a trusted technical partner to engineering and business leaders across Carousell Group.

What We're Looking For

Must Have

  • Significant experience leading large-scale engineering organisations in Platform Engineering, Infrastructure / SRE and/or Data Engineering.

  • Deep technical expertise in at least two of the three areas while having enough breadth across all three to effectively lead teams with deeper specialists.

  • Strong hands-on experience driving AI-native or agentic engineering adoption within an engineering organisation.

  • Strong distributed systems architecture and design expertise.

  • A track record of successfully building, scaling and operating high-scale platforms or systems.

  • Experience leading complex technical initiatives from architecture through execution and operations.

  • Strong technical judgement with the ability to engage credibly with Principal and Senior Engineers.

Good to Have

  • Experience mentoring and developing Principal / Senior Engineers and building strong technical leadership pipelines.

  • Experience owning cloud infrastructure or platform costs at significant scale.

  • Experience leading distributed engineering organisations of 15–30+ engineers through an EM layer.

  • Experience working in a multi-brand, multi-market or multi-business-unit organisation.

  • Experience working across different geographies and cultures.

  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder influence.

By proceeding with your application, you are adhering to our PDPA policies. In case you are interested to know more, read about our Candidates Personal Data Privacy Statement.

About Carousell Group

Carousell Group is the leading multi-category platform for secondhand in Greater Southeast Asia on a mission to make secondhand the first choice. Founded in August 2012 in Singapore, the Group has a leading presence in seven markets under the brands Carousell, Carousell Media Group, Cho Tot, Laku6, LuxLexicon, Mudah.my, OneShift, REFASH and Revo Financial, serving tens of millions of monthly active users. Carousell is backed by leading investors including Telenor Group, Rakuten Ventures, Naver, STIC Investments, 500 Global and Peak XV Partners (formerly known as Sequoia Capital India).

As a team of passionate individuals working together to solve meaningful problems, there is so much more for you to discover in a career with Carousell. Our culture is made up of hiring, developing, and promoting people who embody our values of HEART, which is an acronym for Humility, Empathy, Accountability, Relentlessly resourceful and Teamwork. Together as an organisation, we make magic happen.
