About AJC

American Jewish Committee (AJC) is the global advocacy organization for the Jewish people. We create trusted partnerships with leaders around the world to ensure Jews and Israel are safe and thriving.

With an unparalleled reach spanning six continents, AJC engages leaders in more than 110 countries through 40 offices and dozens of partnerships with Jewish communities worldwide. Wherever the Jewish people and Israel need us, AJC is there—empowering leaders in government, education, partner communities, and the private sector to counter antisemitism and act as allies.

The challenges we face are global. AJC is leading the global response. Join us.

Your Department

AJC uses marketing, branding, communications, and social media to educate the public and shape opinion in pursuit of our mission. We leverage our vast global media presence—which includes the largest social media following of any Jewish organization—as an essential part of our advocacy arsenal.

Your Impact

This position makes an impact at AJC by planning, overseeing, and developing work with significant impact on the organization's mission and goals; manages a small team. Works with significant latitude to solve complex problems and make strategically important decisions impacting the department.

The incumbent leads the visual strategy to increase brand awareness and support the agency's mission. This position is responsible for overseeing all agency-wide design projects, overseeing the work of the Graphics Team, and ensuring AJC's visual presence is consistent and impactful across all platforms.

Your Role

  • Conceptualize and direct the visual strategy to increase AJC’s brand awareness in a crowded marketplace and build support for the agency’s mission and advocacy objectives
  • Generate and oversee all agency design projects, including promotional brochures, event collateral, direct mail fundraising packages, AJC.org website, AJC’s social media platforms, email templates, and environmental graphics
  • Lead a talented Graphics Team in creating engaging, relevant, and inspiring visual designs
  • Manage and mentor AJC’s in-house Graphics Team, overseeing an annual goal-setting process, identifying professional development opportunities for all team members, and overseeing the day-to-day operations of the team
  • Maintain and manage a roster of freelance designers, illustrators, photographers, and external print shops
  • Review, adjust, and implement best practices for AJC’s in-house Graphics Team and print shop, ensuring the use of state-of-the-art technology and techniques
  • Collaborate with key Marketing and Communications stakeholders, especially the Senior Director of Brand Marketing, to plan major marketing initiatives, like the annual end-of-year fundraising campaign
  • Play a key role in setting AJC brand guidelines and ensuring adherence across the agency for all print, digital, and environmental designs
  • Partner with the video specialist to provide creative oversight for all externally-produced video projects
  • Create and maintain a consistent brand look across AJC offices representing AJC’s global and regional prominence
  • Maintain a deep knowledge of compelling visuals relevant to AJC’s priority issue areas and audiences
  • Generate and oversee the vision for AJC Global Forum collateral and environmental graphics
  • Serve as a consultant and stakeholder to the Department’s efforts to maintain AJC’s digital asset management system, ensuring proper licenses/rights for images and easy accessibility across the agency
  • Oversee designs requested by internal clients and train all staff on how to interface with the Graphics Team
  • Seek insights from end-users to develop design and graphic request operations best practices
  • Identify, negotiate contracts for, manage, and evaluate outside design, photography, and printing vendors, ensuring contracted projects are completed on time and within budget
  • Lead all graphics, photography, fabrication, and other visual experiential initiatives, including related vendors, at major AJC events, working outside of normal business hours in the weeks up to and during such events
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of design trends in the Jewish communal organization sector, social media advocacy, and digital advocacy
  • Prepare and monitor the annual graphics budget in consultation with AJC’s accounting department and the SVP of Marketing and Communications.
  • Research and recommend efficient and justifiable purchases for the graphics team and print shop
  • Support AJC regional and overseas offices and national departments with design and branding requests
  • Present final layouts for approval, explaining the creative with clear rationale
  • Review and approve proofs of printed artwork and copy.

Supervisory Role

Medium office/team of 4-7

Education, Training, and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 8-10+ years of related work experience
  • 12+ years of graphic design experience, preferable in an agency or non-profit setting.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Passion for the mission, goals, and objectives of AJC
  • Committed to AJC’s core values: respect, accountability, integrity, innovation, and collaboration
  • Demonstrates professionalism and high standards of conduct
  • Ability to work collaboratively with individuals from diverse backgrounds
  • Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and listening)
  • Strong organization and project management skills, including the ability to set priorities and meet deadlines
  • Capacity to multitask and work in a fast-paced and changing environment
  • Willing and able to work outside of standard working hours, including early mornings, evenings, and/or weekends
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Teams, and Outlook), Google Suite applications, and Zoom
  • Proficient in Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign
  • Understanding of web production and digital design elements
  • Familiarity with video production
  • Strong managerial skills and the ability to direct, motivate, and develop individuals and/or teams
  • Experience with, and ability to oversee, the installation of all event fabrications along with oversight of photography and graphics at major events.

We are looking for a Director - Developer Platforms, Infra, Data Engineering and Platform to lead and evolve the engineering platforms and infrastructure that power Carousell Group at scale.

This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who can operate across Platform Engineering, Infrastructure / SRE and Data Engineering and go deep in at least two of these areas.

You will help shape how our engineering organisation builds, operates and scales systems while driving the adoption of AI-native and agentic engineering practices across the organisation.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable operating at both strategic and technical depth. You should be able to engage with senior engineers on architecture and technical decisions while also leading managers and engineering organisations through complex, multi-year initiatives.

What You Will Do

  • Lead and evolve our platform, infrastructure and engineering capabilities to support highly scalable and reliable systems across Carousell Group.

  • Drive agentic engineering and AI adoption across engineering teams, leading from the front with hands-on experience applying AI to engineering workflows and software development.

  • Provide technical direction across Platform Engineering, Infrastructure / SRE and Data Engineering and make sound architecture decisions across these areas.

  • Lead the design and operation of highly scalable distributed systems with strong focus on reliability, performance, observability and operational excellence.

  • Partner with engineering leaders across the organisation to improve developer productivity, engineering velocity and system reliability.

  • Build and develop a strong engineering leadership layer and help principal and senior engineers grow their technical leadership.

  • Lead distributed engineering teams through managers and create an environment where senior technical talent can do their best work.

  • Drive engineering excellence across areas including service runtime, observability, scaling, service communication, data consistency, developer tooling, networking, security and infrastructure.

  • Own and influence significant infrastructure and platform investments including engineering efficiency and cloud cost optimisation.

  • Work closely with Product, Data, Engineering and executive stakeholders to shape technical strategy and influence business outcomes.

  • Operate effectively across multiple markets, teams and cultures within Carousell Group.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success will mean:

  • Our engineering teams are increasingly AI-native and effective in using agentic engineering practices.

  • Our platform and infrastructure can scale reliably with the growth of the business.

  • Engineering teams have strong internal platforms, tooling and infrastructure that allow them to move faster without compromising reliability.

  • Senior technical talent is being developed into stronger technical and organisational leaders.

  • Platform and infrastructure investments are managed with a strong balance between engineering quality, reliability, developer productivity and cost.

  • You become a trusted technical partner to engineering and business leaders across Carousell Group.

What We're Looking For

Must Have

  • Significant experience leading large-scale engineering organisations in Platform Engineering, Infrastructure / SRE and/or Data Engineering.

  • Deep technical expertise in at least two of the three areas while having enough breadth across all three to effectively lead teams with deeper specialists.

  • Strong hands-on experience driving AI-native or agentic engineering adoption within an engineering organisation.

  • Strong distributed systems architecture and design expertise.

  • A track record of successfully building, scaling and operating high-scale platforms or systems.

  • Experience leading complex technical initiatives from architecture through execution and operations.

  • Strong technical judgement with the ability to engage credibly with Principal and Senior Engineers.

Good to Have

  • Experience mentoring and developing Principal / Senior Engineers and building strong technical leadership pipelines.

  • Experience owning cloud infrastructure or platform costs at significant scale.

  • Experience leading distributed engineering organisations of 15–30+ engineers through an EM layer.

  • Experience working in a multi-brand, multi-market or multi-business-unit organisation.

  • Experience working across different geographies and cultures.

  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder influence.

By proceeding with your application, you are adhering to our PDPA policies. In case you are interested to know more, read about our Candidates Personal Data Privacy Statement.

About Carousell Group

Carousell Group is the leading multi-category platform for secondhand in Greater Southeast Asia on a mission to make secondhand the first choice. Founded in August 2012 in Singapore, the Group has a leading presence in seven markets under the brands Carousell, Carousell Media Group, Cho Tot, Laku6, LuxLexicon, Mudah.my, OneShift, REFASH and Revo Financial, serving tens of millions of monthly active users. Carousell is backed by leading investors including Telenor Group, Rakuten Ventures, Naver, STIC Investments, 500 Global and Peak XV Partners (formerly known as Sequoia Capital India).

As a team of passionate individuals working together to solve meaningful problems, there is so much more for you to discover in a career with Carousell. Our culture is made up of hiring, developing, and promoting people who embody our values of HEART, which is an acronym for Humility, Empathy, Accountability, Relentlessly resourceful and Teamwork. Together as an organisation, we make magic happen.

raw.description:
Local Progress is seeking a Senior Staff Attorney

Position Location: Remote, U.S.

About Local Progress and Local Progress Impact Lab

Local Progress and the Local Progress Impact Lab work collectively to advance a racial and economic justice agenda through all levels of government. Local Progress (LP) is a movement of more than 1,800 local elected officials advancing a racial and economic justice agenda through all levels of local government. The Local Progress Impact Lab (the Impact Lab) brings together local leaders, partners, and experts to build the knowledge, skills, and leadership needed to advance racial and economic justice at the local level.

About the Position:

Working as part of a national legal and policy team, the Senior Staff Attorney will provide legal, policy, and research support to local elected officials in a variety of geographies, with particular emphasis on the organization’s priority issue areas, which include immigrant justice, economic justice and worker power, reimagining public safety, home rule and local democracy, and advancing housing justice for all. In light of growing attacks on democracy and marginalized communities, the Senior Staff Attorney will be tasked with leading and supporting a number of strategies and tactics which include, for example, providing legal analysis on specific local policies, drafting amicus briefs and other litigation tactics, and coming up with creative policy solutions for local leaders to govern despite state and federal preemption.

The Senior Staff Attorney will play a leading role in driving the organization’s work on advancing immigrant justice. This role will collaborate with national, state, and local partners to advance shared goals of protecting immigrant communities from federal attacks and advancing a proactive vision of full immigrant inclusion.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is eager to build the policy and legal capacity of the Local Progress network, which is comprised of elected officials serving in cities, counties, and school boards, as well as closely collaborate with these members in working hand-in-hand with impacted communities to win transformational local policy on some of the most pressing issues facing communities today. This role will provide timely resources, strategy, and collaboration to Local Progress members on the forefront of these efforts, and lead the organization’s Immigrant Justice Steering Committee to set and implement network-wide goals and programming..

The Senior Staff Attorney will report to the Managing Director, Legal and Policy.

Location: This is a remote position based in the U.S. with no in-office requirement.

Travel Requirement: This position is required to travel to in-person events up to six days a month.

Primary Responsibilities.

  • Legal and Policy
    • Produce, edit, and review legal memos, amicus briefs, and other legal documents; manage and oversee the production of such documents by partners.
    • Lead development of resources that enable us to move members into action across the full diversity of our network, test and popularize bold policy ideas, and model collaborative governance in our work, including policy briefs, campaign toolkits, template resolutions, and training curricula.
    • Engage with LP staff, members and partners to assess and advise on policy and legal questions, and perform research and policy analysis to respond to those questions, sometimes in rapid response situations.
  • Issue Area Programming
    • Serve as the expert and lead strategist for the organization’s work on immigrant justice.
    • Envision, plan, and implement program offerings to advance immigrant justice, both in-person and virtual.
      • LP and the Impact Lab’s programs include webinars, interactive meetings, virtual working groups, in-person gatherings, site visits, and large-scale conferences involving anywhere from a few to several hundred elected officials, government staffers, and allies. Find examples here, here, and here.
    • Staff the Immigrant Justice Steering Committee comprised of Local Progress members and develop the leadership of the Steering Committee’s members
    • Build and maintain strong working relationships with external partners on immigrant justice.
    • Additional issue area policy leadership as needed, including potentially land use, procurement, legal authority of counties, and first amendment / democracy protections.
  • Support Local Progress and the Impact Lab's work
    • Collaborate across Local Progress teams to support organizational activities and infrastructure including caucus work, state chapter activities, Collaborative Governance Academy trainings, reports, convenings, web products, etc.
    • Play a supporting role in maintaining funder relationships and identifying new opportunities for expanding support.

Required Qualifications:

  • A juris doctor degree and admission to a state bar.
  • At least 9 years of relevant policy or legal experience and at least 4 years working on immigrant justice issues via policy, organizing, direct legal representation, impact litigation, etc..
  • Experience with organizing and campaigns, including working with organizers or movement lawyering.
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey and translate complex information for a variety of audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, create and execute work plans, anticipate obstacles and identify ways to navigate challenges, and identify and involve stakeholders appropriately.
  • Awareness of and ability to address issues of power, race, class, gender, and other forms of privilege within the internal dynamics and culture of a workplace.
  • A demonstrated commitment to social, racial, and economic justice and interest in local policy, politics, and government.
  • Experience in relational organizing and an ability to relate to and move to action a diverse group of people from a variety of local contexts and backgrounds, including in a virtual setting.
  • Ability to take initiative and exercise strategic judgment.
  • Ability to travel monthly.

The Ideal Candidate Will Have:

  • Experience with “inside/outside” strategies and movement governance that features deep partnership between “outside” organizing and “inside” elected officials.
  • Litigation experience.
  • Familiarity with core municipal authorities including land use, zoning, and procurement.

Salary and Benefits:

Salary will be determined according to a salary scale which takes into account years of experience and advanced degrees, and will be between $108,600 and $111,000.

This position is included in a union-represented collective bargaining unit, and specific terms and conditions of employment will be subject to a collective bargaining agreement. With a collectively bargained salary scale, we are not able to negotiate once a salary offer is calculated based on the factors that determine placement on the scale.

We operate with a default schedule of Monday through Thursday. We have a generous benefits package, including health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, five weeks of vacation per year, 20 sick days per year, paid holidays, and contributions to individuals’ 403(b) plans. The Local Progress office is closed between December 24 and January 1 annually.

Timeline:

Applicants will be screened on a rolling basis, so we encourage applicants to apply as soon as possible. We encourage applicants to apply by October 9, 2026, for an anticipated start date of January 19, 2027. If you have any time constraints, please indicate as much in your application.

How to apply:

Please submit your cover letter and resume through the JazzHR portal.

Local Progress Values

  • Respect: We value people and treat each other with dignity. We strive to understand each other as full human beings, and give each other grace and room to grow.
  • Honesty: We communicate directly with each other, are honest about our strengths and our shortcomings, and are transparent about who has what level of information and authority and why.
  • Groundedness: We are authentic, and have high humility and low ego. We ground our work in the day-to-day reality and needs of our members.
  • Mutual accountability: We do what we say we're going to do, follow through on our commitments to each other and to our members, and we hold each other to a high bar. We self-reflect and develop each other’s skills as leaders.
  • Nuance: We understand that our work is complex and hold space for multiple viewpoints, contradictions, and tensions. We can hold many things as true while making decisions that advance our mission.
  • Impact: We empower our team to make decisions to drive their work. We are focused on results, persistent in overcoming obstacles, and adapt to changing external conditions. We take pride in our work.
  • Collaboration: We come together across different levels of power to advance shared interests. We center what’s best for the organization and are team players.
  • Joy: We value playfulness, humor, and joy as ways to create community, connection, and goodwill that sustains us through the challenges inherent in our work.

Local Progress is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and actively recruits people of color, womxn, individuals with disabilities, and members of the LGBTIQAA+ community.

Description

About Our Team

Our employees thrive in a culture that is fast-paced, collaborative, and ego-free, where innovation and teamwork are encouraged at every level. We provide Federal agencies with immediate access to highly skilled professionals who understand complex mission challenges and deliver efficient, scalable solutions. By continuously investing in talent, technology, and specialized capabilities, we maintain expert teams prepared to support evolving Federal missions through tailored technical solutions and modern service delivery approaches.

We value diverse perspectives and strive to attract talent from all backgrounds. We are seeking professionals who are passionate about technology, mission success, and solving complex operational challenges with creativity and purpose. If you enjoy expanding your technical expertise while supporting impactful Federal initiatives, you will thrive within our organization. Veterans and military spouses are strongly encouraged to apply and bring their valuable experience to our team.

About the Role

Our company is seeking a highly skilled IRIS/Cache ObjectScript/MUMPS developer to join our fast-growing IT-project based consulting business. Our team is working with a large federal agency to modernize all aspects of their health services application portfolio and we need top notch technical skills to get it done! We need a well-rounded team member with a background in InterSystems IRIS ObjectScript, MUMPS/CACHE development and integration that can work within an Agile team environment to maintain, enhance, integrate, and modernize healthcare applications, including VistA applications.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with InterSystems IRIS and ObjectScript, including development using ObjectScript routines, classes, methods as well as globals, data structures, and database capabilities. Experience working with legacy MUMPS/CACHE applications and transitioning or integrating those applications with IRIS-based solutions is highly valuable.

We're seeking talented and bright team players who are passionate about technology and want to work in a fast-paced, dynamic, and ego-free culture while applying a creative approach to problem-solving. Team members who like to grow their skill sets while solving challenging, real world business problems thrive on our team. By joining our team, you’ll become a part of a fun and diverse team of talented and creative people who share the goal of using the latest technology to solve business challenges.

The IRIS/Cache ObjectScript/MUMPS developer will collaborate with a mix of technical experts and architects, business/product owners, business analysts, technical writers, testers, and scrum masters in a DevSecOps focused, Agile-Scrum environment. Our team members must have a proactive nature. We're looking for team members who are eager to problem solve, collaborate with business and technical team members, willing to learn, and always show great initiative in their daily pursuits.

Responsibilities

  • Provide technical expertise in InterSystems IRIS ObjectScript and MUMPS/CACHE development, integration, and deployment.
  • Design, develop, test, and maintain applications using IRIS ObjectScript.
  • Develop and maintain ObjectScript routines, classes, methods, globals, and data structures.
  • Work with both object-oriented ObjectScript development and traditional MUMPS code as required by existing healthcare applications.
  • Support the maintenance, enhancement, modernization, and integration of VistA and other healthcare applications.
  • Support HL7 messaging, healthcare interoperability, and healthcare data management initiatives.
  • Develop and support interfaces and integrations between IRIS, VistA, and external healthcare systems.
  • Work with IRIS database technologies, including globals, persistent classes, and SQL-based data access.
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex application, integration, and database issues.
  • Support modernization and migration efforts involving legacy MUMPS/CACHE applications and InterSystems IRIS.
  • Work within an Agile Scrum and DevSecOps environment.
  • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable software solutions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define requirements and system architecture.
  • Write clean, efficient, and maintainable ObjectScript/MUMPS code.
  • Participate in backlog refinement, estimation, and sprint activities.

TAG:

TAG: INDMJC

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 2+ years of experience with InterSystems IRIS ObjectScript and/or MUMPS/Caché software development.
  • Hands-on experience developing and maintaining ObjectScript routines, classes, methods, globals, and data structures.
  • Experience working with InterSystems IRIS or Caché database technologies.
  • Experience with MUMPS development and the ability to work with existing legacy MUMPS code.
  • Experience with HL7 messaging development and integration.
  • Knowledge of software development, web applications, REST APIs, web services, and architectural patterns.
  • Experience troubleshooting application, database, and integration issues.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and client-facing skills.
  • Ability to understand user requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.
  • Ability to work remotely.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing or supporting VA VistA applications.
  • Experience modernizing, migrating, or integrating legacy MUMPS/Caché applications with InterSystems IRIS.
  • Experience with IRIS SQL, persistent classes, and object-oriented development.
  • Experience with healthcare interoperability and healthcare data integration.
  • Experience with Agile frameworks and regression testing.
  • Knowledge of VA TRM compliance.
  • Knowledge of Section 508 accessibility requirements.
  • SAFe certification.

    • Experience with database performance monitoring tools, backup/recovery solutions, and data modeling tools.

    • Excellent analytical skills, problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail.

raw.description:
Developer Relations Engineer

🌎 Remote (U.S. or Canada) | 💼 Full-Time | ✈️ Quarterly Travel

About Akuity

With the move to the cloud Kubernetes has become widely adopted by DevOps and Platform Engineering teams, but it has also added complexity. While scaling Kubernetes at Intuit, the Akuity founders started building Argo CD in order to streamline the adoption of Kubernetes. Argo CD helps developers own, understand and deploy their K8s deployments via GitOps.

Today, Argo CD is the third most popular project in the CNCF (Cloud Native Computing Foundation) and is used by 70% of companies who are using Kubernetes in production. The list of Argo CD users includes companies like Intuit, BlackRock, Tesla, Major League Baseball, Peloton, and many more.

The team founded Akuity in 2021 to enable enterprises to ship software faster and more reliably with modern GitOps best practices. The Akuity Platform enables teams to manage the development and deployment across hundreds – if not thousands – of Kubernetes clusters from a single control plane. Trusted by top companies around the globe, the Akuity Platform provides the only end-to-end GitOps platform for the enterprises.

Our mission is to simplify the software delivery process so that DevOps and Platform Engineering teams can move fast, and deploy code effortlessly without the fear of breaking things.

The Opportunity

This is a hybrid technical role focused on bridging the gap between Akuity and its developer community by combining software engineering with developer relations. Responsibilities include creating technical content like tutorials and demos, providing developer support, gathering feedback for product teams, and engaging with the community at events and online. This role helps drive product adoption by ensuring the developer experience is positive and effective.

What You’ll Do

  • Content Creation: Develop technical assets such as code samples, SDKs, demos, tutorials, documentation, and blog posts to help developers use a company's product.
  • Community Engagement: Actively participate in online forums, social media, and other community channels to answer questions, provide support, and gather feedback.
  • Technical Support: Serve as a point of contact for external developers, helping them resolve technical issues and offering guidance.
  • Event Participation: Represent the company at developer conferences, meetups, and workshops, and potentially help organize these events.
  • Collaboration: Work with internal product and engineering teams to relay developer feedback and contribute to improving the overall developer experience and tools.
  • Evangelism: Advocate for the company's technology by presenting its value and capabilities to the broader developer community.

What We Look For

Must Have

  • Technical Expertise: A strong background in software development to build credible demos and understand developer workflows.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for creating content, giving presentations, and interacting with the community.
  • Empathy: The ability to understand and relate to the challenges and needs of other developers.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong problem-solving abilities to help developers overcome technical hurdles.
  • Community Focus: A passion for building and nurturing relationships with developers and contributing to open-source communities.

Why Akuity?

At Akuity, we believe open-source software is the most impactful way to build lasting technology. We founded this company to advocate for Argo, share our expertise, and be a trusted partner to its users.

Our culture is grounded in humility, authenticity, and diversity. We value people from different backgrounds and paths in life. We trust our team members to take ownership, act responsibly, and support one another. If you are collaborative, curious, and dedicated to helping customers succeed, we’d love to meet you.

Akuity is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

  • Architect solutions to meet business requirements
  • Provide thought leadership on new and emerging SAP technologies and the alignment to customer’s strategic and near-term roadmaps and plans

Required:

  • Proven leadership in managing SAP teams
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of SAP Public Sector.
  • Experience operating in an Agile/SAFe delivery environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Management Systems or a related discipline. Equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of degree.

Desired:

  • Experience with federal shared service providers (e.g., USDA NFC, GSA, DFAS).

-

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. $105,100-$231,100

raw.title: Junior Fullstack Developer 2.0 (PHP + React + Cursor/Windsurf)
raw.excerpt: Szukamy Junior Developerów do zespołu IT w związku z intensywnym rozwojem organizacji, mających już solidne podstawy i chcących programować z AI.
raw.description:
Szukamy Junior Developerów do zespołu IT w związku z intensywnym rozwojem organizacji, mających już solidne podstawy i chcących programować z AI. Jeśli nie pracowałeś jeszcze z AI - najlepiej zacznij :) (będzie to potrzebne w rekrutacji i w pracy). Po nawiązaniu współpracy możemy Ci pokazać to i owo, jak można mądrze wykorzystywać AI w developmencie.

Stare czasy w IT minęły, nowa era rozwoju oprogramowania już tu jest - w Telemedi dołączamy do prekursorów zmian w procesie developmentu. Wierzymy, że łącząc użycie najnowszych technologii z biegłością techniczną i ponadprzeciętnym zaangażowaniem możemy budować więcej, szybciej, i lepiej, niż to było kiedykolwiek możliwe.

Developerzy w naszym IT pracują z Cursor AI (cursor.com) - to IDE zmienia kompletnie paradygmat programowania. My potrafimy w kilka godzin zrobić to, co innym deweloperom zajmuje kilka dni. I tego też będziemy oczekiwać od Ciebie.

Aplikuj do nas, jeśli:

  • chcesz pracować w firmie produktowej, w której domena biznesowa jest bardzo ciekawa, rozległa i złożona, a Twoja praca dziś przekłada się na wymierny efekt jutro
  • jesteś ambitny i chcesz się rozwijać nie przez kursy, tylko w boju
  • masz solidne podstawy teoretyczne i/lub praktyczne do nowoczesnego programowania
  • lubisz dynamiczne środowisko, w którym dużo się dzieje
  • czujesz i bierzesz odpowiedzialność za to, co robisz Ty i cały zespół
  • chętnie i otwarcie przyjmujesz konstruktywny feedback do wykonywanej pracy
  • nie boisz się wyzwań, i odnajdziesz się w skomplikowanej aplikacji
  • lubisz poznawać biznes i dobrze się komunikujesz z innymi (nie tylko w IT)
  • potrafisz szybko i sprawnie tworzyć jakościowe aplikacje / feature’y
  • chętnie poprawiasz procesy wokół siebie

Twoje zadania:

  • udział w tworzeniu rozwiązań IT od początku do końca (u nas IT nie jest “silosem”)
  • rozwój aplikacji webowych (nowe funkcje, bugfixing, refactors)
  • udział w projektowaniu architektury nowych rozwiązań i infrastruktury deweloperskiej
  • udział w code review i dbałość o jakość tworzonych rozwiązań
  • stałe podnoszenie standardów procesów developmentu
  • ścisła współpraca z zespołem (Devs, PMs/POs, QAs)
  • dbanie o wysoką jakość programistyczną i wysokie tempo dostarczanych zadań (indywidualnie i jako team)

Requirements

  • Solidnych podstaw z wiedzy dot. programowania - dla Juniorów: min. ukończone studia (licencjat/inżynier) z kierunków informatycznych lub pokrewnych, LUB min. 2 lata komercyjnego doświadczenia w pracy z PHP +
  • Chęci i umiejętności bardzo szybkiego uczenia się i poznawania skomplikowanych aspektów rozwiązań technicznych
  • Umiejętności korzystania z nowoczesnych narzędzi AI w programowaniu (jak Cursor / Windsurf - Github Copilot nie jest “good enough”). Nie musisz mieć w tym doświadczenia - ale musisz rozumieć paradygmat i mieć to "przećwiczone".
  • Praktycznej znajomości wzorców projektowych i dobrych praktyk programowania (SOLID, KISS, DRY itd)
  • Sprawności w pracy z systemami kontroli wersji, np. Git.
  • Ownershipu - samodzielności i odpowiedzialności za powierzone zadania
  • Dokładności i sumienności w pracy (indywidualnie i w zespole)
  • Płynnej znajomości języka polskiego.

Mile widziane:

  • Znajomość zagadnień zw. z wydajnością i optymalizacją aplikacji web.
  • Znajomość zagadnień zw. z infrastrukturą aplikacji w chmurze (np. GCP)
  • Doświadczenie w rozwoju architektury mikroserwisowej.
  • Praktyczna znajomość obszaru środowisk skonteneryzowanych (Docker)
  • Doświadczenia w pisaniu testów jednostkowych i integracyjnych.
  • Doświadczenie komercyjne z Node.js / Nest.js

Pracujemy z:

  • Backend: Symfony, PHP + MySQL/PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, GraphQL, Hasura
    • architektura: mikroserwisy + duży monolit
  • Frontend: React.js + Typescript + Twig w panelach admina
  • Infrastruktura: Google Cloud Platform + Kubernetes, Datadog
  • Build (CI): Docker, Github Actions
  • Kontrola wersji: Github
  • Issue Tracker: JIRA, Confluence
  • Testy: PHPUnit + Playwright + QA manualne

Benefits

  • Wynagrodzenie: 8 000 - 13 000 PLN netto (B2B)
  • Elastyczny model pracy (hybrid/remote)
  • Opieka medyczna
  • Karta Multisport
  • Współpraca w oparciu o B2B lub umowę zlecenie

Co wyróżni Cię spośród innych kandydatów:

  • Twoja zdolność do myślenia poza schematami
  • Komunikatywność - jasna, klarowna i rzeczowa
  • Umiejętność rozwiązywania problemów "end to end".

Nasze wartości

  • Organizational "YES": Witamy osoby, które z entuzjazmem podchodzą do zmian i nowych możliwości.
  • 5x why, first principles: Zachęcamy do zadawania pytań "dlaczego?" i szukania lepszych rozwiązań.
  • Data-driven: Wspieramy decyzje rzetelnymi danymi i analizami. Zawsze weryfikujemy informacje u źródła - nie przyjmujemy założeń bez sprawdzenia faktów i danych.
  • Startup mindset: Cenimy szybkie działanie i eksperymentowanie poprzez prototypy.
  • Getting things done as an A-player: Koncentrujemy się na realnych efektach i wspólnie świętujemy sukcesy. Nie tolerujemy zaniedbań i nie popełniamy błędów wynikających z niedbalstwa.
  • Transparency: Stawiamy na radykalnie szczerą komunikację w duchu "radical candor" - feedback jest bezpośredni, konstruktywny i natychmiastowy. Mówimy otwarcie co działa, a co wymaga poprawy.
  • Sense of urgency: Działamy sprawnie i efektywnie, dążąc do szybkiej realizacji celów.
  • Accountability: Nie chowamy głowy w piasek - otwarcie przyznajemy gdy coś nie działa i bierzemy odpowiedzialność za wprowadzanie niezbędnych zmian.

Co nie wpisuje się w naszą kulturę pracy

  • Ignorowanie problemów.
  • Brak zaangażowania w testowanie nowych inicjatyw.
  • Opieranie działań na nieaktualnych danych i brak elastyczności w działaniu.
  • Unikanie odpowiedzialności
  • Stagnacja: Oczekiwanie, że metody, które były efektywne w przeszłości, będą działać na zawsze.
  • Przeciwstawianie się zmianie
  • Brak transparentności
  • Niewłaściwe zarządzanie czasem. Brak pilności w działaniu.
  • Odkładanie zadań na później
  • Ignorowanie problemów
  • Popełnianie błędów wynikających z zaniedbania

Etapy procesu rekrutacyjnego:

  1. krótki quiz online (5-10 min)
  2. zadanie techniczne
  3. rozmowa z Hiring Managerem
  4. (opcjonalnie) Assessment Day dla wybranych kandydatów

Dzięki takim etapom rekrutacji nie wymagamy dużego zaangażowania czasowego na początku, proces rekrutacyjny idzie sprawnie (feedback dostajesz szybko!) oraz możemy dać szansę szerszemu gronu kandydatów.

Jeżeli uważasz, że jesteś właściwą osobą do tego stanowiska, skontaktuj się z nami i dołącz do zespołu, który naprawdę robi różnicę! W swoim CV pokaż nam, że jesteś komandosem, którego szukamy.

Nie zwlekaj, dołącz do nas już dziś!

raw.description:
NTT DATA Services strives to hire exceptional, innovative, and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

Service Desk Analyst – Clinical Applications Support

NTT DATA is looking for Service Desk / Help Desk professionals to join our Healthcare Provider Clinical Service Desk, supporting healthcare organizations and clinicians in a 24x7x365 environment.

As a Service Desk Analyst, you will be the first point of contact for healthcare customers experiencing technical and application-related issues. You’ll troubleshoot problems, document incidents, assist users with clinical applications, and either resolve issues directly or escalate them to the appropriate support team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong customer-service mindset who enjoys technical troubleshooting, problem solving, and working in a fast-paced Service Desk environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Handle inbound calls from healthcare professionals and clinical staff requiring technical and application support.
  • Troubleshoot issues involving clinical applications such as Epic, Cerner, McKesson, and Meditech.
  • Support users with issues including:
    • Application errors and functionality
    • Workflow and usability issues
    • User access and login problems
    • Basic technical troubleshooting
  • Ask effective questions and use strong listening skills to understand the caller's issue and determine the appropriate resolution.
  • Document troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and other relevant information accurately in the service management/ticketing system.
  • Resolve incidents when possible and escalate more complex issues to the appropriate support teams.
  • Follow established procedures and service levels to ensure incidents are handled and resolved in a timely manner.
  • Provide a professional, patient, and service-oriented experience to clinicians and healthcare customers.
  • Work effectively in a high-volume, fast-paced call center / Service Desk environment.

Work Environment & Schedule

This is a 24x7x365 Service Desk operation, so candidates must be comfortable working a flexible shift schedule.

  • Night, weekend, and holiday shifts are required.
  • Shifts may be 8–10 hours with scheduled breaks.
  • Schedules may change based on client, business, and training requirements.
  • Overtime may occasionally be required.
  • Initial account-specific training is conducted during daytime hours, regardless of your eventual assigned shift.
  • The position is primarily desk-based and requires extended periods of working at a computer and in the phone queue.

What You’ll Need

Required:

  • At least 1 year of experience in a Call Center, Customer Service, Service Desk, Help Desk, or Application Support environment.
  • At least 1 year of technical troubleshooting experience.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Strong listening and problem-solving abilities.
  • Comfortable working with computers and reading information on screen for extended periods.
  • Ability to work independently while following established processes and procedures.
  • A strong customer-service mindset and professional approach when working with users and colleagues.

Preferred:

  • 4+ years of Service Desk / Help Desk experience, or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience.
  • Experience supporting clinical or healthcare applications.
  • Experience working in a high-volume call center or Service Desk.
  • Experience with applications such as Epic, Cerner, McKesson, or Meditech.
  • Experience working in a 24x7 support environment.
  • Healthcare IT or clinical technology experience.

Remote Work Requirements

Candidates working remotely must have:

  • A quiet, private workspace suitable for handling confidential customer calls.
  • Reliable high-speed wired internet.
  • A working cell phone for manager communication and Two-Factor Authentication (2FA).
  • The ability to remain at the designated workspace and available in the phone queue throughout scheduled working periods and breaks.

Additional Requirements

  • Up to 10% travel may be required.
  • Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. when equipment setup is required.
  • Must be legally authorized to work directly for NTT DATA or its applicable subsidiaries. Third-party, temporary, or corp-to-corp contractors will not be considered.

Why Join NTT DATA?

You’ll have the opportunity to build your career in healthcare IT and clinical application support, working directly with healthcare professionals and supporting technology that is critical to patient care.

NTT DATA provides a comprehensive benefits package beginning on your first day of employment, along with the opportunity to develop your technical troubleshooting and healthcare technology expertise in a large-scale Service Desk environment.

Pay Transparency

Where required by law, NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for specific roles. The starting pay range for this remote role is $44,000-$49,034. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s actual work location, relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications.

This position is eligible for company benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance with an employer contribution, flexible spending or health savings account, life and AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program with company match, and additional voluntary or legally-required benefits.

About NTT DATA

NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, .

NTT DATA endeavors to make accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at . Role Description:

We are seeking an experienced Product Engineering Manager. You will play a critical role in managing and developing airgap-native software and ensuring it integrates seamlessly with UDS to Accelerate the ATO. You will oversee the development of innovative solutions that meet customer needs and drive the success of our products in National Defense. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, leadership, and will need a deep understanding of modern software systems.

You will be responsible for guiding a team of talented engineers, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, and delivering high-quality, scalable, and secure products. Collaboration with cross-functional teams, including Product, Growth, and Delivery, is essential to ensure alignment with our company roadmap and customer requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead, inspire, and manage a team of engineers dedicated to developing and maintaining UDS-compatible applications.
  • Own the team's deliverables, ensuring the timely delivery of scalable, highly-available products that exceed customer expectations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to prioritize and manage engineering roadmaps in alignment with Product objectives.
  • Instill a spirit of continuous improvement in code quality, architecture, and processes, driving innovation and efficiency.
  • Mentor and guide the professional and technical development of team members, helping them advance their careers and achieve their goals.
  • Facilitate communication among clients/customers and engineers, ensuring clear understanding of specifications, budgets, and deadlines.
  • Stay abreast of new trends, developments, and technologies to continually improve product lines and production efficiency.

Travel Expectations/Requirements: 10-25%

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise.

Preferred Experience and Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of industry experience, preferably in building, maintaining, and managing platforms and infrastructure.
  • 2+ years of experience managing engineering teams, with experience in a remote, distributed environment.
  • Strong technical background in software engineering, with deep experience in architecting and delivering scalable solutions using cloud providers such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, while deploying cloud-native software to Kubernetes.
  • Proficiency in DevOps principles, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure automation.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and leadership skills, with a track record of inspiring and empowering teams.
  • High level of technical proficiency, with the ability to work within the team to solve complex problems.
  • Detail-oriented, highly organized, and able to prioritize tasks effectively.

Amazing To Haves

  • Contributions to open-source projects or published projects.
  • Familiarity with Cloud-Native technologies including Kubernetes. Experience with Zarf, and the UDS ecosystem is highly desirable.
  • Understanding of the needs of airgapped systems, edge devices, and the implications of semi-disconnected software delivery is a differentiator.
  • Experience in mobile development, particularly Android software development, is a huge plus.

Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience. Compensation ranges are established using national benchmarking data and apply across all geographic locations within the United States.

Remote - USA
$178,500—$241,500 USD

Who We Are

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market.

What We Do

We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily.

Who We Serve

Defense Unicorns’ customers are mission-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products.

raw.description:
Taxwell helps everyday Americans get every tax advantage they deserve by finding credits and deductions they never even knew existed. Our tax preparation software offers easy guidance and ensures your maximum tax refund. We strive to build a team of like-minded experts in both tax and technology who align with our brand purpose, are advocates for our customers and have a fresh, non-traditional approach to the tax industry.

TaxAct is a leading digital tax filing platform which offers customers do-it-yourself digital and downloadable products that are easy-to-use, best-in-class technology, and provide unparalleled customer support. We are a trusted solution for all users including those with complex tax returns. We strive to attract and retain candidates who exemplify our values: performance, perseverance, progress and partnership. TaxAct is a member of the Taxwell family of products. We are an organization of forward thinkers looking to add industry experts to our growing team.

This role will primarily support TaxAct as the organization helps everyday Americans file their taxes. We seek to build a team of experts in tax and technology who are customer advocates and have the mindset to reimagine the services our customers receive.

Job Description

TaxWell is seeking an accomplished Senior Data Analyst to support our product and marketing teams. In this role, you will report to the Director of Analytics and focus primarily on product analytics—uncovering insights through deep funnel analysis, user behavior investigation, anomaly detection, and data storytelling. This is a hands-on, investigative role where you dig into performance data, find the signal in the noise, and help stakeholders understand what is working and what is not.

You will play a critical role in translating complex behavioral, customer journey, funnel, and feature usage data into meaningful insights that inform product strategy, user engagement optimization, and marketing performance. Experience with marketing analytics (campaign performance, paid media, attribution) is a plus, but product analytics will be the primary focus of this role.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Investigate user behavior, customer journey, and conversion funnels across product touchpoints to identify trends, anomalies, and drop-off patterns.

  • Partner with product managers to define and track performance KPIs, evaluate feature adoption, and support data-informed product decisions.

  • Deliver clear, actionable insights that guide product optimization, landing page improvements, and user experience enhancements.

  • Collaborate with marketing operations and product teams to connect funnel insights across the full customer journey.

  • Design and build custom dashboards in Tableau (or similar) to support ongoing performance monitoring and exploratory analysis.

  • Write and refine SQL queries to extract, clean, and analyze large datasets—especially across digital engagement, conversion events, and behavioral data.

  • Perform exploratory analysis to uncover unexpected patterns, detect data integrity issues, and recommend solutions or next steps.

  • Support A/B testing analysis, attribution modeling, and ongoing campaign evaluation as needed.

  • Analyze large data sets of structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data to discover insights and collaborate with business partners to deliver business value.

  • Prepare and effectively present findings to business stakeholders, including executive management, in a concise fashion.

  • Leverage AI-assisted analytics tools (e.g., tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT Codex) to accelerate analysis, improve data exploration, and enhance data storytelling—while maintaining analytical rigor and data quality standards.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, management, accounting, economics, statistics, information science, or a related field required.

  • Minimum of 5+ years of proven working experience as a data analyst, business data analyst, or similar role.

  • Strong emphasis on B2C product analytics, including user behavior analysis, funnel investigation, and feature or journey performance.

  • Marketing analytics experience (paid search, display, brand and variable marketing, campaign performance, ROAS) is a plus.

  • Strong SQL skills, with proven experience querying and transforming large datasets for both ad-hoc analysis and dashboard use.

  • Expertise in Tableau or other BI tools to build insightful, scalable dashboards from scratch.

  • Demonstrated success in anomaly detection, funnel investigation, and actionable insight delivery.

  • Experience with performance metrics such as conversion rate, bounce rate, session duration, feature adoption, and retention; familiarity with ROAS and campaign metrics is a plus.

  • Practical experience using AI tools to support analytics workflows—such as accelerating SQL development, exploratory analysis, documentation, or insight synthesis. Familiarity with agentic or copilot-style analytics tools is a plus; given how recently these capabilities have become viable, formal "years of AI experience" is not expected.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information.

  • Some knowledge of statistics and experience using statistical packages for analyzing datasets (Excel, R, SAS, SPSS, etc.) is desired.

  • Ability to deliver insights with creativity and pragmatism, ensuring a clear understanding of the "so what?" implications.

At Taxwell, we believe our work benefits from the diverse perspectives of our employees. As such, Taxwell welcomes and celebrates diversity and inclusion and is committed to equal opportunity employment. Developer Relations Engineer

🌎 Remote (U.S. or Canada) | 💼 Full-Time | ✈️ Quarterly Travel

About Akuity

With the move to the cloud Kubernetes has become widely adopted by DevOps and Platform Engineering teams, but it has also added complexity. While scaling Kubernetes at Intuit, the Akuity founders started building Argo CD in order to streamline the adoption of Kubernetes. Argo CD helps developers own, understand and deploy their K8s deployments via GitOps.

Today, Argo CD is the third most popular project in the CNCF (Cloud Native Computing Foundation) and is used by 70% of companies who are using Kubernetes in production. The list of Argo CD users includes companies like Intuit, BlackRock, Tesla, Major League Baseball, Peloton, and many more.

The team founded Akuity in 2021 to enable enterprises to ship software faster and more reliably with modern GitOps best practices. The Akuity Platform enables teams to manage the development and deployment across hundreds – if not thousands – of Kubernetes clusters from a single control plane. Trusted by top companies around the globe, the Akuity Platform provides the only end-to-end GitOps platform for the enterprises.

Our mission is to simplify the software delivery process so that DevOps and Platform Engineering teams can move fast, and deploy code effortlessly without the fear of breaking things.

The Opportunity

This is a hybrid technical role focused on bridging the gap between Akuity and its developer community by combining software engineering with developer relations. Responsibilities include creating technical content like tutorials and demos, providing developer support, gathering feedback for product teams, and engaging with the community at events and online. This role helps drive product adoption by ensuring the developer experience is positive and effective.

What You’ll Do

  • Content Creation: Develop technical assets such as code samples, SDKs, demos, tutorials, documentation, and blog posts to help developers use a company's product.
  • Community Engagement: Actively participate in online forums, social media, and other community channels to answer questions, provide support, and gather feedback.
  • Technical Support: Serve as a point of contact for external developers, helping them resolve technical issues and offering guidance.
  • Event Participation: Represent the company at developer conferences, meetups, and workshops, and potentially help organize these events.
  • Collaboration: Work with internal product and engineering teams to relay developer feedback and contribute to improving the overall developer experience and tools.
  • Evangelism: Advocate for the company's technology by presenting its value and capabilities to the broader developer community.

What We Look For

Must Have

  • Technical Expertise: A strong background in software development to build credible demos and understand developer workflows.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for creating content, giving presentations, and interacting with the community.
  • Empathy: The ability to understand and relate to the challenges and needs of other developers.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong problem-solving abilities to help developers overcome technical hurdles.
  • Community Focus: A passion for building and nurturing relationships with developers and contributing to open-source communities.

Why Akuity?

At Akuity, we believe open-source software is the most impactful way to build lasting technology. We founded this company to advocate for Argo, share our expertise, and be a trusted partner to its users.

Our culture is grounded in humility, authenticity, and diversity. We value people from different backgrounds and paths in life. We trust our team members to take ownership, act responsibly, and support one another. If you are collaborative, curious, and dedicated to helping customers succeed, we’d love to meet you.

Akuity is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

  • Solidnych podstaw z wiedzy dot. programowania - dla Juniorów: min. ukończone studia (licencjat/inżynier) z kierunków informatycznych lub pokrewnych, LUB min. 2 lata komercyjnego doświadczenia w pracy z PHP +
  • Chęci i umiejętności bardzo szybkiego uczenia się i poznawania skomplikowanych aspektów rozwiązań technicznych
  • Umiejętności korzystania z nowoczesnych narzędzi AI w programowaniu (jak Cursor / Windsurf - Github Copilot nie jest “good enough”). Nie musisz mieć w tym doświadczenia - ale musisz rozumieć paradygmat i mieć to "przećwiczone".
  • Praktycznej znajomości wzorców projektowych i dobrych praktyk programowania (SOLID, KISS, DRY itd)
  • Sprawności w pracy z systemami kontroli wersji, np. Git.
  • Ownershipu - samodzielności i odpowiedzialności za powierzone zadania
  • Dokładności i sumienności w pracy (indywidualnie i w zespole)
  • Płynnej znajomości języka polskiego.

Mile widziane:

  • Znajomość zagadnień zw. z wydajnością i optymalizacją aplikacji web.
  • Znajomość zagadnień zw. z infrastrukturą aplikacji w chmurze (np. GCP)
  • Doświadczenie w rozwoju architektury mikroserwisowej.
  • Praktyczna znajomość obszaru środowisk skonteneryzowanych (Docker)
  • Doświadczenia w pisaniu testów jednostkowych i integracyjnych.
  • Doświadczenie komercyjne z Node.js / Nest.js

Pracujemy z:

  • Backend: Symfony, PHP + MySQL/PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, GraphQL, Hasura
    • architektura: mikroserwisy + duży monolit
  • Frontend: React.js + Typescript + Twig w panelach admina
  • Infrastruktura: Google Cloud Platform + Kubernetes, Datadog
  • Build (CI): Docker, Github Actions
  • Kontrola wersji: Github
  • Issue Tracker: JIRA, Confluence
  • Testy: PHPUnit + Playwright + QA manualne

Benefits

  • Wynagrodzenie: 8 000 - 13 000 PLN netto (B2B)
  • Elastyczny model pracy (hybrid/remote)
  • Opieka medyczna
  • Karta Multisport
  • Współpraca w oparciu o B2B lub umowę zlecenie

Co wyróżni Cię spośród innych kandydatów:

  • Twoja zdolność do myślenia poza schematami
  • Komunikatywność - jasna, klarowna i rzeczowa
  • Umiejętność rozwiązywania problemów "end to end".

Nasze wartości

  • Organizational "YES": Witamy osoby, które z entuzjazmem podchodzą do zmian i nowych możliwości.
  • 5x why, first principles: Zachęcamy do zadawania pytań "dlaczego?" i szukania lepszych rozwiązań.
  • Data-driven: Wspieramy decyzje rzetelnymi danymi i analizami. Zawsze weryfikujemy informacje u źródła - nie przyjmujemy założeń bez sprawdzenia faktów i danych.
  • Startup mindset: Cenimy szybkie działanie i eksperymentowanie poprzez prototypy.
  • Getting things done as an A-player: Koncentrujemy się na realnych efektach i wspólnie świętujemy sukcesy. Nie tolerujemy zaniedbań i nie popełniamy błędów wynikających z niedbalstwa.
  • Transparency: Stawiamy na radykalnie szczerą komunikację w duchu "radical candor" - feedback jest bezpośredni, konstruktywny i natychmiastowy. Mówimy otwarcie co działa, a co wymaga poprawy.
  • Sense of urgency: Działamy sprawnie i efektywnie, dążąc do szybkiej realizacji celów.
  • Accountability: Nie chowamy głowy w piasek - otwarcie przyznajemy gdy coś nie działa i bierzemy odpowiedzialność za wprowadzanie niezbędnych zmian.

Co nie wpisuje się w naszą kulturę pracy

  • Ignorowanie problemów.
  • Brak zaangażowania w testowanie nowych inicjatyw.
  • Opieranie działań na nieaktualnych danych i brak elastyczności w działaniu.
  • Unikanie odpowiedzialności
  • Stagnacja: Oczekiwanie, że metody, które były efektywne w przeszłości, będą działać na zawsze.
  • Przeciwstawianie się zmianie
  • Brak transparentności
  • Niewłaściwe zarządzanie czasem. Brak pilności w działaniu.
  • Odkładanie zadań na później
  • Ignorowanie problemów
  • Popełnianie błędów wynikających z zaniedbania

Etapy procesu rekrutacyjnego:

  1. krótki quiz online (5-10 min)
  2. zadanie techniczne
  3. rozmowa z Hiring Managerem
  4. (opcjonalnie) Assessment Day dla wybranych kandydatów

Dzięki takim etapom rekrutacji nie wymagamy dużego zaangażowania czasowego na początku, proces rekrutacyjny idzie sprawnie (feedback dostajesz szybko!) oraz możemy dać szansę szerszemu gronu kandydatów.

Jeżeli uważasz, że jesteś właściwą osobą do tego stanowiska, skontaktuj się z nami i dołącz do zespołu, który naprawdę robi różnicę! W swoim CV pokaż nam, że jesteś komandosem, którego szukamy.

Nie zwlekaj, dołącz do nas już dziś!

raw.description:
NTT DATA Services strives to hire exceptional, innovative, and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

Service Desk Analyst – Clinical Applications Support

NTT DATA is looking for Service Desk / Help Desk professionals to join our Healthcare Provider Clinical Service Desk, supporting healthcare organizations and clinicians in a 24x7x365 environment.

As a Service Desk Analyst, you will be the first point of contact for healthcare customers experiencing technical and application-related issues. You’ll troubleshoot problems, document incidents, assist users with clinical applications, and either resolve issues directly or escalate them to the appropriate support team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong customer-service mindset who enjoys technical troubleshooting, problem solving, and working in a fast-paced Service Desk environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Handle inbound calls from healthcare professionals and clinical staff requiring technical and application support.
  • Troubleshoot issues involving clinical applications such as Epic, Cerner, McKesson, and Meditech.
  • Support users with issues including:
    • Application errors and functionality
    • Workflow and usability issues
    • User access and login problems
    • Basic technical troubleshooting
  • Ask effective questions and use strong listening skills to understand the caller's issue and determine the appropriate resolution.
  • Document troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and other relevant information accurately in the service management/ticketing system.
  • Resolve incidents when possible and escalate more complex issues to the appropriate support teams.
  • Follow established procedures and service levels to ensure incidents are handled and resolved in a timely manner.
  • Provide a professional, patient, and service-oriented experience to clinicians and healthcare customers.
  • Work effectively in a high-volume, fast-paced call center / Service Desk environment.

Work Environment & Schedule

This is a 24x7x365 Service Desk operation, so candidates must be comfortable working a flexible shift schedule.

  • Night, weekend, and holiday shifts are required.
  • Shifts may be 8–10 hours with scheduled breaks.
  • Schedules may change based on client, business, and training requirements.
  • Overtime may occasionally be required.
  • Initial account-specific training is conducted during daytime hours, regardless of your eventual assigned shift.
  • The position is primarily desk-based and requires extended periods of working at a computer and in the phone queue.

What You’ll Need

Required:

  • At least 1 year of experience in a Call Center, Customer Service, Service Desk, Help Desk, or Application Support environment.
  • At least 1 year of technical troubleshooting experience.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Strong listening and problem-solving abilities.
  • Comfortable working with computers and reading information on screen for extended periods.
  • Ability to work independently while following established processes and procedures.
  • A strong customer-service mindset and professional approach when working with users and colleagues.

Preferred:

  • 4+ years of Service Desk / Help Desk experience, or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience.
  • Experience supporting clinical or healthcare applications.
  • Experience working in a high-volume call center or Service Desk.
  • Experience with applications such as Epic, Cerner, McKesson, or Meditech.
  • Experience working in a 24x7 support environment.
  • Healthcare IT or clinical technology experience.

Remote Work Requirements

Candidates working remotely must have:

  • A quiet, private workspace suitable for handling confidential customer calls.
  • Reliable high-speed wired internet.
  • A working cell phone for manager communication and Two-Factor Authentication (2FA).
  • The ability to remain at the designated workspace and available in the phone queue throughout scheduled working periods and breaks.

Additional Requirements

  • Up to 10% travel may be required.
  • Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. when equipment setup is required.
  • Must be legally authorized to work directly for NTT DATA or its applicable subsidiaries. Third-party, temporary, or corp-to-corp contractors will not be considered.

Why Join NTT DATA?

You’ll have the opportunity to build your career in healthcare IT and clinical application support, working directly with healthcare professionals and supporting technology that is critical to patient care.

NTT DATA provides a comprehensive benefits package beginning on your first day of employment, along with the opportunity to develop your technical troubleshooting and healthcare technology expertise in a large-scale Service Desk environment.

Pay Transparency

Where required by law, NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for specific roles. The starting pay range for this remote role is $44,000-$49,034. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s actual work location, relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications.

This position is eligible for company benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance with an employer contribution, flexible spending or health savings account, life and AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program with company match, and additional voluntary or legally-required benefits.

About NTT DATA

NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, .

You will oversee the development of innovative solutions that meet customer needs and drive the success of our products in National Defense. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, leadership, and will need a deep understanding of modern software systems.

You will be responsible for guiding a team of talented engineers, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, and delivering high-quality, scalable, and secure products. Collaboration with cross-functional teams, including Product, Growth, and Delivery, is essential to ensure alignment with our company roadmap and customer requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the team's deliverables, ensuring the timely delivery of scalable, highly-available products that exceed customer expectations.
