raw.description:
Taxwell helps everyday Americans get every tax advantage they deserve by finding credits and deductions they never even knew existed. Our tax preparation software offers easy guidance and ensures your maximum tax refund. We strive to build a team of like-minded experts in both tax and technology who align with our brand purpose, are advocates for our customers and have a fresh, non-traditional approach to the tax industry.

TaxAct is a leading digital tax filing platform which offers customers do-it-yourself digital and downloadable products that are easy-to-use, best-in-class technology, and provide unparalleled customer support. We are a trusted solution for all users including those with complex tax returns. We strive to attract and retain candidates who exemplify our values: performance, perseverance, progress and partnership. TaxAct is a member of the Taxwell family of products. We are an organization of forward thinkers looking to add industry experts to our growing team.

This role will primarily support TaxAct as the organization helps everyday Americans file their taxes. We seek to build a team of experts in tax and technology who are customer advocates and have the mindset to reimagine the services our customers receive.

Job Description

TaxWell is seeking an accomplished Senior Data Analyst to support our product and marketing teams. In this role, you will report to the Director of Analytics and focus primarily on product analytics—uncovering insights through deep funnel analysis, user behavior investigation, anomaly detection, and data storytelling. This is a hands-on, investigative role where you dig into performance data, find the signal in the noise, and help stakeholders understand what is working and what is not.

You will play a critical role in translating complex behavioral, customer journey, funnel, and feature usage data into meaningful insights that inform product strategy, user engagement optimization, and marketing performance. Experience with marketing analytics (campaign performance, paid media, attribution) is a plus, but product analytics will be the primary focus of this role.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Investigate user behavior, customer journey, and conversion funnels across product touchpoints to identify trends, anomalies, and drop-off patterns.

  • Partner with product managers to define and track performance KPIs, evaluate feature adoption, and support data-informed product decisions.

  • Deliver clear, actionable insights that guide product optimization, landing page improvements, and user experience enhancements.

  • Collaborate with marketing operations and product teams to connect funnel insights across the full customer journey.

  • Design and build custom dashboards in Tableau (or similar) to support ongoing performance monitoring and exploratory analysis.

  • Write and refine SQL queries to extract, clean, and analyze large datasets—especially across digital engagement, conversion events, and behavioral data.

  • Perform exploratory analysis to uncover unexpected patterns, detect data integrity issues, and recommend solutions or next steps.

  • Support A/B testing analysis, attribution modeling, and ongoing campaign evaluation as needed.

  • Analyze large data sets of structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data to discover insights and collaborate with business partners to deliver business value.

  • Prepare and effectively present findings to business stakeholders, including executive management, in a concise fashion.

  • Leverage AI-assisted analytics tools (e.g., tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT Codex) to accelerate analysis, improve data exploration, and enhance data storytelling—while maintaining analytical rigor and data quality standards.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, management, accounting, economics, statistics, information science, or a related field required.

  • Minimum of 5+ years of proven working experience as a data analyst, business data analyst, or similar role.

  • Strong emphasis on B2C product analytics, including user behavior analysis, funnel investigation, and feature or journey performance.

  • Marketing analytics experience (paid search, display, brand and variable marketing, campaign performance, ROAS) is a plus.

  • Strong SQL skills, with proven experience querying and transforming large datasets for both ad-hoc analysis and dashboard use.

  • Expertise in Tableau or other BI tools to build insightful, scalable dashboards from scratch.

  • Demonstrated success in anomaly detection, funnel investigation, and actionable insight delivery.

  • Experience with performance metrics such as conversion rate, bounce rate, session duration, feature adoption, and retention; familiarity with ROAS and campaign metrics is a plus.

We are a remote-first company, Pushies can choose to work remotely or from our Downtown Vancouver office.

We are seeking a Utilization Review Specialist to add to our dynamic team! The Utilization Review Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring that healthcare services provided to patients are medically necessary, efficient, and compliant with regulatory standards. This position involves thorough evaluation of patient records, treatment plans, and clinical data to determine the appropriateness of care and resource utilization. The specialist collaborates closely with healthcare providers, insurance companies, and case managers to facilitate timely approvals and optimize patient outcomes. By applying clinical knowledge and regulatory guidelines, the role helps control healthcare costs while maintaining high-quality patient care. Ultimately, the Utilization Review Specialist contributes to the integrity and sustainability of healthcare delivery systems across the United States.

Responsibilities

  • Complete admission, precertification, concurrent, continued-stay, step-down, and retrospective reviews in accordance with payer requirements and established departmental workflows
  • Obtain, document, and monitor authorizations across the continuum of care, including approved level of care, number of units or days, effective dates, review dates, authorization numbers, and payer-specific conditions
  • Review the medical record and collaborate with the treatment team to obtain complete, accurate, and timely clinical information supporting medical necessity and the requested level of care
  • Present clinical information to payer representatives clearly, objectively, and persuasively, using applicable medical-necessity criteria and payer guidelines
  • Maintain accurate authorization records in the electronic medical record, payer portals, tracking systems, and other designated applications
  • Monitor assigned caseloads and authorization deadlines daily; complete required follow-up and escalate unresolved payer, documentation, or authorization barriers before reimbursement is placed at risk
  • Identify clinical documentation gaps or inconsistencies and communicate specific needs to the appropriate clinician, provider, or leader without directing clinical care or altering the clinical record
  • Coordinate with clinical and case-management teams regarding anticipated transitions, discharge planning, and changes in level of care to support continuity of treatment and timely payer notification
  • Recognize potential adverse determinations and promptly escalate cases requiring peer-to-peer review, reconsideration, appeal, or leadership intervention
  • Prepare concise case summaries and supporting documentation for peer reviews, appeals, and other payer escalation activities as assigned
  • Review payer correspondence and adverse determinations for accuracy, communicate outcomes to appropriate stakeholders, and complete required follow-up within established deadlines
  • Participate in denial review, root-cause analysis, quality audits, training, and performance-improvement initiatives
  • Follow standardized utilization review policies, workflows, escalation pathways, and documentation requirements across assigned facilities and states
  • Maintain working knowledge of payer policies, authorization requirements, medical-necessity criteria, regulatory standards, and assigned service-line requirements
  • Collaborate professionally with Utilization Review leadership, Centralized Admissions, Clinical Directors, clinical teams, facility leadership, Patient Financial Services, Billing, Compliance, and other Revenue Cycle partners
  • Protect patient privacy and ensure compliance with HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2, payer requirements, accreditation standards, and organizational policies
  • Perform other duties as assigned in support of Utilization Review and Revenue Cycle objectives

Minimum Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; relevant college coursework, professional certification, or equivalent directly related experience strongly preferred
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in behavioral healthcare, substance use disorder treatment, utilization review, managed care, insurance authorization, case management, revenue cycle, or a closely related function.
  • Behavioral Health and/or Substance Use Disorder experience required.
  • Working knowledge of insurance authorization processes, including precertification, concurrent review, continued-stay review, authorization tracking, and payer follow-up.
  • Ability to interpret clinical documentation and clearly communicate symptoms, functional impairment, risk factors, treatment needs, progress, and barriers to discharge.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple cases, payer deadlines, and competing priorities with accuracy and appropriate escalation.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, professional judgment, attention to detail, and commitment to patient confidentiality.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA and 42 CFR Part 2 requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Psychology, Counseling, Nursing, Healthcare Administration, Health Information Management, or a related healthcare discipline
  • Minimum 1 year of direct utilization review, concurrent review, or payer authorization experience within behavioral health or substance use disorder treatment
  • Knowledge of ASAM Criteria and experience with residential, inpatient, partial hospitalization, intensive outpatient, and outpatient levels of care
  • Experience working with commercial insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, Managed Medicaid, TRICARE, Veterans Affairs, or other managed-care payers
  • Experience preparing cases for peer-to-peer reviews, reconsiderations, retrospective reviews, and clinical appeals
  • Active clinical license or relevant certification, such as RN, LPN/LVN, LMSW, LPC, CADC, LADAC, CCM, or an equivalent credential, preferred but not required
  • Experience with enterprise electronic medical record systems, payer portals, and Microsoft Office applications

raw.description:
About Frontier

Frontier is a subsidiary of Fresh Prints. Fresh Prints is a New York-based, fast-growing, fully remote, 150-person company with most of our team based in India and the Philippines. A few years ago, Fresh Prints began helping other fast-growing companies build their teams. We got so good at it that we spun out a new company to focus exclusively on that — and called it Frontier.

At Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people and place them into the best companies. In three years, we’ve never lost a client. If you’re interested in a Frontier role and you apply and are accepted, we’ll screen you through assessments and interviews and aim to get you an interview for a full-time job within the month.

Think of us as your personal talent agent — and good luck with the application! 😊

Please note: To ensure we find the best technical fit, our process begins with a practical skills assessment prior to interviews.

About Portal Warehousing

Portal Warehousing (“Portal”) is a micro-bay industrial real estate platform providing flexible, small-scale warehouse suites for modern businesses and e-commerce operators. We acquire infill industrial properties and convert them into turnkey spaces (100–2,500 SF) equipped with dock-high loading, industrial zoning, and shared logistics infrastructure.

Our model allows tenants to operate professionally without long-term leases or significant upfront investment. As Portal expands nationally, we are hiring our first dedicated Accounting Manager to build the financial foundation supporting our next stage of growth.

The Role

Portal is seeking a hands-on Accounting Manager to own day-to-day accounting operations and financial reporting. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building systems, improving processes, and operating in a fast-growth entrepreneurial environment.

You will oversee monthly close, reporting, budgeting, treasury, and AP/AR functions while partnering closely with leadership and operations teams. This position reports directly to senior leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting Operations & Monthly Close

  • Manage day-to-day bookkeeping and general ledger accounting.

  • Lead timely month-end close and preparation of financial statements.

  • Perform bank, credit card, and intercompany reconciliations.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare monthly and quarterly reporting packages with variance analysis vs. budget and forecast.

  • Track KPIs related to property performance and operating margins.

  • Support management and investor decision-making through ad hoc analysis.

Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Assist with annual budgeting and rolling forecasts.

  • Model cash flow projections and capital requirements with leadership.

AP/AR & Treasury

  • Oversee accounts payable and receivable processes.

  • Manage vendor payments, tenant billing, and collections.

  • Monitor cash balances and support liquidity planning.

Systems & Process Development

  • Implement scalable accounting systems, processes, and internal controls.

  • Prepare the company for audits, financing activities, and investor reporting.

  • Recommend best practices to support operational discipline during growth.

Asset Management Support

  • Maintain property-level financial models and operating statements.

  • Track leasing performance, occupancy, renewals, and churn metrics.

  • Partner with operations to evaluate property performance and identify value opportunities.

Lender & Investor Reporting

  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting packages for lenders and investors.

  • Track loan covenants, reserve accounts, and compliance requirements.

  • Coordinate draw requests, financial certifications, and lender audits or reviews.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (CPA or CPA-track preferred).

  • 4–7 years of progressive accounting experience; real estate or property management experience strongly preferred.

  • Strong knowledge and experience of US GAAP, accrual accounting, and month-end close processes.

  • Experience managing AP/AR, budgeting, and financial reporting.

  • Proficiency with accounting software such as QuickBooks, Yardi, AppFolio, or similar.

  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills.

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to operate independently.

  • Comfortable working in a startup or high-growth environment and building processes from scratch.

This Opportunity

raw.excerpt: About Us We are a modern marketing collective built for scale, efficiency, and impact.
raw.description:
About Us

We are a modern marketing collective built for scale, efficiency, and impact. As the parent company, Agital supports three specialized agencies: Go Fish Digital, REQ, and WDG, with shared infrastructure, advanced technology, and deeply experienced people, allowing each brand to do its best work.

Go Fish Digital is an engineering-forward performance marketing agency specializing in SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), its Barracuda AI platform, social commerce, and conversion-focused creative.

WDG designs and builds complex enterprise web experiences for associations, nonprofits, foundations, universities, and other mission-driven organizations.

REQ is a digital marketing and communications agency specializing in brand, reputation, and advocacy for global organizations across technology, healthcare, finance, hospitality, and real estate.

Together, we operate as one collaborative ecosystem, combining deep expertise, AI-powered capabilities, and a culture of curiosity to help ambitious brands grow while creating meaningful opportunities for our people.

About the Role

Go Fish Digital is where digital marketing meets clarity, creativity, and scale. As our agency grows and our client engagements become increasingly complex and cross-functional, strong project management is essential to ensuring great strategy turns into great execution.

The Project Manager serves as the operational backbone of assigned client work. This person creates the structure that allows Client Strategy and delivery teams to execute effectively, turning priorities and decisions into clear tasks, realistic timelines, coordinated resources, and measurable progress.

You will work across teams to keep complex client work moving, identify risks before they become problems, and create the visibility teams need to deliver on time and profitably.

What You'll Do

You will own the execution system for a portfolio of complex client accounts and projects.

You will partner closely with Client Strategy and delivery teams to translate approved strategy into actionable work, coordinate timelines and dependencies, maintain clear project plans, and ensure teams have the information and capacity needed to deliver.

You will not own the client relationship or service strategy. Instead, you will create operational discipline around those functions, making sure decisions turn into action, risks surface early, and commitments remain realistic.

Your involvement will vary based on the complexity of the account or project. On some engagements, you may be deeply embedded in internal planning and execution; on others, you may provide lighter project governance and periodic oversight. Go Fish intentionally uses a tiered PM model based on account complexity, revenue impact, coordination burden, timeline risk, capacity needs, and margin exposure.

Key Functions

Project Planning and Execution

  • Translate approved strategy and project decisions into clear work plans, tasks, milestones, dependencies, owners, and timelines.
  • Build and maintain realistic project schedules that reflect scope, priorities, team capacity, and delivery dependencies.
  • Monitor execution, adjust plans as conditions change, and ensure decisions consistently move into action.
  • Maintain strong project structure in ClickUp so teams understand what needs to happen, who owns it, and when it is due.
  • Ensure assigned work meets Go Fish standards for task clarity, ownership, dates, estimates, prioritization, and actionable context.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Coordinate work across Client Strategy, delivery teams, and other contributors to keep multi-service and project-based engagements moving smoothly.
  • Translate internal decisions into clear next steps and ensure owners understand dependencies, priorities, and expectations.
  • Identify handoff gaps, conflicting priorities, and unclear ownership before they disrupt delivery.
  • Maintain continuity as work moves across teams and help ensure important decisions, requests, and project context are not lost.

Timeline, Capacity, and Risk Management

  • Maintain current, realistic project timelines and proactively identify work at risk of delay.
  • Monitor team capacity and workload constraints, escalating trade-offs before they affect client commitments.
  • Surface operational risks related to scope, timelines, dependencies, staffing, or workflow and partner with Client Strategy and delivery leaders on resolution.
  • Use sound judgment to address issues directly when possible and escalate repeated or material risks at the appropriate level.
  • Regularly review assigned projects to identify overdue work, adjust dependencies, resolve capacity concerns, and protect delivery timelines.

Margin and Financial Discipline

  • Help protect project and account margin through strong planning, accurate time estimates, workflow control, and visibility into actual effort.
  • Monitor time tracking and hours against project expectations, surfacing material variances or scope concerns early.
  • Support deferred revenue forecasting and revenue-recognition schedules for applicable project-based work.
  • Partner with Client Strategy and Operations to identify when project demands exceed planned scope, capacity, or financial assumptions.
  • Ensure project-management practices support both high-quality delivery and profitable execution. Project-management KPIs at Go Fish specifically include margin protection, time-tracking compliance, and deferred-revenue forecast accuracy where applicable.

Client Lifecycle and Project Setup

  • Support onboarding and kickoff for assigned accounts by establishing project structure, timelines, milestones, tasks, and internal ownership.
  • For project-based engagements, develop the execution schedule and align the internal team before Client Strategy confirms commitments with the client.
  • Maintain project documentation and structure throughout the engagement so teams have a reliable view of current work, decisions, and progress.
  • Support smooth transitions when timelines, priorities, services, or team members change.

What You Bring

Project Management Experience

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex projects, preferably in a marketing agency, professional-services firm, or multi-client environment.
  • Strong ability to translate strategy and broad direction into clear, actionable project plans.
  • Experience coordinating work across multiple teams, disciplines, and dependencies.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects while maintaining visibility into priorities, risks, and deadlines.
  • Strong follow-through and a willingness to remain engaged until work is complete.

Planning, Prioritization, and Judgment

  • Strong ability to build realistic timelines, manage dependencies, and anticipate execution risks.
  • Sound judgment when priorities compete, information is incomplete, or teams have conflicting needs.
  • Ability to distinguish between an urgent request and a true project priority.
  • Confidence challenging unrealistic timelines, unclear ownership, or commitments that do not align with available capacity.
  • Ability to escalate risks at the right time and level.

Systems and Analytical Fluency

  • Strong working knowledge of project-management platforms; experience with ClickUp is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with time estimates, capacity data, project hours, margin visibility, and execution reporting.
  • Ability to maintain highly organized project structures and accurate task-level information.
  • Comfortable using operational data to identify project risk and guide action.
  • Curiosity about AI and automation and how they can improve project planning, documentation, coordination, or visibility.

Communication and Collaboration

  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to turn meetings and strategic discussions into actionable tasks, owners, deadlines, and dependencies.
  • Confidence following up with teammates, challenging unclear requests, and holding stakeholders accountable professionally.
  • Ability to partner effectively with Client Strategy and delivery teams without taking over their strategic or client-facing responsibilities.
  • A calm, responsive, and practical working style.

What You Will Need

Alongside your resume, please submit a one-page cover letter that gives us insight into your professional journey, your interest in the role, and the experiences that have prepared you to manage complex, cross-functional client work. Please also include your salary expectations.

Where possible, include examples of complex projects, project plans, workflow improvements, or systems you have used to improve execution, visibility, or team coordination.

Applications that do not include the requested materials may not be considered. Attention to detail matters in this role, and the application process is an opportunity to demonstrate it.

We appreciate the time and thought you put into your application and look forward to learning more about you.

Why Join Us
You'll work alongside talented people who are passionate about solving problems, helping clients grow, and delivering meaningful results. We're a collaborative, fast-moving team where curiosity is encouraged, ideas are welcomed, and great work is recognized.

We believe the best work happens when people are trusted to take ownership, supported in their growth, and empowered to bring their unique perspectives to the table. Whether you're just getting started or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact while continuing to learn and grow.

Benefits & Compensation 

We believe great people deserve great support. Our company offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well-being, and career growth, including:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible work environment
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Unlimited paid time off
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance
  • Paid parental leave
  • A collaborative culture with autonomy and ownership
  • Employee wellness programs and additional perks

Additional Information

No agencies, please.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to succeed. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Please note that this job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications, which may change based on business needs.

At this time, we are unable to sponsor or transfer employment visas for this position.

raw.description:
You’re joining a strategic initiative to help a major media and technology company build a new behavioral intelligence platform from the ground up. This is an embedded consulting role, not a traditional engagement. You’ll be shaping the technical foundation of a commercial unit that leverages large-scale behavioral data through AI and advanced data architecture.

Your role is to serve as the technical authority — making platform decisions, representing them to client stakeholders, and guiding the team through the complexity of data architecture, privacy-preserving systems, and multi-tenant infrastructure design. You’ll report to Blend’s Chief Solutions Officer while working directly within the delivery team, with regular visibility to the client’s executive leadership.

What You’ll Own

Platform Architecture & Decisions

  • Define and validate the technical blueprint across cloud data warehouse, clean room infrastructure, embedding compute, and privacy controls

  • Own the data modeling strategy for large-scale behavioral signals across multiple data sources and device types

  • Design the embeddings architecture and feature store supporting advertising, commerce, and AI use cases

  • Guide clean room design and ensure compliance with applicable privacy frameworks

Technical Leadership & Unblocking

  • Identify and resolve critical path blockers across infrastructure, integrations, and identity resolution

  • Pressure-test technical proposals against real-world scale and operational complexity

  • Bridge between Blend’s engineering and data science teams and the client’s senior technical stakeholders

Executive Presence & GTM Alignment

  • Participate in regular leadership touchpoints with the client’s commercial and product leadership

  • Translate technical capabilities into commercially relevant differentiation

  • Ensure the technical roadmap aligns with go-to-market milestones

  • Serve as a credible technical voice in early client and partner conversations

Who You Are:

Technical Depth

  • Enterprise data platforms (Snowflake, AWS, or equivalent)

  • Real-time and batch data architecture

  • ML/AI systems and embeddings infrastructure

  • Data privacy frameworks and compliance-by-design approaches

  • Clean rooms, DSPs, and SSPs

Executive Presence & Communication

  • You’ve worked directly with CTO-level stakeholders — not through layers

  • You move comfortably between technical depth and business context

  • You articulate architectural tradeoffs clearly and in terms of business impact

  • You’re comfortable in high-stakes client or investor settings

Problem-Solving Orientation

  • You ask hard questions about scale, cost, compliance, and risk before committing to approaches

  • You hold opinions but update them when presented with better information

  • You see your role as unblocking the team, not bottlenecking it

Collaborative Mindset

  • You’ve worked in embedded delivery or partner roles

  • You don’t need to own everything to drive impact

  • You value getting to the right answer over being the one with the answer

Required

  • 10+ years in data or platform architecture, with at least 3 years on systems at significant scale

  • Deep experience with Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or a comparable enterprise data platform

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical strategy in high-stakes client or executive contexts

  • Experience designing for privacy, compliance, or security constraints

  • Background in consulting delivery or embedded partner roles

Nice to Have

  • Clean room or federated data architecture experience

  • Embeddings or feature store work

  • Identity resolution or data monetization projects

  • AWS or cloud infrastructure design

  • DSP or SSP experience

Less Important

  • Familiarity with every tool on the stack (you’ll learn what you need)

  • Specific certifications or credentials

  • Individual contributor “rock star” energy — we care about collaborative problem-solving

The starting pay range for this role is $250,000 - $350,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on several factors including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, certifications, training, and location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range and determining factors for compensation are considered for each individual circumstance. BLEND360 offers a competitive benefits program designed to support the health and financial well-being of our team members and their families. Benefits vary by role and eligibility and may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, paid holidays, commuter benefits, flexible spending accounts, life and disability insurance, and employee assistance programs.

Blend360 is a premier data, AI, and marketing consulting firm that partners with the world's most ambitious organizations to turn complex challenges into competitive advantage. We sit at the intersection of deep analytical rigor and pragmatic business execution—helping Fortune 1000 companies and Private Equity-backed businesses unlock transformational value through data, technology, and human expertise.

DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: QA/QC Field Technician III

Position Location: Remote - work from anywhere in the United States. Must be located near a major airport

JOB SUMMARY

The QA/QC Field Technician III ensures all systems are installed to the project requirements in accordance with the Project Documents, Basis of Design (BOD), the Commissioning Plan of Record and the Quality Control Plan.

This person will collaborate with design engineers, construction contractors, equipment vendors and client staff to validate newly installed electrical and mechanical systems including those in mission critical facilities. Monitor Daily Construction Activities and provide timely status reports on project scheduling, Change Order management, contractor conformance to Quality Control Plan, and Submittal/RFI responses.

The QA/QC Field Technician III will receive general instructions on routine work and detailed instructions on new projects or assignments. May work independently, consistently exercising discretion and independent judgment on individual work, or may work under immediate supervision. May serve as lead on routine projects of limited scope.

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
Assist in Performing On-site Inspection, Validation, and Verification of Electrical and Mechanical Equipment (65%)

  • Monitor daily MEP contractor activities.
  • Conduct inspections throughout project stages, including offsite fabrication, construction, and punch list phases.
  • Collaborate with design professionals, clients, trade contractors, and craftsmen to address coordination issues and installation challenges.
  • Attend and contribute to QA/QC and construction team meetings.
  • Inspect Owner Furnished Equipment, both offsite and onsite.
  • Evaluate subcontractors' capabilities in meeting quality requirements. Ensure all trade contractors are following their approved QA/QC Plans.
  • Ensure all trade contractors are installing work in accordance with project documents, applicable codes, standards, and best work practices.
  • Ensure compliance with safety policies and procedures. Confirm site adherence to HSE requirements and that LOTO procedures are properly utilized during project activities.

Assist in Developing Testing Plans and Procedures (15%)

  • Monitor scheduling of commissioning plans.
  • Prepare pre-functional checklists.
  • Captures quality data from systems to either confirm compliance with established standards or identify deviations and create a plan of action.

Assist in Reviewing Construction Related Design Documents, Drawings and Specifications (15%)

  • Review shop drawings and submittals.
  • Verify contractor quality requirements are specified to vendors and contractor documentation submittals.
  • Identify project milestones and adherence to equipment startups.
  • Assist Project QA/QC Manager to manage a field document control system for construction drawings, specifications, test and inspection reports, vendor data and as-built drawings.

Reporting (5%)

  • Monitor project progress and report status regularly to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of inspections, test reports, checklists, and other quality records, assuring that the contract obligations for testing and record keeping are adhered to.
  • Facilitate root cause analysis for site-level non-conformance reports and drive continuous improvement and best practices.
  • Monitor the disposition of all issued non-conformance reports.
  • Prepare reports and generate metrics as necessary to understand and communicate site compliance of quality program.
  • Monitor the progress and effectiveness of the project quality management system. Recommend and implement improvements as approved.
  • Ensuring proper turnover of complete quality control, ensure that turnover documentation is maintained, organized and turned over on schedule.
  • Manage personal hours using company tools.

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (INTERMEDIATE LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING)

  • Knowledge of electrical, mechanical and controls system principles.
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management.
  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail.
  • Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, optimize operational processes, and contribute to company-wide innovation.
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment thru effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace.
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements.
  • Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information).
  • Ability to communicate effectively directly with clients and at times serve as primary point of client contact.
  • Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines.
  • Ability to achieve certification for NFPA70E and / or OSHA training as / if required.
  • Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently manipulating, moving or grasping small parts, devices or tools.
  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position.
  • Frequently moving through office, critical facility and other environments (such as low temperatures, high temperatures and outdoor elements such as precipitation and wind), including tight and confined spaces.
  • Frequently descending / ascending stairs and ladders to access equipment.
  • On occasion the employee may be required to position self under or over equipment.
  • On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS

  • Must have a valid driver’s license and ability to rent vehicles.
  • Up to 75%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states.
  • Must be located near a major airport.
  • Effective May 7, 2025, and in accordance with U.S. federal regulations for domestic air travel, a valid REAL ID (or an acceptable alternative, such as a passport) is required for travel associated with this position.
  • Travel may involve transportation by car or plane depending on the destination and nature of the business need.
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meetings for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.
  • Potential for international assignments.
  • Potential relocation opportunities may exist per project needs.

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction or related discipline.

OR

  • Two years’ experience with installation, hands-on testing, validation and troubleshooting of mechanical, controls and / or electrical infrastructure.

PLUS

  • Minimum three years’ additional experience with installation, hands-on testing, validation and troubleshooting of mechanical, controls and / or electrical infrastructure.

BENEFITS

DLB Associates offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Flex spending accounts (FSA)
  • Dental and vision plans
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is DLB's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

DLB Associates is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce.

Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award-winning team!​

Description

Nebius Academy is an international educational platform that helps business professionals and organizations navigate AI-driven transformation. We create practical programs that help teams apply AI tools to real business workflows, make informed decisions, and lead organizational change.

We are looking for a senior AI for Managers Teaching Expert with direct professional experience in the insurance or insurance-brokerage industry and strong knowledge of the Latin American business environment.

You will deliver a four-week program for senior managers at a major LATAM insurance-brokerage group. The program consists of five live virtual sessions focused on practical AI applications for management, decision-making, productivity, automation, and business transformation.

The workshop materials are already prepared. Your role will be to deliver the sessions, prepare through dry runs, adapt examples to the insurance-brokerage context, and help participants apply the course concepts to their own business projects. You will also act as a trusted subject-matter expert who can discuss the operational, strategic, governance, and risk implications of AI adoption.

What you will do

  • Deliver five engaging live virtual workshops for senior managers in Spanish.
  • Prepare for each session and participate in internal dry runs.
  • Present practical AI applications for management, decision support, productivity, automation, and business transformation.
  • Adapt examples, case studies, and discussions to the insurance and insurance-brokerage industry.
  • Help participants apply AI concepts to their own business projects and provide constructive feedback.
  • Explain the operational, governance, legal, and organizational implications of AI adoption.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success, Program, and course teams to align delivery with the client’s goals.
  • Maintain a practical, business-focused approach suitable for senior and executive audiences.
  • Stay current on relevant AI tools, trends, risks, and business applications.

Requirements

Must Have

  • Direct professional experience working in the insurance or insurance-brokerage industry.
  • Direct, on-the-ground professional experience in the Latin American region.
  • Senior-level experience working with managers, senior leaders, or executive stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience deploying or leading business, technology, AI, or transformation projects.
  • Strong practical understanding of AI concepts and tools applicable to business management.
  • Experience teaching, training, mentoring, consulting, or facilitating sessions for management-level professionals.
  • Ability to explain AI clearly to non-technical senior audiences using practical, decision-oriented business language.
  • Native-level Spanish.
  • Professional working proficiency in English.
  • Confidence delivering live virtual workshops and responding to senior stakeholders’ questions.

Nice to Have

  • Portuguese proficiency.
  • Experience delivering corporate or B2B training programs.
  • Background in digital transformation, change management, AI adoption, or management consulting.
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, or similar platforms.
  • Understanding of AI governance, risk management, data privacy, compliance, and responsible AI use.
  • Experience helping organizations move AI initiatives from initial concepts or pilots into implementation.

What we can offer you

  • Remote, part-time collaboration under a service agreement.
  • An initial four-week project up to 20 hours maximum, depending on participant project-review needs.
  • Compensation of up to USD 200 per hour.
  • Five scheduled live sessions with preparation time and dry runs included in the compensated workload.
  • Ready-to-use workshop materials and support from the Nebius Academy course and program teams.
  • The opportunity to work with senior managers from a major Latin American insurance-brokerage group.
  • A consultative role in which you can help participants evaluate and develop practical AI initiatives.
  • Potential opportunities to support future courses and client engagements.
  • Professional autonomy and the opportunity to contribute real industry and AI-transformation expertise.

Career Category

Quality

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Product Quality Director

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will be the champion for a product team as the Product Quality Leader (referred to as PQL), providing technical expertise, strategic and project leadership to the Product Quality (PQ) organization. The PQL has responsibility for working with PQ staff and executive leadership, International Quality, Quality Control, Contract Manufacturing Quality, Regulatory, Process Development, Quality Assurance, and other functional areas on the resolution of issues associated with process/manufacturing, in process controls, analytical methods, specifications, comparability, stability, reference standards, importation testing, investigations, change control, regulatory submissions and inspections. The PQL has responsibility for inspiring change to implement operationally efficient processes and corporate alignment across international sites. As a leader in Product Quality, the successful candidate is expected to have experience, knowledge and understanding of large molecule development and commercial lifecycle maintenance, product stability programs, regulatory filings, risk assessment, and Amgen Quality Management Systems.

Amgen offers the opportunity to be at the interface between research, global development, and manufacturing to ensure that our molecules become medicines. Many of the technologies we’re employing are not only new to Amgen but are new to the industry as a whole. Help us to pave new roads for helping patients.

This role is directly responsible for the product quality and related activities (e.g., comparability, specifications, stability, annual product review) in support of the Product Development Team (PDT). The PQL provides scientific oversight for the product quality of pivotal and/or commercial product(s) including timely product data review, ownership of GMP documents and regulatory filing sections, execution of transactions in relevant GMP system (EDMQ, change control, etc), and support for regulatory audits and responses to questions. The individual is directly responsible to lead a Product Quality Team (PQT), including oversight of the product stability programs, and providing indirect staff management and guidance to members of the PQT.

Key Responsibilities include:

  • Provide effective, cross-functional quality leadership, and manage multiple, complex long- term PDT deliverables for late phase and commercial programs, including actions required for the PQT/APR; specification, comparability, and stability programs; site and method transfers; product quality impact statements for NCs; and PQ owned regulatory filing sections and RTQs

  • Provide expertise in science and risk-based evaluation of complex process and product quality data, including ability to develop patient-oriented strategies that account for business needs and/or provide novel solutions to complex issues

  • Demonstrate proficiency in oral and written communication of complex information to Amgen leadership, peers and regulatory agencies including communications associated with inspectional activities

  • Demonstrate proficiency in knowledge of cGMP and international regulatory expectations

  • Understand and respond to the impact of emerging scientific/technical trends and their implications for Amgen

  • Actively mentor new and existing team members to develop Product Quality core skills

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic professional we seek is a collaborate leader with these qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Doctorate degree and 4 years of Quality, Operations, Scientific or Manufacturing experience OR

  • Master’s degree and 7 years of Quality, Operations, Scientific or Manufacturing experience OR

  • Bachelor’s degree and 9 years of Quality, Operations, Scientific or Manufacturing experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree in chemistry, biochemistry, biology, or a related biotechnology sciences field

  • Expertise in the areas of protein and small molecule analysis and industry regulations

  • 8+ years of pharmaceutical experience with increasing responsibility in a quality, analytical development, process development, pharmaceutics, regulatory, or manufacturing environment experience

  • 6+ years working in a regulated environment (direct GMP)

  • 5+ years managing staff with increasing responsibilities and larger groups

  • 2+ years experience as a PQL, technical professional or product champion

  • 1+ years of experience with authoring or review of regulatory filing or similar regulatory documentation.

  • 1+ years of experience supporting non-conformance investigations, authoring, reviewing and defending critical product impacting non-conformances

  • Experience in Project Management in support of product development

  • Knowledge of protein and small molecule quality, compliance and regulatory requirements

  • Knowledge of analytical techniques used for protein molecule product quality control

  • Understanding of drug substance and drug product development and manufacturing

  • Strong leadership and management skills

  • General knowledge of cGMP and filing regulations, practices, and trends pertaining to the manufacture and testing of pharmaceuticals

  • Previous experience working on a cross-functional team in a matrix environment

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including facilitation and presentation skills

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts

  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan

  • Stock-based long-term incentives

  • Award-winning time-off plans

  • Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

Role Overview:

The Automation Specialist will be responsible for designing and implementing internal workflows and automations across the agency’s tech stack. You’ll build systems to streamline how we onboard clients, launch ad campaigns, manage content production, assign tasks, and track deliverables — all without manual bottlenecks.

This role blends technical automation skills with operational thinking. You’ll work closely with the Operations Manager, media buyers, and creative team to identify friction points and build customized automations that improve speed, accuracy, and visibility.

Key Responsibilities:

✦ Workflow Automation (Client & Internal)

  • Build scenarios to automate repetitive workflows (e.g., client onboarding, asset delivery, reporting alerts, etc.)

  • Automate Notion dashboards and task creation when a client signs or a new project kicks off

  • Integrate tools like Google Forms, Airtable, Slack, Drive, and ClickUp with Make or Zapier

✦ Ad Operations Automation

  • Automate naming conventions, folder creation, and campaign briefs for new ad launches

  • Support media team with automations for creative tracking, performance logging, and approvals

  • Create logic-based systems for media buyers to trigger creative refreshes, test tracking, etc.

✦ Communication & Asset Handoff

  • Automate notifications and task handoffs between departments (e.g., once UGC is approved, editor is notified)

  • Create Slack or email automations for key events (e.g., “Client submitted creative form” or “Ad set ready to publish”)

  • Set up triggers for client updates, review reminders, and feedback loops

✦ SOPs & Documentation

  • Build internal knowledge base of how automations work and how the team should use them

  • Maintain documentation for each major automation scenario, including how to troubleshoot or update

About LabX Media Group

LabX Media Group is a leading worldwide science publishing company that delivers meaningful industry content and integrated marketing solutions for the scientific community. LabX Media Group’s brands and product solutions deliver trusted, timely and deep information across print and digital products to empower our customers and advance their research.

We are looking for a Head of Audience & Subscriptions to join our team!

As part of the Marketing team, the Head of Audience & Subscriptions will lead and grow our print and digital circulation strategy for a large publication. The Head of Audience & Subscriptions will oversee print circulation operations, subscriber retention, revenue optimization, and churn reduction while driving data informed audience growth initiatives across multiple channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage all aspects of print and digital circulation strategy for a large consumer-focused publication, with accountability for subscriber acquisition, retention, renewal performance, circulation growth, and audience engagement.
  • Develop and execute audience growth strategies that increase paid and qualified circulation, optimize subscriber lifetime value (LTV), reduce churn, and improve overall circulation profitability.
  • Utilize audience, subscription, and engagement data to make informed decisions that drive acquisition, retention, conversion, and revenue growth across multiple channels.
  • Plan and execute subscriber acquisition, renewal, win-back, and retention campaigns using segmentation, behavioral targeting, lifecycle marketing, and data-driven personalization strategies.
  • Build and optimize subscriber lifecycle programs from initial conversion through onboarding, engagement, renewal, gifts, reactivation, and long-term retention.
  • Develop test plans, trial offers, pricing strategies, promotional packages, and conversion optimization initiatives. Continuously measure performance and apply a disciplined test-and-learn approach to improve response rates, retention, and ROI.
  • Monitor and optimize key circulation and subscription metrics including subscriber growth, renewal rates, churn, engagement, customer acquisition cost (CAC), lifetime value (LTV), conversion rates, and subscription revenue.
  • Own subscription revenue performance and circulation economics, including forecasting acquisition and retention results, monitoring profitability, and identifying opportunities to improve yield and operational efficiency.
  • Develop annual circulation forecasts, budgets, reporting, and performance analysis. Present recommendations and results to senior leadership based on measurable business outcomes.
  • Oversee all print circulation operations including fulfillment, production schedules, print order management, subscriber services, shipping, postal optimization, and newsstand distribution.
  • Manage relationships with fulfillment houses, printers, direct mail agencies, newsstand consultants, digital marketing partners, distribution vendors, and other third-party suppliers to ensure operational excellence and cost efficiency.
  • Ensure compliance with circulation reporting requirements, privacy regulations, subscription policies, and postal regulations. Manage relationships with audit organizations and maintain the integrity of subscriber data.
  • Conduct competitive analysis and market research to identify audience trends, emerging technologies, subscription best practices, and growth opportunities that keep the publication ahead of the market.
  • Monitor email deliverability and optimize subscriber communications to improve inbox placement, open rates, click-through rates, engagement, retention, and conversion performance.
  • Develop and execute integrated audience development strategies that grow readership and drive traffic and engagement across print, digital, email, social media, events, newsletters, and advertiser-supported content programs.
  • Partner closely with editorial, sales, product, analytics, and marketing teams to align audience growth initiatives with broader business, content, and revenue goals.
  • Leverage advanced audience segmentation, cohort analysis, retention modeling, and performance reporting to identify opportunities for growth, improve subscriber experiences, and support strategic decision-making.
  • Continuously evaluate new channels, technologies, partnerships, and marketing opportunities to expand audience reach, improve subscription performance, and strengthen long-term customer relationships.

Qualifications:

  • Post-secondary degree or diploma in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related
    field; equivalent experience will be considered.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in circulation management, audience development, or
    digital/print marketing, ideally within a media, publishing, B2B or B2C environment.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret audience data and translate insights
    into actionable strategies that drive measurable growth.
  • Excellent communication and project management skills; ability to manage multiple brands
    and campaigns simultaneously in a fast-paced, remote environment.
  • Experience in/knowledge of the scientific industry is an asset.

Experience & Skills:

  • Expert working knowledge of subscription fulfillment software (Omeda, CDS).
  • Experience with e-mail marketing platforms and list segmentation best practices.
  • Experience with web analytics platforms (Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics) and data
    visualization tools to monitor audience KPIs and campaign performance.
  • Hands-on experience with social media management; familiarity with emerging platforms
    and growth tactics.
  • Direct experience both executing and managing paid advertising efforts.
  • Experience with A/B testing and conversion rate optimization; a disciplined, test-and-learn
    approach to campaign development capable of demonstrating clear ROI
  • Advanced knowledge of print fulfillment workflows, subscriber database management,
    subscription billing cycles, and postal regulations.

This position is remotely based and is open to all eligible candidates in the UK.

when contacted for an interview. We thank all candidates for applying. Only those candidates

description: Type: Full-time contractor (hours negotiable) Location: Remote - Africa/Europe time zones (strong preference for candidates based in Africa) Reports to: CEO Direct reports: Head of Implementation, Implementation Engineering Director, and Senior Advisors on the Services Team OpenFn is the digital public good for public service automation & AI orchestration.

raw.title: Managing Director, Services
raw.excerpt: Type: Full-time contractor (hours negotiable) Location: Remote - Africa/Europe time zones (strong preference for candidates based in Africa) Reports to: CEO Direct reports: Head of Implementation, Implementation Engineering Director, and Senior Advisors on the Services Team OpenFn is the digital public good for public service automation & AI orchestration.
raw.description:
Type: Full-time contractor (hours negotiable)
Location: Remote - Africa/Europe time zones (strong preference for candidates based in Africa)
Reports to: CEO
Direct reports: Head of Implementation, Implementation Engineering Director, and Senior Advisors on the Services Team

OpenFn is the digital public good for public service automation & AI orchestration. Our platform automates data exchange and digital workflows so that governments and NGOs can deliver public services more efficiently, achieve interoperability across fragmented systems, and scale critical public services across health, humanitarian, and government programs.

Our team, Open Function Group, the primary steward of this open-source platform, is a lean, fully-remote team of integration specialists, solution architects, and implementation consultants working across 40+ countries.

We are not making marginal improvements to already comfortable lives. We are building the infrastructure that allows governments to function, clinics to operate, and vulnerable populations to access services they depend on. The solutions you design will shape whether a ministry can reach its citizens, whether a health system can act on its own data, and whether a government can adopt AI on its own terms rather than someone else's.

The role

This is a chance to influence how governments approach AI adoption, public service automation, and digital transformation, not from the outside, but embedded in the delivery of real programs. This year we have 8 government implementations across Africa and Latin America, with global adoption accelerating, and we're at an inflection point in scaling that critical work. At the same time, we're trying to solve something few digital public goods have solved: how to be both deeply impactful and financially sustainable, borrowing hard-won lessons from enterprise software and open source companies and adapting them to markets those playbooks weren't built for. This role sits squarely at that intersection, owning both the impact and financial sustainability of what we deliver, because we believe the two are meant to reinforce each other, not compete.

We are hiring a Managing Director, Services to own the full portfolio of delivery work at OpenFn, from project-based implementations to the management and delivery of capacity building “expert days” on retainer for subscribing governments and iNGOs. This role is primarily about team leadership and enablement, business strategy, sales support and scoping, and technical/implementation strategy consulting for government clients and external partners, including both large consulting firms and small local implementers.

OpenFn's Services organization has historically operated like a traditional IT consulting practice: the same people won new business, scoped it, and delivered it. As we sell more subscription bundles and shift toward recurring, subscription-shaped revenue for our consulting, support, and expert-days work, that model is changing. Sales and account management responsibilities are moving into our Growth organization, and Services is becoming a focused delivery and technical authority function: accountable for scoping accuracy, delivery quality, and SLA performance, not for owning the entire end-to-end sales relationship.

You will be a central architect of that transition: helping design, validate, and then operationalize OpenFn's new subscription-centered delivery model. You’ll be part of the core strategy team, interfacing regularly with the Head of Product, Head of Growth, CEO and COO, while working closely with our Head of Implementation (who owns day-to-day portfolio execution and financial governance), our Growth organization's BD Leads and Partner Managers (who own new pipeline and deal-closing), and our Implementation Engineering Director (who owns technical architecture and quality across the delivery portfolio).

Think of this as the role that holds Services accountable for what it delivers, while giving the team the leadership, scoping discipline, and strategic clarity to thrive as the business model shifts underneath it.

What you’ll be doing

Team Leadership & Enablement

  • Lead and develop the Services leadership team, including the Head of Implementation, Director of Engineering, and senior engagement/consulting leads, ensuring they have the strategy, tools, and support to deliver high-quality, profitable work
  • Own hiring, performance management, and career development for the Services leadership bench
  • Maintain the operating rhythm (OKRs, review cadences, portfolio check-ins) that keeps Services focused on financial sustainability and delivery quality
  • Champion adoption of the Implementation Playbook, productization efforts, and AI tooling across the wider team, so delivery knowledge stops living in individual people's heads
  • Partner closely with the Head of Product to support strategic alignment and a continuous feedback loop between service delivery and the OpenFn platform

Sales Support, Scoping & Deal Negotiation

  • Partner closely with the Growth team during pre-sale to scope engagements accurately, size Expert Days allocations within subscription bundles, and structure pricing that protects target margins
  • Serve as the senior technical and delivery voice in deal negotiations, providing the delivery sign-off on scope, timeline, and resourcing that's required before any contract is signed
  • Advise Growth on what is realistically deliverable, flagging over-commitment risk before it reaches a client
  • Support RFP responses and proposal development for complex government and NGO engagements

Technical & Implementation Strategy Consulting

  • Serve as a trusted technical and strategic advisor to government ministries, NGOs, and implementation partners, including both large consulting firms and small local providers, on how to structure successful OpenFn-based programs
  • Advise ministry and NGO leadership on broader digital transformation and AI adoption strategy, not just OpenFn-specific implementation choices
  • Represent OpenFn in high-stakes client conversations, escalations, and strategic account relationships
  • Travel to conferences and partner workshops to represent OpenFn and provide expert strategic and technical advisory
  • Provide implementation strategy guidance that balances client needs, platform capabilities, and OpenFn's delivery capacity

Delivery Portfolio Oversight

  • Own the delivery-side financial accountability for the Services portfolio, translating booked revenue into profitable, efficient execution: gross margin, operating costs, and delivery efficiency against target
  • Oversee delivery of both traditional implementation projects and the expert-days component of subscription bundles, ensuring consistent quality and SLA adherence across both
  • Partner with the Head of Implementation on portfolio-level financial governance (dashboards, margin monitoring, invoicing discipline), while she owns day-to-day operational execution of these systems

Subscription Operating Model Design & Transition

  • Play a leading role in designing, validating, and operationalizing OpenFn's shift from a traditional IT-consulting delivery model to a subscription-shaped delivery and revenue model
  • Participate in OpenFn’s Global Strategy Team to design, validate, and iterate on our business model, including drawing on how established enterprise software and open source companies structure recurring-revenue delivery, and adapt those lessons to the realities of LMIC government and NGO markets
  • Help define how Services engages with the emerging “front door” structure: the division of labor between Growth (lead generation, pre-sale, partnerships) and Services (scoping input, SLA delivery, Expert Days, training, and implementation-partner enablement)
  • Provide input into pricing, scoping frameworks, and delivery playbooks specific to bundled subscriptions as they're piloted and rolled out
  • Identify and flag structural or operational gaps as the model evolves, and adapt team processes accordingly

Requirements

To successfully ensure the technical quality of solutions implemented by the OpenFn services team, you should have the following qualifications and be comfortable consulting with a diverse range of technical stakeholders.

  • 12+ years experience in technical or professional services delivery in B2B/B2G
  • 5+ years at a public-sector-facing technology organization
  • 3+ years leading a technical or professional services delivery team at a B2B or public-sector-facing technology organization
  • Demonstrated experience delivering large, national-scale technology implementations for government partners (e.g., national registries, health information systems, social protection platforms) is a strong advantage
  • Demonstrated experience owning portfolio-level financial accountability (gross margin, operating costs, and delivery efficiency against target); this role is accountable for efficient, profitable delivery of booked revenue, not a new-business sales target
  • Strong financial fluency: comfortable owning financial targets, and translating them into team-level operating discipline
  • Proven experience managing and developing a team of managers or technical delivery leads, not just individual contributors
  • Experience scoping and negotiating complex, multi-stakeholder deals, ideally with government, NGO, or large enterprise clients
  • Willingness to travel internationally (at least once per quarter) for conferences, partner meetings, and government workshops
  • Working knowledge of the operational differences between project-based (services) and subscription-based (recurring) revenue models, and how delivery needs to adapt between them
  • Demonstrated experience being the senior technical/delivery voice in commercial negotiations and public sector contracts
  • Experience working with or managing external implementation partners (systems integrators, consulting firms, or similar)
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication, including facilitating strategic conversations with government and NGO stakeholders
  • Working proficiency in French or Spanish is a strong advantage
  • Background in international development, digital public goods, govtech, or global health is a strong advantage
  • Proven ability to operate effectively in a lean, fully-remote, distributed organization
  • Ability to work from home or a shared office space with fast, stable internet, preferably in a country that is located in Africa/Europe time zones

Benefits

Financial compensation is commensurate with experience.

N.B.: Selling to NGO & government customers, we don’t offer Silicon Valley pay, but high quality of life and fair, transparent, and competitive compensation is important to us.

Flexible working schedule.

We’re fully remote, with team meetups across Europe and Africa (our last three were in Kigali, Cape Town, and Dakar).

Exposure to hottest industry and technology trends and leading health and humanitarian interventions in the sector.

Opportunity for leadership and advancement. You will be a key contributor to our company’s strategy and direction.

The opportunity to shape our strategy and impact millions of lives through our open source software in a small, mission-driven organization.

Position Overview

Blue Acorn iCi is seeking a Senior Consultant, AJO to design, implement, and optimize personalized customer engagement solutions using Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) and Adobe Experience Platform (AEP).
This role partners with clients to translate business objectives into customer journeys, audience strategies, and cross-channel campaigns. The ideal candidate combines hands-on AJO implementation experience with a strong understanding of customer data, personalization, analytics, and marketing technology, along with the consulting skills to guide stakeholders from discovery through launch and ongoing optimization.

Location: Remote - United States

Key Responsibilities
Customer Journey Strategy & Implementation

  • Facilitate discovery sessions to understand client objectives, customer lifecycle needs, engagement use cases, analytical questions, and intended business outcomes.
  • Translate business requirements into solution designs, implementation plans, measurement approaches, technical documentation, and clear decision criteria.
  • Design, configure, and maintain customer journeys and campaigns in AJO, including entry criteria, events, conditions, actions, and cross-channel orchestration.
  • Implement customer engagement programs that support acquisition, onboarding, retention, and re-engagement.

Campaign Execution & Personalization

  • Collaborate with creative, content, and marketing teams to ensure messages align with campaign goals and brand standards.
  • Apply consent preferences, suppression rules, and contact frequency requirements to journey and campaign execution.
  • Perform end-to-end testing, troubleshoot issues, and support launch readiness and deployment.

Adobe Experience Platform & Customer Data

  • Define audience segmentation requirements and validate audience readiness for activation.
  • Partner with data engineers and architects to ensure customer attributes and events are available, accurate, and suitable for the intended use case.
  • Support data ingestion and integration requirements between AEP, AJO, and connected enterprise systems.
  • Apply data governance and consent requirements throughout solution delivery.

Analytics, Measurement & Optimization

  • Connect customer, campaign, operational, and financial evidence to business value, ROI, opportunities, and performance gaps.
  • Synthesize findings, options, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations into clear, executive-ready stories.

Client Consulting & Collaboration

  • Serve as a client-facing subject matter expert for AJO implementation and optimization.
  • Collaborate with marketing operations, data engineering, architecture, analytics, delivery, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Facilitate stakeholder workshops, solution demonstrations, difficult analytical discussions, and knowledge-transfer sessions.
  • Mentor junior team members through coaching, review, analytical problem solving, and actionable feedback.
  • Strengthen reusable delivery practices, analytical standards, data documentation, and quality processes within the assigned area.

  • Experience working with Adobe XDM schemas, datasets, identity structures, and data ingestion processes.

  • Understanding of consent management, data governance, campaign quality assurance, and data-quality considerations.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, workshop facilitation, analytical storytelling, and stakeholder communication skills.

If you’re ready to push boundaries, deliver real value, and help shape the next generation of digital experiences—this is your place.
