Porch Light Health is a local leader in outpatient treatment of Opioid Use Disorders and other addictive disorders. We foster a family environment where patients are treated with compassion and honesty. We believe that addiction is a chronic relapsing brain disease. Our staff is passionate about helping other people. We offer Medication Assisted Treatment and behavioral health services. We believe there is life beyond addiction and strive to help our patients discover their purpose and community in a healthy environment.

Who are you:

Porch Light Health is looking for a licensed Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant with certification in Psychiatry to work virtually and/or in-clinic to support our patients via telehealth to our clinics across Colorado and New Mexico.

Looking for a Medical Provider that is empathetic, non-judgmental, works well on teams, understands the “harm reduction” approach when it comes to treating substance use disorders and psychiatric illness, and can work within certain prescribing parameters. We are professional, agile and collaborative team. The right candidate will be willing to be cross trained in delivering Medication for Addiction Treatment (MAT).

Clinical Setting:

  • Virtual/telehealth to support our patients for our clinics across Colorado and New Mexico
  • Must currently reside in Colorado or New Mexico and be licensed
  • Mental health providers do not prescribe controlled substances.

Qualifications:

  • Completes medication and health education to include but not limited to informed consent, benefits, risks, side effects, and alternative treatments for medications ordered, health/wellness management, metabolic risk reduction strategies
  • Competent and comfortable with conducting Telemedicine technology appointments- both for intake and follow up encounters
  • Completion of an accredited Psychiatric Mental Practitioner program, required
  • Current Licensed Practitioner with full active and unrestricted licensure in the state of practice (CO and NM) and active state DEA License required
  • At least 1 Year of Psych providing and working in EMR systems
  • Skills:

    • Strong clinical assessment and diagnostic skills.
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
    • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to build rapport with patients and collaborate effectively with healthcare teams.
    • Understanding of regulatory compliance and documentation requirements in MAT settings.

Job Duties:

  • The Psychiatric Practitioner provides direct client care, including assessing, diagnosing, planning, and prescribing pharmacologic and non-pharmacologic treatment of health problems, health promotion and preventive care within this specialized area of practice
  • Performs psychiatric diagnostic evaluations to determine diagnoses, treatment strategies, and care coordination needs for clients with mental health, substance use, or other psychiatric and medical needs
  • Provide all psychiatric and/or medical services within reasonable and expected medical standards, timelines, and in conformance with all requirements imposed by the applicable health licensing boards
  • Applies medical knowledge and skills to the process of diagnosis, prevention, and treatment of illnesses
  • Maintain timely, complete, accurate and legible medical records for all patients evaluated and treated by the Practitioner in organization medical record system
  • Performs timely, concurrent, accurate clinical/billing documentation meeting professional standards in compliance with State and Federal regulations, clinical necessity, and appropriate coding standards
  • Performs pharmacologic treatment strategies, orders medications, monitors, and evaluates progress on psychiatric and/or other medications
  • Order, obtain and assess appropriate laboratory tests and diagnostics. Base clinical decisions on laboratory interpretation
  • Assures timely access to care, demonstrates flexibility in scheduling to fully meet client needs, and meets applicable productivity standards
  • The Provider will assume client care responsibilities inclusive of psychiatric evaluation, professional diagnoses and prescribing and/or administering treatment
  • Collaborates with MD or DO for challenging or complex cases
  • Remain in compliance with state laws and regulations for Psychiatry, including meeting supervised hour requirements, CME, and completing appropriate assessments in timely manner with supervising physician

  • Paid time off

Schedule:

Village Capital is a global leader in impact investing, helping early-stage startups access the type of social and financial capital they need to grow – reshaping the supply and demand sides of capital flows as a result. As our work continues to expand globally, we are looking to build a network of talented professionals (experienced consultants, specialists, and independent contractors) to join our contractor/consultant pool and support fundraising, partnership development, investor engagement, and business development operations.

Scope of Work

We are interested in connecting with professionals who bring expertise in one or more of the areas below and are interested in collaborating with us through flexible engagement models, including project-based assignments, part-time support, retainers, or ongoing partnerships.

Prospecting

  • Conduct targeted prospecting to identify potential partners, funders, and strategic opportunities aligned with Village Capital’s priorities across its operating regions.
  • Develop curated prospect lists that include prospect profiles, research-based partnership alignment analysis, relevant areas of interest, recommended engagement targets, and identified points of contact.
  • Cross-reference identified prospects against HubSpot and available internal records to validate information, avoid duplication, and ensure accurate pipeline tracking.
  • Prepare tailored outreach messaging that reflects the prospect’s priorities, relationship context, and alignment with Village Capital’s programs and impact areas.
  • Support thematic prospecting exercises focused on priority impact areas, including regenerative economics and disability innovation.
  • Maintain prospect list by supporting Village Capital staff with relevant follow ups and progression of opportunities (cold-warm-hot) as relevant.

Concept Note Development

  • In partnership with Village Capital communications team, develop initial drafts of concept notes and related written materials to support partnership cultivation and funding opportunities.
  • Coordinate with relevant program and investment teams to gather inputs, incorporate feedback, refine content, develop case studies, and support the finalization of materials, including edits and design preparation.

Proposal Development

  • Develop draft proposal materials, including narrative sections, budgets, theory of change, KPIs, impact metrics, and other supporting documentation, ensuring alignment with partner requirements and Village Capital program priorities.
  • Coordinate the completion of required due diligence, KYC, and partner compliance documentation to facilitate timely and accurate proposal submissions.

Conference/Event List Reviews

  • Review conference attendance lists to identify potential partners and funders aligned with Village Capital’s current priorities, and share with internal teams for review.
  • Scan conferences globally to develop short-list of potential new conferences and events for Village Capital to attend, with the goal of improving business development reach and converting prospects.

Internal Business Development Coordination

  • Review internal or inbound lead submissions to assess alignment with Village Capital priorities by responding to BD-requests and BD-lead workflows on Slack and ensure opportunities are documented and routed appropriately.
  • Support coordination across regional teams by documenting updates, aligning on opportunity progress, and tracking follow-up actions from internal coordination sessions, including drafting agenda for biweekly BD calls.

HubSpot Management

  • Maintain and review HubSpot CRM records to ensure accurate opportunity tracking, updated pipeline stages, and reliable reporting on partnership development activities.
  • Prepare HubSpot reports, data extracts, and reporting snapshots to provide visibility into opportunity updates, pipeline health, and progress toward business development goals.

Engagement Structure

Consultants may be engaged on a project, retainer, hourly, or fixed-fee basis, depending on organizational priorities and business needs. Joining the contractor pool does not guarantee an engagement but provides an opportunity to be considered for future consulting opportunities as they arise.

We're not looking for someone who simply manages a campaign calendar. We're looking for someone who asks: what can we do that nobody else in our category is doing - and just as importantly, did it work?

  • Strong understanding of internet culture, emerging creative formats, and what gets people talking

title: Director of CS, SMB
description: ParentSquare is a rapidly growing Santa Barbara-based company that’s changing the way schools and parents communicate every day.

raw.title: Director of CS, SMB
raw.excerpt: ParentSquare is a rapidly growing Santa Barbara-based company that’s changing the way schools and parents communicate every day.
raw.description:
ParentSquare is a rapidly growing Santa Barbara-based company that’s changing the way schools and parents communicate every day. Sound simple? We strive to keep it that way! Our mission is to give schools the power to incredibly enhance family engagement for all students. ParentSquare and RemindHub, our flagship products, serve over 22 million students and drive our mission by providing unified communications tools -forms, sign ups, payments, RSVPs, direct messaging, language translations, chat and more. Remind Chat, our free product, reaches over 80% of K-12 students, providing a safe and easy-to-use platform for direct communication between teachers and families. And our latest innovation, SmartSites, offers state-of-the-art websites for school districts, enhancing their online presence and accessibility.

We are not just creating a product; we are creating empowered educators and engaged parents to improve the lives of all students. We are passionate advocates for our customers and for our employees and we invite you to join us on this exciting journey.

Who we’re looking for:

We’re looking for a Director, Customer Success – SMB to own the strategy and the outcomes for our largest customer segment: more than 6,000 small and single-site districts across the country. You’ll be the leader accountable for how we show up for these customers at scale.

You’ll own our 1:many customer success motion end to end — the digital-first engagement model, the programs and playbooks behind it, and the adoption and retention numbers it produces. You’ll lead and grow our SMB customer success team, shape the operating and coverage model for the segment, and represent SMB when we’re deciding where to invest.

This is where customer outcomes and operational efficiency go hand in hand. We want thousands more districts getting real value from ParentSquare, and we want to get there through a model built to scale. You’ll be the one who takes it there.

Most importantly, you’re someone who shares in our passion for improving the lives of students through communication.

This role will include:

  • Own adoption, retention, and expansion outcomes for our SMB segment, and report on them to our executive team
  • Set the strategy for our 1:many motion, which uses a mix of automated, digital, and live touchpoints across onboarding, adoption, renewal, and expansion
  • Lead, hire, and develop our SMB customer success team, shaping the structure, coverage model, and career paths as the team and customer base grow
  • Scale the operating model behind the segment: enrollment thresholds, coverage ratios, capacity planning, and the efficiency targets that support them
  • Partner with our Marketing and Customer Education teams on workshops, community programming, and lifecycle campaigns that reach thousands of districts at once
  • Work with Customer Success Operations to operationalize the journey through the data, signals, and automation our motion depends on
  • Align with Sales, Marketing, and Product on identifying expansion signals across the segment and acting on them
  • Measure the effectiveness of our SMB programs, and move your team’s effort toward what the data shows is working

Our ideal candidate will have the following:

  • 8+ years in Customer Success or Account Management within SaaS, where you’ve owned retention and adoption outcomes directly
  • 4+ years of people leadership, including developing managers or leading a multi-layer team
  • Experience building or scaling a 1:many, digital-first customer success motion — automation, digital campaigns, webinars, office hours
  • A high-volume segment you’ve owned outcomes for, and the operational rigor to run it: segmentation, coverage models, capacity planning
  • Comfort using customer data and usage signals to decide where your team spends its time and where risk is building
  • A strategic mindset paired with operational follow-through — you can design the system and make sure it actually runs
  • Strong executive communication, and the ability to influence across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations

The perks of working for us are great!

You’ll get your foot in the door as our company continues to grow. We’re big believers in work-life balance and provide:

  • Employer-paid health insurance (including dependent coverage)
  • An employer-matched 401K retirement savings program from day 1
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Stock options
  • Health + wellness reimbursements
  • PTO that increases each year
  • 15 paid holidays, including your birthday!

As a fully remote team, we’ll make sure you have all the tools and equipment you need to make your home office a place where you can thrive.

We're an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. We are committed to maintaining a drug-free workplace in compliance with applicable state laws.

The salary range for this role will be $110,000-$130,000, DOE.

raw.title: Respiratory Therapist
raw.excerpt: ResPro Health is committed to supporting healthcare providers in the respiratory field by offering resources and tools to implement impactful programs such as remote patient monitoring and chronic care management.
raw.description:
ResPro Health is committed to supporting healthcare providers in the respiratory field by offering resources and tools to implement impactful programs such as remote patient monitoring and chronic care management. As a Respiratory Therapist with our team, you will have the opportunity to engage with patients daily, ensuring compliance with prescribed therapies and improving overall outcomes. Working from the comfort of your own home, you will collaborate with a dedicated team of specialists to enhance patient care and drive innovation in respiratory medicine.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide clinical oversight and guidance to Certified Medical Assistants
  • Manage and support patients on Advanced BiPAP ST, AVAPS, IVAPS, ASV
  • Assist CPAP patients with specialized needs
  • Recommend adjustments to PAP settings and create orders in electronic medical records
  • Educate and coach patients on CPAP devices and care
  • Identify and address barriers to compliance for advanced PAP machine patients
  • Collaborate with providers and escalate any concerns as needed
  • Coordinate and order CPAP supplies for advanced PAP machines
  • Maintain accurate patient records and stay current on respiratory therapy practices

Requirements

  • Valid Respiratory Therapists (RT) license
  • Minimum of 2 years experience as a Respiratory Therapist
  • Knowledge of respiratory therapy equipment and procedures
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment
  • Attention to detail and BLS certification

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental, Vision)

- Life Insurance options

- Unlimited Paid Time Off

- Training and Development opportunities

  • Full Time position with a salary range of 55-60K

raw.description:
📍 Parma / Bologna / Hybrid | 🚀 Venture Building | 💡 Agrifood Tech & Innovation

CDP Venture Capital, insieme a Mutti, Sipcam Oxon, Spreafico, Crédit Agricole Italia, e GELLIFY, lancia Novagria Ventures: il nuovo Venture Builder dedicato alla filiera agroalimentare italiana.

🎯 Obiettivo: creare fino a 6 nuove startup in 3 anni, mobilitando oltre 45 milioni di euro di investimenti complessivi per colmare i gap di digitalizzazione e sostenibilità della filiera.

👀 Cosa facciamo

Novagria Ventures costruisce startup da zero, partendo dai bisogni reali della filiera agroalimentare — dal campo alla tavola — per sviluppare soluzioni innovative in:

  • Agritech & Smart Farming
  • Digital Supply Chain & B2B Platforms
  • Food Safety, Tracciabilità e Sostenibilità
  • AI, IoT e Biotech applicati al settore agroalimentare

Novagria Ventures ti fornirà un ecosistema potente, un metodo strutturato, e il supporto economico e strategico per portare le idee al mercato.

🚀 Il ruolo

Cerchiamo l'Entrepreneur in Residence che guiderà una nuova venture nell'ambito della digitalizzazione della filiera agroalimentare, con focus su supply chain e procurement B2B. La venture si concentra sul settore delle biomasse. Il prodotto sarà una piattaforma di supply chain intelligence B2B pensata per questo mercato. Partirai da una value proposition già pre-validata dal team GELLIFY. Il tuo compito sarà trasformarla in un prodotto e in un business sostenibile, fino al lancio sul mercato.

Il lavoro inizia dentro Novagria Ventures, dove l'idea viene validata, prototipata e lanciata. Se genera abbastanza traction, costruirai il round di finanziamento che porterà la venture a scorporarsi da Novagria. A quel punto sarai tu a guidare la crescita della nuova impresa.

Cosa farai

Validazione della Value Proposition:

  • Affini la value proposition e il modello di business
  • Validi target user, target customer e user journey
  • Definisci una strategia di go-to-market coerente

Sviluppo MVP & Validazione di mercato:

  • Progetti un MVP digitale, anche no-code o low-code
  • Testi il problem-solution fit con clienti reali
  • Analizzi le metriche chiave: adozione, conversione, retention, willingness to pay
  • Iteri value proposition e business model in base ai test

Go-to-Market & Early Growth:

  • Lanci campagne di marketing sperimentale
  • Validi i canali di acquisizione
  • Ottieni i primi clienti o PoC

Fundraising e Leadership:

· Guidi la costruzione del round della venture

· Rappresenti l'opportunità a business angel, corporate e investitori

· Costruisci il founding team

Obiettivi del ruolo

· Validare rapidamente problema, soluzione e mercato

· Identificare value proposition e business model chiari, con i primi clienti paganti

· Portare la startup al seed round entro 6-9 mesi

· Diventare CEO e co-founder della nuova impresa

💡Chi cerchiamo

  • 5–10 anni di esperienza in startup, product, growth, innovation o venture building
  • Esperienza diretta nella validazione di prodotti digitali e MVP
  • Forte attitudine imprenditoriale, visione strategica e capacità di execution
  • Capacità di guidare team cross-funzionali e gestire l’incertezza tipica dell’early stage

Plus: esperienza da founder, fundraising o product-led growth.

💰 Cosa offriamo

  • Retribuzione durante il periodo di lavoro all’interno di Novagria
  • Equity nella startup che sarà scorporata
  • Lavoro full-remote
  • Opportunità concreta di diventare CEO e co-founder di una startup backed da corporate top-tier

🌍 Perché unirti a noi

👉 Costruisci startup con impatto reale sulla filiera agroalimentare
👉 Lavora con partner industriali di livello mondiale
👉 Accedi al network di CDP Venture Capital e GELLIFY
👉 Impara un metodo replicabile per lanciare startup da zero

🌾 Come candidarti

Crediamo che le persone straordinarie si riconoscano da come pensano, non solo dal CV.
Oltre a inviare il tuo CV o profilo LinkedIn, ti chiediamo di allegare un breve video Loom (max 1 minuto) in cui ci racconti:

  1. Quali problemi ti appassionano oggi e perché
  2. Raccontaci un progetto o un’idea che hai validato o costruito da zero
  3. Perché pensi di essere la persona giusta per costruire con noi, adesso

Non serve un video perfetto: vogliamo solo conoscerti, capire il tuo modo di pensare e sentire la tua energia.
🎬 Registra su loom.com (o un qualsiasi link video privato) e condividilo nel form di candidatura.

Vuoi costruire la prossima startup che digitalizzerà e renderà sostenibile la filiera agroalimentare italiana?
💥 Unisciti a Novagria Ventures e diventa protagonista dell’innovazione Made in Italy.

Position Summary

The Contracts Specialist supports the Senior Contract Analyst in managing the lifecycle of company contracts and agreements. This role focuses on contract preparation, review, tracking, and compliance oversight to reduce operational and legal risk. The position coordinates across departments to ensure contracts are accurate, compliant, and executed efficiently.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Assist with drafting, formatting, proofreading, and redlining company contracts and agreements.
  • Review contracts for accuracy, completeness, and consistency with company standards.
  • Prepare contract packages using Adobe tools and standardized templates.
  • Track, maintain, and verify that contract requirements are being met by roofing installers.
  • Maintain contract records, version control, and supporting documentation in company systems.
  • Identify missing documentation or contract risks and escalate appropriately.
  • Ensure contracts comply with applicable state regulations, licensing requirements, and company standards.
  • Coordinate with internal departments and external parties to move contracts through review and execution.

Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Acrobat editing and redlining required.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word contract formatting required.
  • Excel proficiency required, including the ability to create, manage, and analyze tracking spreadsheets.
  • Experience with Smartsheet or similar project tracking systems preferred.
  • Comfort working with digital document management systems.

Core Competencies

  • Attention to detail and accuracy in reviewing and preparing legal documents.
  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to prioritize competing deadlines and manage a high volume of documents without loss of accuracy.
  • Organized and self-directed follow-through on open items and outstanding documentation.
  • Collaborative approach to working across departments and with outside parties.

Experience

Three to five years of experience in contract administration, compliance, or the construction industry required. Roofing industry experience is strongly preferred.

Education

Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.

This position description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties. Responsibilities may change based on business needs.

Requirements

This is a full time role

Rate is up to $7/hr

100% Remote

raw.description:
SUMMARY:

Leads the design, development, and support of modern software solutions in an Agile/Scrum and DevOps environment, with specialization in Enterprise Content Management (ECM) and workflow automation. Applies modern engineering practices CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, and observability to deliver secure, resilient, and scalable services. Provides technical leadership for ECM technologies (e.g., OnBase, Kofax, ImageRight or similar) and integrates content services with enterprise applications and cloud platforms.

RESPONSIBILITIES/TASKS:

  • Serves as technical lead for Enterprise Content Management (ECM) platforms and content services (e.g., OnBase, Kofax, ImageRight), including workflow automation, integrations, and platform modernization.
  • Leads end to end delivery for ECM and content enabled applicationsplanning, design, build, test, release, and support and ensures alignment to enterprise architecture standards.
  • Partners with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, architects, and business stakeholders to refine roadmaps, define outcomes, and prioritize backlogs; translates requirements into executable delivery plans.
  • Implements Agile/Scrum practices and DevOps automation CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code quality gates, and infrastructure as code and drives release management across environments to improve delivery speed and reliability.
  • Provides technical direction to the team establishes patterns, ensures consistent implementation, and coaches engineers through design and delivery decisions.
  • Diagnoses and resolves incidents and performance issues across ECM platforms, APIs/integrations, and supporting services (application, database, and infrastructure).
  • Works with the Product Team to ensure user stories for content capture, workflow, and records requirements are developer-ready with clear acceptance criteria and test scenarios.
  • Builds automated tests and performs resiliency, failover, and load testing to validate nonfunctional requirements for ECM services in production.
  • Ensures ECM solutions align with security, retention, privacy, and audit requirements; partners with IT Security and Records to implement governance controls.
  • Leads and participates in engineering excellence activities design reviews, architecture discussions, communities of practice and mentors engineers on modern development practices.
  • Performs and facilitates code reviews to enforce standards, secure coding practices, and maintainable designs; drives consistent patterns for integrations and workflow components.
  • Drives operational readiness monitoring/alerting, runbooks, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement to maintain high availability in production.
  • Extensive knowledge of software architecture and design, modern engineering practices, and delivery including Agile/Scrum, CI/CD, and DevOps operations.
  • Expertise with cloud technologies (Azure, O365, AWS) and enterprise platforms (e.g., SharePoint) and experience integrating with ECM/content services.
  • Ability to build services and applications using .NET / ASP.NET / C# / SQL Server and integrate with CRM and other enterprise systems.
  • Experience integrating ECM platforms via REST/SOAP APIs, webhooks, and eventdriven patterns; strong understanding of content capture, indexing, and workflow concepts.

  • Strong knowledge of C#, .Net framework, Asp.Net, and MVC.

  • Strong knowledge of OOAD and multi-tier architectures, including MVC/MVP/MVVM design patterns.

  • Strong knowledge of web services, WCF, REST, and SOA Architecture.

  • Knowledge with MS Entity Framework.

  • Strong knowledge of MVC GUI design including the ability to incorporate JQuery, JavaScript and CSS, plus expertise with AJAX/SPA.

  • Expertise with tools such as MS SQL Studio, PL/SQL Developer / Toad etc.

  • Strong analytical, problem solving, and planning skills.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

  • Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.

  • Team player who is flexible, delivery-oriented, and takes responsibility for the team’s success.

  • Enthusiastic attitude with the drive to continually learn and improve.

This position description identifies the responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the performance of the position. Other relevant essential functions may be required.

EMPLOYMENT QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION OR EQUIVALENT EXPERIENCE:

Bachelor’s degree in information services or related field.Combinations of relevant education and experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. Continuous learning, as defined by the Company’s learning philosophy, is required.Certification or progress toward certification is highly preferred and encouraged.

EXPERIENCE:

Minimum seven years experience of development and system design which provides the necessary skills, knowledge, and abilities.

SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE/ABILITIES (SKA) REQUIRED:

  • Ability to understand business needs and conceptualize and implement information systems that support those business strategies.
  • Experience working within an agile framework like Scrum based development organization.
  • Thorough knowledge of departmental procedures processes and work flows.
  • Knowledge of standard languages, coding methods, company coding standards and quality requirements.

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills required.

  • Demonstrated abilities to successfully document and communicate software platform designs to all levels of staff (technical and non-technical).

  • Ability to work constructively with other technical experts in a group setting.

  • Knowledge of object-oriented development languages and web-related technologies.

  • Ability to comprehend the consequences of various problem situations and address them, or refer them for appropriate decision making.
  • Ability to effectively exchange information clearly and concisely, and present ideas, reports facts and other information, and respond to questions as appropriate.
  • Demonstrated leadership abilities.
  • Ability to make competent, independent decisions.
  • Ability to manage technical services and software vendors.
  • Ability and proficiency in the use of project management tools and techniques.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality.
  • Ability to perform other assignments at locations outside the office.

RECOMMENDED SKILLS/QUALIFICATIONS (ADDITIONAL)

  • Experience with Enterprise Content Management (ECM) platforms, including:

    • OnBase by Hyland (workflow design, Unity scripting, WorkView, API integrations)

    • Kofax (Capture, Transformation Modules, workflow automation)

    • ImageRight (content storage, workflow configuration, system administration)

    • Other ECM/document‑management systems supporting imaging, workflow, and records retention

  • Ability to integrate ECM platforms with enterprise applications, including .NET systems, CRM platforms, and cloud services.

  • Knowledge of document capture, indexing, classification, and automated workflow design.

  • Experience modernizing or migrating legacy ECM solutions to cloud or hybrid architectures.

  • Familiarity with REST APIs, webhooks, and service‑based integrations used in ECM ecosystems.

  • Understanding of security, retention, and governance practices related to enterprise content.

  • Ability to troubleshoot and optimize ECM workflows and performance.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

Work is performed mainly in an office environment with minimal hazards. Ability to work extended hours as needed. Travel may be required.

PAY RANGE:

It is not standard practice for an offer to be at or near the top of the range, and therefore a reasonable estimate for this role is between $82,900 and $217,250.”

raw.description:
We are looking for an experienced Data Engineering Lead to play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering our enterprise data platform. This is an exciting opportunity to lead the development of scalable, secure, and AI-ready modern data platform that enable advanced analytics, reporting, automated and AI-enabled processes, and the creation of data powered digital products.
Working closely with Data Architecture, Analytics, and wider business teams, you will be responsible for designing and maintaining robust data pipelines, integrating multiple business systems, and ensuring data remains trusted, accessible, consistent, and fit for purpose.
This role is ideal for a technically strong data engineering professional who enjoys combining hands-on delivery with leadership and continuous improvement.

What you will do?

As our Data Engineering Lead, you will:
  • Design, develop and maintain enterprise ETL/ELT pipelines, integrating data from case management, finance, CRM and third-party systems into a central data platform.
  • Lead the development and continuous improvement of our cloud-based data platform within Azure.
  • Ensure data pipelines are scalable, reliable, cost-effective and resilient.
  • Build and maintain datasets that support business reporting, analytics, dashboards and data-enabled products.
  • Establish and champion engineering best practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, version control, monitoring and alerting on pipeline failures.
  • Work closely with Data Architects to implement target-state data models and modern data engineering principles.
  • Partner with data scientists and analysts to operationalise advanced analytics and predictive models.
  • Manage integrations with insurer portals and external data providers, ensuring high-quality, timely and secure data flows.
  • Support the organisation's ambition to become increasingly data-driven and AI-enabled.

Who you are

Essential Experience & Skills
  • Proven experience in a senior Data Engineering or Lead Data Engineer role.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure data technologies, including:
    • Azure Data Factory
    • Azure Synapse Analytics
    • Microsoft Fabric
    • Azure Data Lake
  • Advanced SQL development skills.
  • Proficiency in Python and modern data pipeline orchestration tools, including their monitoring and automation.
  • Track record of building reliable, monitored production-grade data pipelines.
  • Experience integrating data from multiple business-critical applications and legacy systems.
  • Good understanding of data security, data protection and access control principles within cloud-based data platforms.
  • Comfortable working in regulated data environments with sensitive personal and litigation data.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
Desirable Experience
  • Exposure to predictive analytics, machine learning operationalisation or AI platforms.
  • Experience working with Dynamics CRM, case management platforms such as VisualFiles, and finance systems such as Elite 3E.
  • Understanding of data modelling and data architecture best practices.
  • Experience leading or mentoring data engineering teams.
  • Experience within insurance, legal services, claims management or financial services is desirable but not mandatory.
Why Join Us?
This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of data engineering within a growing, data-driven organisation.
You'll have the opportunity to:
  • Be part of an exciting journey reshaping how data and AI are used in claims management.
  • Play a key role in our major transformation initiatives and the creation of our modern cloud data platform.
  • Work with cutting-edge Azure and AI technologies.
  • Influence strategic data decisions across the business.
  • Deliver solutions that directly improve operational performance and customer outcomes.
  • Join a collaborative and forward-thinking Data & Analytics function.
Success MeasuresSuccess in this role will be measured by:
  • Reliability and performance of data pipelines and platform services.
  • Delivery of high-quality, trusted data products.
  • Reduction in data-related incidents and support issues.
  • Improved data accessibility and adoption across the business.
  • Successful implementation of engineering best practices and automation.
  • Enablement of analytics, reporting and AI initiatives through scalable data pipelines and architecture.
Ready to Apply?If you are passionate about building modern data platforms and turning complex data challenges into business value, we'd love to hear from you. Join us and play a key role in shaping the future of data across the organisation.

What's in it for you?

  • High levels of flexibility and a great work life balance -
  • A well-rounded remuneration package (which includes private medical insurance, income protection insurance and discounted gym membership, amongst many other benefits)
  • Opportunities for growth and progression including professional funding
  • In person and remote social events
  • Opportunity to get involved in a range of Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) activities
We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, which aligns closely to our cultural principles (Determined, Clear, Creative and Supportive). If you are excited about this role and being part of our culture, but your past experience does not align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles!

AI Pipeline Engineer- Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: AI Pipeline Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
PositionType: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
ExperienceRequired: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an AI Pipeline Engineer to build and operate the large-scale data systems that power modern AI training and evaluation pipelines. The role combines deep data engineering expertise with a strong understanding of AI workloads, focusing on ingestion, transformation, quality assurance, lineage, and high-throughput delivery of data to training jobs across diverse modalities. The ideal candidate has experience operating petabyte-scale data systems, strong software engineering fundamentals, and clear understanding of how data infrastructure choices propagate into model quality and training efficiency.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and operate large-scale data pipelines supporting AI training, evaluation, and continual improvement workflows.
  • Build ingestion systems for diverse modalities including text, image, audio, video, and structured signals.
  • Implement data cleaning, deduplication, filtering, and quality assurance at petabyte scale.
  • Develop dataset versioning, lineage, and provenance tracking systems suitable for reproducible training.
  • Build high-throughput data loading systems that maximize GPU utilization during training.
  • Implement labeling workflows, active learning pipelines, and human-in-the-loop data improvement systems.
  • Design storage architectures balancing cost, throughput, and latency across data tiers.
  • Build evaluation dataset construction pipelines with strict integrity and contamination controls.
  • Implement data privacy, redaction, and consent enforcement throughout the pipeline.
  • Collaborate with ML researchers and engineers to align data systems with model development needs.
  • Drive observability of data quality, drift, and pipeline health across the AI data estate.
  • Optimize cost and performance through compression, format selection, and caching strategies.
  • Document data systems, schemas, and operational procedures for broad internal use.
  • Stay current with AI data infrastructure research and emerging open-source tools.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Six or more years of data engineering experience, with significant work supporting ML or AI workloads.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and at least one JVM or systems language.
  • Deep experience with modern data processing frameworks such as Spark, Ray, or Beam.
  • Hands-on experience operating petabyte-scale storage and pipeline systems.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, data modeling, and storage formats.
  • Experience with dataset versioning, lineage, and reproducibility for ML workflows.
  • Familiarity with high-throughput data loading for accelerator-based training.
  • Strong software engineering practices including testing, CI/CD, and code review.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with multimodal datasets at large scale.
  • Familiarity with data quality tooling and dataset evaluation methodology.
  • Exposure to privacy-preserving data systems and regulated data handling.
  • Open-source contributions to data infrastructure projects.
  • Experience supporting frontier model training pipelines.

How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to  or contact us at (908) 505-3544. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at .

Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Job Title: Customer Acquisition Specialist

Location: Caribbean Region

Job Level: Full-Time | Fully Remote (2-year renewable contract)

Job Summary

The Customer Acquisition Specialist at The Hive Careers is responsible for developing and executing strategies to attract new clients, expand the company's customer base, and strengthen client relationships through proactive outreach. This role works closely with the marketing and sales teams to generate leads, optimize conversion funnels, support client outreach initiatives, and ensure a seamless onboarding experience for new customers.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation: Identify and engage potential customers through various channels, including digital marketing, social media, email campaigns, networking events, and direct outreach.

Client Outreach: Conduct proactive outreach to prospective clients through email, phone calls, social platforms, and other communication channels to build relationships, introduce services, and convert leads into customers.

Marketing Funnel Optimization: Analyze and improve the customer journey from awareness to conversion, ensuring efficient processes that maximize acquisition rates.

Data Analysis: Monitor and evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer acquisition and outreach efforts, providing regular reports and insights to guide strategic decisions.

Collaboration: Work closely with the marketing and sales teams to align acquisition strategies with overall business objectives and maintain consistent messaging across all platforms.

Customer Onboarding: Oversee the onboarding process for new clients, ensuring a positive experience that supports long-term relationships.

Market Research: Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and customer preferences to identify new growth opportunities.

Budget Management: Manage acquisition budgets effectively, ensuring resources are allocated strategically to meet targets.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Proven experience in customer acquisition, client outreach, sales, or marketing roles
  • At least 3-5 years experience in B2B client acquisition

Key Skills

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Proficiency in CRM software and marketing tools
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
  • Self-motivated with a results-oriented approach

raw.description:
About Us

Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.
Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.
Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at .

Role Summary

The Senior Director, MSP Channel Sales leads the strategy, growth, and operating performance of the Sophos Managed Service Provider (MSP) channel program across the Americas. This role influences future channel strategy and business results by translating market, partner, and customer insights into scalable go-to-market models that expand recurring revenue, increase active MSP productivity, and strengthen Sophos’ position in the managed security services market.

Reporting to senior channel leadership, this role leads key business operations through direct and matrixed teams and serves as the executive voice of the MSP business. The Senior Director sets the Americas MSP channel vision, aligns regional execution with global priorities, manages strategic partner and distributor relationships, and influences program design, pricing, product readiness, enablement, and investment decisions. Success requires a strategic, hands-on leader who can build market opportunities, negotiate complex decisions, and deliver consistent end-to-end execution.

What You Will Do

  • Set MSP strategy and direction: Define the multi-year Americas MSP channel strategy and operating plan, aligned with Sophos business priorities, global partner strategy, product direction, and market trends.
  • Own program performance: Lead the regional execution and continuous improvement of the Sophos MSP channel program, including partner recruitment, onboarding, activation, tier progression, enablement, retention, and expansion.
  • Translate program benefits, requirements, specializations, and rules of engagement into clear sales motions that help MSPs deliver security-as-a-service and grow recurring revenue.
  • Drive revenue and partner productivity: Own MSP bookings, recurring revenue, pipeline, forecast accuracy, partner-sourced and co-sell performance, product adoption, retention, churn management, and expansion across the MSP portfolio, protecting and growing the existing monthly recurring revenue base while accelerating new revenue.
  • Establish segment and partner strategies across strategic, growth, and long-tail MSPs, using partner economics, service maturity, route to market, and growth potential to focus resources and investments.
  • Build strategic MSP and distribution relationships: Serve as executive sponsor for priority MSPs, distributors, aggregators, marketplaces, and alliances; lead joint business planning, executive business reviews, and complex commercial negotiations.
  • Create scalable distribution-led motions that improve MSP recruitment, time to first revenue, activation, product deployment, and long-term partner value.
  • Shape the program and portfolio: Represent the voice of MSP partners to Global Partner Programs, Product, Pricing, Finance, Legal, Marketing, Sales Operations, and Enablement; influence program design, consumption-based licensing, incentives, partner experience, and product readiness.
  • Identify new market opportunities and innovative MSP business models that differentiate Sophos and accelerate adoption of managed security offerings, including MDR, endpoint, firewall, XDR/EDR, cloud, and related services. Align MSP strategy with regional sales and channel leadership, and establish clear rules of engagement across MSP and term business.
  • Lead through others: Build, coach, and develop a high-performing MSP sales organization with clear expectations, career development, accountability, and a strong team culture. Set objectives, resource plans, and operating rhythms across direct reports and matrixed teams, and build the capabilities required to scale the MSP business.
  • Ensure end-to-end execution across partner recruitment, enablement, demand generation, co-selling, technical support, and partner lifecycle management while managing the budget and investments for the area.
  • Use data to improve outcomes: Establish KPIs and executive reporting for partner health, onboarding, activation, tier progression, time to first revenue, recurring revenue growth, attach, retention, product adoption, and program return on investment.
  • Use insights from performance data, market intelligence, and competitive programs to resolve systemic barriers, adjust investments, and improve program effectiveness.

What You Will Bring

  • 15+ years of progressive channel sales, partner management, or business development experience in cybersecurity, SaaS, cloud, or enterprise technology, including significant leadership of MSP programs or recurring-revenue channel businesses.
  • Proven success setting strategy and scaling a complex MSP business through direct, distribution, marketplace, and alliance channels.
  • Deep understanding of MSP operating models, partner economics, consumption-based billing, service lifecycle, partner portals, program tiers, onboarding, and recurring-revenue forecasting.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior leadership, shape policy and investment decisions, and negotiate complex agreements with partners, distributors, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Experience leading high-performing sales teams and matrixed organizations, allocating resources, managing budgets, and driving consistent execution across regions and functions.
  • Strong knowledge of the Americas cybersecurity market and managed security portfolio, including MDR, endpoint, firewall, XDR/EDR, cloud, and security services.
  • Executive-level communication, business planning, financial acumen, negotiation, and analytical skills, with the ability to convert data and market insights into clear decisions.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to travel within the Americas for partner meetings, business reviews, and industry events.
In the United States, the base salary for this role ranges from $184,800 to $308,400. In addition to the base salary, there's a component for target sales commissions alongside a comprehensive benefits package.  A candidate’s specific pay within this range will depend on a variety of factors, including job-related skills, training, location, experience, relevant education, certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

raw.description:
Help Power the Future

AECOM is seeking a Sr. Lead Substation Engineer to join our growing Energy practice in a remote role based anywhere in the United States. This position offers the opportunity to lead the design and delivery of critical transmission, distribution, renewable energy, and grid modernization projects while working alongside some of the industry's top engineering professionals.

As a technical leader within AECOM's Power Delivery team, you will play a key role in helping utilities and energy clients navigate an evolving energy landscape by delivering innovative, reliable, and resilient substation solutions.

Whether supporting grid expansion, renewable energy integration, or infrastructure modernization, you'll have the flexibility of a remote work environment while contributing to impactful projects across North America.

The Opportunity

As a Lead Substation Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for the planning, design, and delivery of utility-scale substation projects. Working with multidisciplinary teams, clients, and project managers, you will support projects from concept development through construction while ensuring technical excellence, quality, and client satisfaction.

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, mentoring others, and building strong client relationships while contributing to the continued growth of AECOM's Energy business.

What You'll Do

Technical Leadership

  • Lead the engineering and design of transmission and distribution substation projects for utility, renewable energy, and industrial clients.

  • Provide technical guidance and oversight for substation physical design, protection and control integration, grounding systems, equipment layouts, and power delivery infrastructure.

  • Support the development and review of one-line diagrams, protection schemes, equipment specifications, construction packages, and design documentation.

  • Apply engineering expertise throughout project phases including planning, conceptual design, detailed design, procurement, and construction support.

  • Support engineering studies and analyses related to grounding, equipment sizing, fault current evaluations, and substation design considerations.

  • Stay current with evolving technologies, industry standards, and utility practices related to substations, grid modernization, and power delivery systems.

  • Build standards across processes and practices.

Project Delivery

  • Lead engineering tasks and coordinate multidisciplinary project teams to deliver high-quality work on schedule and within budget.

  • Support project planning, resource coordination, technical reviews, and project execution activities.

  • Provide technical oversight for substation upgrades, expansions, brownfield modifications, and greenfield projects.

  • Collaborate with project managers to identify and mitigate risks while maintaining project objectives and client expectations.

  • Support construction activities through technical consultation, design clarifications, and resolution of field issues.

Client Engagement & Business Development

  • Build strong relationships with utility, renewable energy, and industrial clients.

  • Participate in client meetings, technical workshops, presentations, and project reviews.

  • Support proposal development, scope definition, cost estimates, and pursuit efforts.

  • Identify opportunities to expand services and strengthen long-term client partnerships.

  • Collaborate with regional and national teams to support strategic growth initiatives.

Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Mentor engineers and designers while supporting technical development and knowledge sharing.

  • Collaborate with civil, structural, transmission, protection and control, and program management teams.

  • Contribute to engineering best practices and continuous improvement initiatives across the Energy practice.

  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, safety, and collaboration.

Why AECOM

AECOM is the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle. Our Energy practice helps clients modernize the electric grid, integrate renewable energy resources, improve reliability, and support the transition to a more sustainable future.

As part of AECOM, you'll enjoy:

  • Remote work flexibility.

  • Opportunities to work on industry-leading energy projects.

  • Access to a global network of technical experts.

  • Career growth, leadership development, and professional training opportunities.

  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.

  • A collaborative culture focused on innovation, inclusion, and technical excellence.

Location: Remote (U.S.) with occasional travel based on project and client needs.

Join AECOM and help deliver the next generation of energy infrastructure.

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline with +12 years of experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.

  • Experience supporting transmission and distribution substation projects.

  • Experience with electrical engineering principles, utility infrastructure, and power delivery systems.

  • Experience leading engineering tasks, reviewing technical deliverables, and coordinating project teams.

  • Experience and knowledge working with industry standards and codes such as IEEE, NESC, and NEC.

  • Experience with industry-standard engineering and design software such as AutoCAD, MicroStation, ETAP, Aspen, CAPE, or similar tools.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a remote environment.

  • Willingness to travel periodically for project, client, and team needs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in Engineering or a related technical field.

  • Strong communication, leadership, and client relationship skills.

  • Experience supporting utility, renewable energy, grid modernization, or energy transition projects.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to technical leadership initiatives.

  • Familiarity with substation physical design, protection and control systems, SCADA integration, or related power system applications.

  • Sponorship is not available for this role
  • Relocation is not available for this role

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Die Steuerkanzlei Seitz GmbH begleitet seit über 45 Jahren mittelständische Unternehmen, Selbstständige und Privatpersonen in steuerlichen und betriebswirtschaftlichen Fragen. Wir arbeiten digital, denken langfristig und legen Wert darauf, dass unsere Mandanten feste Ansprechpartner haben. Genau deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen möchten und Freude daran haben, Mandanten kompetent zu begleiten.

Du hast Erfahrung in der Entgeltabrechnung und möchtest Dein Wissen in einer flexiblen Teilzeitstelle einsetzen? Ob aus einer Personalabteilung, einer Steuerkanzlei oder einem kaufmännischen Umfeld – bei der Steuerkanzlei Seitz GmbH übernimmst Du die eigenständige Bearbeitung der Lohnabrechnungen für unsere Mandanten und arbeitest mit modernen DATEV-Prozessen. Dabei bieten wir Dir maximale Flexibilität: Auf Wunsch ist auch eine Tätigkeit im Homeoffice zu bis zu 100 % möglich.

Aufgaben

  • Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung: Du erstellst eigenständig die monatlichen Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnungen für unsere Mandanten und sorgst für eine korrekte und termingerechte Abwicklung
  • Mandantenbetreuung: Du betreust Deinen eigenen Mandantenkreis und bist Ansprechperson bei Fragen rund um Lohnabrechnung, Lohnsteuer und Sozialversicherung
  • Meldewesen und Bescheinigungen: Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehören Meldungen an Krankenkassen und Sozialversicherungsträger sowie die Erstellung erforderlicher Bescheinigungen
  • Datenpflege und Qualitätssicherung: Du prüfst abrechnungsrelevante Daten, bearbeitest Änderungen und stellst sicher, dass alle Informationen vollständig und korrekt verarbeitet werden
  • DATEV und digitale Prozesse: Mit DATEV erstellst Du Lohnabrechnungen und nutzt digitale Abläufe für eine effiziente Bearbeitung
  • Fristenmanagement: Wichtige Termine und gesetzliche Vorgaben behältst Du im Blick und stellst eine zuverlässige Umsetzung sicher

Qualifikation

  • Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, zum Beispiel als Steuerfachangestellte, Kauffrau/Kaufmann für Büromanagement, Personaldienstleistungskaufmann/-frau (m/w/d) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Kenntnisse im Lohnsteuer- und Sozialversicherungsrecht
  • Erfahrung mit DATEV Lohn und Gehalt oder vergleichbaren Lohnabrechnungssystemen sowie ein routinierter Umgang mit MS-Office
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Diskretion im Umgang mit sensiblen Daten
  • Professionelles und freundliches Auftreten im Austausch mit Mandanten und sichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice: Mit unserer Gleitzeitregelung und der Möglichkeit, bis zu 100 % remote oder flexibel im Büro zu arbeiten, gestaltest Du Deinen Arbeitsalltag so, wie es für Dich passt. Für Deinen Arbeitsplatz zu Hause stellen wir Dir die notwendige Ausstattung zur Verfügung
  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz mit Perspektive: Freue Dich auf einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag, 30 Tage Urlaub plus zusätzliche Urlaubstage nach individueller Verhandlung und die Möglichkeit, Dich langfristig in unserer Kanzlei weiterzuentwickeln
  • Bonuszahlungen und zusätzliche Leistungen: Neben Deinem festen Gehalt profitierst Du von Bonuszahlungen bei besonderen Leistungen
  • Mobilität leicht gemacht: Für Deinen Arbeitsweg bieten wir verschiedene Möglichkeiten: E-Bike-Leasing, E-Ladestationen direkt vor Ort und die Option eines Dienstwagens
  • Moderne Ausstattung und digitale Prozesse: Du arbeitest mit moderner Technik, einem eigenen Laptop und DATEV. Digitale Abläufe helfen Dir dabei, Deine Aufgaben effizient zu bearbeiten
  • Weiterbildung und fachliche Entwicklung: Du möchtest Dein Wissen erweitern oder Dich fachlich weiterentwickeln? Wir unterstützen Dich mit passenden Fortbildungen und übernehmen die Kosten
  • Ruhiger Arbeitsplatz mit guter Erreichbarkeit: Unsere Kanzlei liegt in Marktsteft bei Kitzingen. Du arbeitest in einer Umgebung mit kurzen Wegen, ohne den täglichen Stress einer Großstadt, und erreichst gleichzeitig Würzburg und die umliegenden Orte gut

Du weißt, worauf es in der Lohnabrechnung ankommt. Wir bieten Dir die Rahmenbedingungen, damit Du Deine Erfahrung bestmöglich einsetzen kannst: flexible Arbeitszeiten, bis zu 100 % Homeoffice, moderne DATEV-Prozesse und einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz mit langfristiger Perspektive.

raw.description:
This role is a remote role to be based in Thailand.

About our company
Join Triptease — a high-growth SaaS company reshaping the future of hotel distribution. We help hoteliers take back control from OTAs by equipping them with the tools to grow direct bookings, protect margins, and strengthen guest loyalty.

Our platform combines proprietary hotel data, AI-driven marketing tools, and advanced pricing intelligence to give hoteliers an edge. With over £1 billion in direct revenue driven for clients annually and a global presence, this is your chance to be part of something big.

About our role

Ready to accelerate your career in Customer Success while making a real difference in the travel industry?

We're looking for a smart, driven and customer-obsessed individual to join our global CS team as a Customer Success Manager overseeing a group of our Mid Market accounts. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with 2–3 years of experience who's ready to take the next step, own relationships, and grow fast with a supportive team around them.

What you'll do

  • Own Your Portfolio — Manage ~25–35 hotel accounts. You'll be their go-to advisor, ensuring they're successful on the platform, achieving their goals, and sticking around long term.
  • Be Their Strategic Partner — Go beyond support. You'll help hoteliers improve their digital guest experience, boost direct bookings, and maximize revenue. Think of yourself as a consultant, not just a CSM.
  • Drive Impact with Data — Turn insights into action. Use our platform data to show the value your hotels are getting, and help them do more with it.
  • Grow and Renew Your Accounts — Own the commercial arc of every relationship. You'll convert trials into long-term contracts by making sure clients actually hit the expectations set at kick-off, uncover expansion opportunities as their needs grow (additional products, new properties, etc.), and lead renewal conversations and negotiations when the time comes. Retention and growth in your portfolio are yours to drive.
  • Build Real Relationships — You'll work with everyone from hotel marketing managers to GMs, and with our internal teams (Product, Sales, Engineering) to make sure your clients get what they need.
  • Level Up Their Success (and Yours) — Share best practices, lead training, gather feedback, and advocate for your hotels internally. We're big believers in customer-led growth.
  • Represent & Inspire — Encourage happy clients to become advocates at events, webinars, and in our hotelier community. Represent Triptease and your clients proudly.

Requirements

  • Experience: 2–3 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role, ideally within B2B SaaS. You've owned a portfolio, grown that book of business and been accountable for whether those customers renewed.
  • Language: Native-level proficiency in English and Thai (written and spoken) is essential. You must be able to communicate commercial and technical nuance clearly, and hold a confident conversation with a hotel's commercial leadership.
  • The "Automate Everything" Mindset: You are obsessed with efficiency and hate doing the same manual task twice. You approach work with this logic:
    • First time: You solve it and wonder if it will happen again.
    • Second time: You build a template or tool to automate the majority of the task.
    • Third time: You actively work to automate the process from start to finish so you never have to do it manually again.
  • In practice, this means the CSM who builds a reusable reporting template will always beat the one who rebuilds the same deck 30 times a quarter. We give you AI tools and the freedom to use them — we expect you to.
  • Commercial Ownership: You're comfortable owning renewal conversations, spotting risk early, and identifying growth opportunities in your accounts. You can talk about numbers — retention, revenue impact, ROI — without flinching.
  • Data Fluency: You can get into a spreadsheet or dashboard, find the story in the numbers, and build a recommendation from it. You don't just forward a report to a client; you tell them what it means and what to do next.
  • Technical Curiosity: You don't need to code, but you should be comfortable enough with web technologies to understand how our product sits on a hotel's website, what a tag manager does, and when an issue needs Support or Engineering. You're able to hold a credible conversation with a client's web agency rather than deferring every technical question.
  • Platform Proficiency: Confident using a modern CS platform (Vitally, Gainsight, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar) and support tooling such as Intercom. More importantly, you pick up new tools quickly and don't need a training course to get started.
  • Communication & Executive Presence: Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can lead a call with a GM or commercial director, present performance clearly, and handle pushback without losing the room.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: You enjoy the investigation. When a hotel's performance dips, you want to understand why, not just report that it happened.
  • Adaptability: Comfort working in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and new features ship frequently.
  • Self-Direction: You manage your own time, portfolio, and priorities across a distributed team without needing to be chased.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in hospitality, travel tech, or a hotel commercial function (revenue management, e-commerce, distribution).
  • Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, or the metasearch and OTA landscape.
  • Experience using issue-tracking tools like Linear or JIRA.
  • Hands-on experience building with AI tools — automations, custom GPTs or Claude projects, scripts, no-code workflows.

Benefits

We’re a well-looked-after bunch, with excellent benefits (these vary by location):

  • A competitive salary and bonus plan
  • Regular career development reviews — we reward great work
  • Something important to you that’s not on this list? Talk to us

Please note: benefits may vary depending on employment type and location, and some benefits listed may not apply to contractor arrangements.

We set big goals and move fast, but we support each other every step of the way. If you're a CS pro who thrives on customer focus, data, and impact, we'd love to hear from you.
